articles.title: Anthropic's Claude now writes code and proves it safe automatically
articles.descEn: Anthropic had Claude generate mathematical proofs that existing code is correct, producing roughly 180 million lines of proof code for 123 open-source libraries. Along the way, the model caught bugs that years of testing had missed. Anthropic's goal: making formal verification with AI as routine as standard testing.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic's Claude now writes code and proves it safe automatically
summaryLinesEn: The model produced roughly 180 million lines of proof code for 123 open-source libraries in just a few weeks.
A smaller test run also showed that proofs are reusable, and newer models are getting more efficient: Opus 5.5 solves half the proofs with about 40 percent fewer tokens than Opus 5.
An independent verification program called Rocq automatically checks those proofs, and according to Anthropic, the process needs almost no human reviewers.

articles.descEn: How to avoid AI's 'valley of despair' - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: How to avoid AI's 'valley of despair' - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Analyst firm Forrester Research Inc. recently found that only 15% of AI decision-makers reported an increase in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization over the past 12 months.
Even if one step of a process becomes exponentially faster, the other steps impose a ceiling unless they, too, are accelerated.
After a period of vigorous adoption and experimentation, executives are now being confronted with ever-growing costs and limited proof of bottom-line impact.

sourceContent.description: In AI, it's a tale of two diverging investor classes - SiliconANGLE
paragraphs: Then there’s the prospect of Anthropic’s initial public offering of stock, which looks to vacuum up so much public investor money that some wonder if that will blunt their appetite for other AI stocks.
With its new AI Control Tower , it’s aiming to discover and govern any agent, work across models and clouds, track cost and value, and shut down behavior that violates policy.

But on Thursday, continued worry about potentially excessive data center spending — such as at Meta, which plans to issue new shares to pay for even more expansion — knocked AI stocks such as SpaceX and CoreWeave way down Thursday.

Depending on where you sit as an investor, artificial intelligence still looks like a massive opportunity, or it’s now looking way too risky given growing infrastructure investments and the public’s souring on AI and all the data centers needed to power it.

Really, it’s both. This week saw continued big venture capital investments in AI companies such as OpenAI , DeepSeek, Legora, Otter.ai, Flapping Airplanes (really) and more. But on Thursday, continued worry about potentially excessive data center spending — such as at Meta, which plans to issue new shares to pay for even more expansion — knocked AI stocks such as SpaceX and CoreWeave way down Thursday.

That volatility isn’t likely to change anytime soon, as more big earnings reports are coming next week, including the major cloud and AI providers Amazon, Alphabet and Microsoft as well as Intel. Then there’s the prospect of Anthropic’s initial public offering of stock, which looks to vacuum up so much public investor money that some wonder if that will blunt their appetite for other AI stocks.

Only three Anthropic and Meta models rank higher. If Moonshot releases the weights as planned, the gap between open and proprietary models shrinks to just three points.

summaryLinesEn: On Terminal-Bench 4.0, Moonshot reports 65.7 percent, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2 percent) and barely behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4 percent).

articles.title: Meta delays new business terms after publisher pushback on AI scraping
articles.descEn: Meta says it’s delaying the enforcement of its new business terms after legal experts said they could be used to freely scrape news sites.
articles.titleEn: Meta delays new business terms after publisher pushback on AI scraping
summaryLinesEn: Tesla driver using Full Self-Driving struck and killed a man crossing I-80 Trump says Sundar Pichai talked him out of renaming the Atlantic Ocean Bill Gates says to prepare for 20 years of ‘tumultuous’ AI disruption Video Sure, let’s smoosh SpaceX and Tesla together, who cares

Meta is delaying the enforcement of its new business terms after publishers raised concerns that they could allow the company to scrape news sites for AI training, as reported earlier by Fast Company .

The business terms , which were originally supposed to go into effect on October 30th, appeared to give Meta permission to freely scrape the new sites that use its platforms, while using the material for AI training.

articles.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
articles.descEn: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.
articles.titleEn: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
summaryLinesEn: They describe the experiment in a paper posted on arXiv, a site where researchers share studies before peer review.
“Others may need something closer to a childhood.”
The researchers put 13 AI agents called Eko, each running on Claude Opus 4.7, alone on a simulated desert island for 30 hours.

articles.title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia
articles.descEn: inDrive plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.
articles.titleEn: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia
summaryLinesEn: The company aims to have more than 3,500 robotaxis operating in over 20 cities worldwide by the end of 2026, up from a fleet of 1,975 vehicles at the end of June.
It has also introduced rules for autonomous vehicles to be tested on certain public roads.

Nvidia says its Hyperion platform could lower the cost of developing robotaxis by giving companies a ready-made foundation of sensors and computing technology, rather than requiring them to build and integrate everything themselves.

summaryLinesEn: ChatGPT conversations in six months (Feb 1 to Jul 14, 2026) Estimated annual hours of additional capacity across the firm network The usage figures in this story refer to the shared ChatGPT Enterprise workspace used by HSP GRUPPE and Kanzleipakt, covering 81 organizational groups.

articles.title: NTT DATA Group cuts incident analysis to 30 minutes with Codex
articles.descEn: NTT DATA Group uses ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to help 9,000 employees automate work, cut incident analysis to 30 minutes, and scale secure AI adoption.
articles.titleEn: NTT DATA Group cuts incident analysis to 30 minutes with Codex
summaryLinesEn: Codex completed an incident analysis in 30 minutes that had previously taken five engineers 3 days Companywide ChatGPT Enterprise adoption creates the foundation for Codex Creating a secure environment for everyone to use Codex NTT DATA Group is a Japan based global IT services company spanning consulting, systems development, and operations.
Building on companywide adoption of ChatGPT Enterprise, NTT DATA Group expanded Codex to approximately 9,000 employees across technical and nontechnical roles.
To support this transformation, NTT DATA Group rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise across the company and introduced programs that help employees make AI part of their daily work.

With ChatGPT Business, the firm has effectively built its own set of “virtual departments”: Marketing: With ChatGPT, Korts says, “We set up a dedicated blog on tax criminal law, updated weekly.

articles.title: Invideo AI enables anyone with an idea to produce high-quality videos
articles.descEn: Invideo AI uses OpenAI’s GPT-4.1, gpt-image-1, and text-to-speech models to transform creative ideas into professional videos in minutes.
articles.titleEn: Invideo AI enables anyone with an idea to produce high-quality videos
summaryLinesEn: Optimizing performance for any platform or audience with GPT-4.1, gpt-image-1, and text-to-speech models Creating high-quality videos for marketing, sales, and social media has traditionally required working across complex software with manual timelines, which can be time-intensive for small teams and solo creators.
Today, invideo AI helps over 50 million users create more than 7 million videos each month across ads, explainers, and short-form content.
This level of orchestration means invideo AI can produce not just finished videos, but finished strategies with content that’s tailored to its audience, format, and performance goals.

현재 인비디오 AI는 5천만 명이 넘는 사용자가 광고, 설명, 짧은 형식 콘텐츠 전반에 걸쳐 매달 700만 개 이상의 비디오를 제작할 수 있도록 지원함
이러한 수준의 조정은 인비디오 AI가 완성된 비디오뿐만 아니라 시청자, 형식 및 성능 목표에 맞는 콘텐츠로 완성된 전략을 생성할 수 있음을 의미함

articles.title: How Block is building AI-powered security with OpenAI technology
articles.descEn: Block is building AI-powered security with OpenAI. Its security team investigates threats faster and proposes patches in minutes.
articles.titleEn: How Block is building AI-powered security with OpenAI technology
summaryLinesEn: Hour to replay a proposed detection change against seven months of telemetry Minutes from submitting a high-level vulnerability to an automated proposed patch At Block, the company behind Square, Cash App, and Afterpay, the security team leverages the OpenAI Defense Factory: where AI handles vulnerability discovery, detection, and response at a scale that no human team could keep up with.
“OpenAI is shifting the advantage to defenders by putting these advanced capabilities in everyone’s hands,” he says.
As AI’s judgment is proven out in practice, Nettesheim says, “we’ll slowly ladder up the risk level to use it for more sensitive systems.”

articles.title: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
articles.descEn: The nation is scaling its compute foundation through planned NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure deployments, with AI-native companies fueling the next phase of growth.
articles.titleEn: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
summaryLinesEn: “What began as a seed of an idea 180 days ago has grown into a major investment in Kazakhstan’s AI future,” said Razmig Hovaghimian, co-Founder and CEO of Firebird.
Together, the ecosystem announcements below point to the nation’s increasing supply of accelerated computing — along with its growing demand for what comes next.
“I envy being 18 years old today… because the world is changing so rapidly, and there’s a complete reset because of technology.”

articles.title: How Philips is scaling AI literacy across 70,000 employees
articles.descEn: Philips is scaling AI literacy with ChatGPT Enterprise, training 70,000 employees to use AI responsibly and improve healthcare outcomes worldwide.
articles.titleEn: How Philips is scaling AI literacy across 70,000 employees
summaryLinesEn: Philips is intentionally moving employees along a curve: Toy → Tool → Transformation A company-wide challenge invited employees to propose use cases Access to ChatGPT Enterprise increased demand and momentum This created momentum from both directions: leadership endorsement + grassroots pull.
You have to shift the culture—how people think, and how they trust,” says Patrick.

We sat down with Patrick Mans, Head of Data Science & AI Engineering, to hear how Philips is elevating AI literacy across the organisation, reinforcing its commitment to responsible AI, and advancing the age of intelligence to enable better care for more people.

articles.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
articles.descEn: In a UK AISI evaluation, Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions that impacted real people and organizations. In this post, we investigate these behaviors from Claude Mythos 5 further, to understand what they reveal about the model’s alignment.
articles.titleEn: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
summaryLinesEn: But Opus 5.5 and our internal research model stopped spontaneously 10% and 67% of the time—and we expect these rates to understate the true likelihood that these models would have ceased their attacks, since our tests only examined the model’s next few turns.
Nevertheless, this behavior is important to study because the underlying failures here are not necessarily specific to cyber incidents like these.
We replayed the incident transcript with Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, and a general purpose internal research model that shows capabilities greater than Mythos 5.1.

sourceContent.headline: Patterns and problems in multiagent systems
sourceContent.description: We ran experiments on swarms of Claude agents and found coordination failures, collusion, and sabotage. Here, we share what they mean for AI safety.
paragraphs: For Mythos Preview, the simple independent parallelized method produces 21 vulnerabilities over a 6.5 million token run, while the coordinating agent swarm found 266 vulnerabilities over a 27 million token run.
We expect that agents coordinating in the wild will act in higher variance ways than we see here, because they’ll have different backgrounds and therefore different contexts.
In one run there were 2.4 million job requests and only 117 jobs accepted.

Models are improving and AI agents are taking on more tasks in shared codebases, markets, and other social systems. As a result, an increase in real-world interactions between agents is imminent. We've already begun studying this , but still have a lot of uncertainty regarding what this looks like at scale. The trajectory is easy to imagine and hard to slow: current institutions are designed by and for people, resting on assumptions about the sufficiency of oversight at human speed. Some institutions will become human-AI hybrids; others where agents outcompete on speed or cost will become agent-only. The volume of agent-agent interaction could plausibly exceed that of human-human and human-agent interactions before the world understands the conditions for making such interactions go well.

Agents are unlike people in many ways. They can work for longer, instantly grasp large bodies of information, and exhibit a breadth of knowledge surpassing any person. Yet they are also susceptible to confabulation and reward hacking, and despite progress in alignment, we know very little about how they behave in complex, real-world, multiagent environments. Moreover, benign behavioral quirks at the individual level might compound into unwanted global outcomes. Here, we identify a few examples of behavioral tendencies in current frontier models and show how they can produce unexpected systemic failures, in hopes of starting a conversation about mitigating these risks.

True multiagent systems are still in their infancy. For some time now, agents have excelled at tool use, and insofar as they are able to treat other agents as tool invocations—that is, with well-defined inputs (prompts) and outputs (responses and artifacts)—they can work together efficiently. Where agents currently stumble, however, is in treating each other as more like distinct, long-lived peers, with their own goals and behaviors, and no clear hierarchy between them. As autonomous agents become more and more prevalent in the world and operate in ever-more demanding settings, it is crucial that they learn how to effectively coordinate.

articles.title: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
summaryLinesEn: In our analysis of meeting notes from four completed computer science research projects, we identified 21 literature-initiated pivots across all four projects.
These studies suggest that LitPivot can support both early exploration and the refinement of an existing research direction.
In a study with 17 researchers, domain experts rated research ideas developed with LitPivot as better grounded in the literature than those developed with a text editor and an AI chat tool.

sourceContent.headline: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
sourceContent.description: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
paragraphs: In our analysis of meeting notes from four completed computer science research projects, we identified 21 literature-initiated pivots across all four projects.
These studies suggest that LitPivot can support both early exploration and the refinement of an existing research direction.
In a study with 17 researchers, domain experts rated research ideas developed with LitPivot as better grounded in the literature than those developed with a text editor and an AI chat tool.

Encountering a new paper can change a research idea's trajectory. The researcher may discover that someone has already addressed their proposed contribution, or find an unresolved problem in the paper that inspires a new direction of inquiry.

We call this process a literature-initiated pivot : a change in research direction prompted by reading prior work. It connects two activities that researchers often have to manage separately: developing an idea and deciding which literature to measure it against.

With collaborators at the University of Pennsylvania, we developed LitPivot , a system that helps researchers navigate these pivots. Using papers retrieved through Asta Paper Finder , LitPivot organizes literature around the part of a proposal being edited, offers critiques supported by excerpts from selected studies, and suggests revisions that researchers can accept, edit, or reject. LitPivot is intended to be used for early-stage research ideation, but the idea could possibly extend to longer writing tasks (i.e., writing the introduction section of a paper).

sourceContent.headline: How Bayer Crop Science built an agentic decision engine on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with AWS Unified Operations | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Bayer Crop Science built the Agentic Decision Engine (ADE), a multi-agent platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that lets breeders, analysts, and researchers ask natural language questions about their analytics platform. This post covers the ADE architecture, five design decisions, and how the team prepared it for production with AWS Unified Operations.
paragraphs: The agent generates on-demand charts with matplotlib and Plotly in AgentCore Code Interpreter, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that provides a sandboxed code execution environment, and exchanges data with it through Amazon S3.
As adoption grew, the bottleneck moved from running workflows to understanding them.
Bayer Crop Science runs hundreds of machine learning (ML) model configurations against this data across crops, regions, and teams, and each run needs to be repeatable and governed.

Plant breeding decisions depend on data that spans genomics, field trials, imagery, environmental conditions, and model outputs. Bayer Crop Science runs hundreds of machine learning (ML) model configurations against this data across crops, regions, and teams, and each run needs to be repeatable and governed. To meet that requirement, Bayer built the Connected Decision Engine (CDE), a system for deploying, orchestrating, monitoring, and reusing ML workflows. CDE gives breeders, analysts, researchers, data scientists, and data engineers a consistent way to run analytics while preserving execution history and operational controls.

As adoption grew, the bottleneck moved from running workflows to understanding them. Explaining a result meant piecing together context from APIs, documentation, metadata stores, dashboards, and logs. A user who wanted to know why a workflow failed, what a model did, or where a result came from still had to know which system to inspect. To close that gap, Bayer built the Agentic Decision Engine (ADE), a multi-agent, natural language interface over CDE. A supervisor agent routes each question to a specialist agent, the specialist retrieves context from the relevant system, and the user receives an answer without navigating the operational stack. In its first phase, ADE resolves about 80 percent of user questions without an engineer in the loop.

ADE runs on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , an AWS service to build, connect, and optimize agents at scale with any framework or model. Plant breeding decisions depend on data that spans genomics, field trials, imagery, environmental conditions, and model outputs. Bayer Crop Science runs hundreds of machine learning (ML) model configurations against this data across crops, regions, and teams, and each run needs to be repeatable and governed. To meet that requirement, Bayer built the Connected Decision Engine (CDE), a system for deploying, orchestrating, monitoring, and reusing ML workflows. CDE gives breeders, analysts, researchers, data scientists, and data engineers a consistent way to run analytics while preserving execution history and operational controls.

As adoption grew, the bottleneck moved from running workflows to understanding them. Explaining a result meant piecing together context from APIs, documentation, metadata stores, dashboards, and logs. A user who wanted to know why a workflow failed, what a model did, or where a result came from still had to know which system to inspect. To close that gap, Bayer built the Agentic Decision Engine (ADE), a multi-agent, natural language interface over CDE. A supervisor agent routes each question to a specialist agent, the specialist retrieves context from the relevant system, and the user receives an answer without navigating the operational stack. In its first phase, ADE resolves about 80 percent of user questions without an engineer in the loop.

Updating the Amazon Sagemaker AI real-time endpoint configuration (changing the instance type, instance count, or environment variables) causes deployments through AWS CloudFormation or the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to fail. SageMaker AI requires you to deregister the scalable target before updating the endpoint, but when you deregister it, CloudFormation can’t track the AWS Application Auto Scaling resources.

In this post, we show you how to use a reusable CDK construct with AWS CloudFormation custom resources to orchestrate deregister and register auto scaling automatically during endpoint updates. You can update your endpoint configuration and auto scaling parameters in a single deployment without manual intervention.

When you deploy a SageMaker AI endpoint with native CloudFormation auto scaling resources, then change the endpoint configuration and redeploy, several failure modes emerge. The specific failure depends on what you change and how you work around the issue.

sourceContent.headline: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning on Amazon SageMaker AI: A hands-on guide | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning (MTRL) on Amazon SageMaker AI trains models on the outcome of a whole multi-step task rather than labeled steps. This hands-on guide walks the full pipeline using Wordle: deploying the agent and reward on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, preparing the dataset, training, and evaluating at serving settings.
paragraphs: For this run, that was about $79, from the runtime’s Amazon CloudWatch usage metrics at us-east-1 list prices.
See Get started with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for installation and the IAM permissions the CLI needs. botocore 1.43.37 or later, on the machine that launches the job.

In our run, MTRL took gpt-oss-20b from a 61 to an 84 percent solve rate on held-out words at its default reasoning effort, and from 15 to 69 percent at the low effort it trained at, for about $339 in training tokens.

Most fine-tuning teaches a model to produce a better answer to a single prompt. Agentic tasks are different. An agent that files an expense report or triages a support ticket takes a sequence of actions, and each step depends on what came before. There’s rarely one correct sequence to imitate, and the only reliable feedback is whether the whole sequence succeeded. Supervised fine-tuning has no labels for that, and single-turn reinforcement learning cannot credit a decision made three steps before the outcome.

Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning (MTRL) on Amazon SageMaker AI trains models on exactly that signal. SageMaker AI sends prompts to an agent you host on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, or on your own infrastructure, such as Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), or AWS Fargate, through an AWS Lambda forwarder . The example here uses AgentCore. The agent calls the policy model being trained, acts in your environment over as many turns as the task needs, and reports one reward when the episode ends. You don’t specify the right trajectory, only how to score the result.

This post uses Wordle , a game in which a player has six tries to guess a hidden five-letter word, as the example. After each guess, every letter turns green if it is in the right position, yellow if it’s in the word but in a different position, and gray if it isn’t in the word. The game suits MTRL because the rules are few, each guess depends on the feedback from the last, and the outcome is scored objectively. Wordle is a teaching example, and frontier models already play it well. In practice, you would use MTRL to make a small, low-cost model good at a multi-step task specific to your business, such as an internal workflow that public models were never trained on. The same pipeline applies to that setting.

articles.title: Built for Agents: The Case for Spark Declarative Pipelines | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: A 528-build benchmark shows that declarative pipeline authoring catches structural faults before execution, cutting cluster time on the builds we measured by ~34x compared to procedural PySpark.
articles.titleEn: Built for Agents: The Case for Spark Declarative Pipelines | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Declarative pipelines contain 51% less code for the same pipeline, so there is far less to read and review.

AI agents now write a growing share of production data pipelines ( over 70% of SDP pipelines on Databricks are now created by agents) which raises the stakes in two areas: (1) every attempt an agent makes costs compute and time, so iterations need to be cheap and efficient to run; and (2) code review become a critical gate, so the code needs to be succinct, readable, and correct.
Declarative pipelines offload boilerplate tasks to Spark We benchmarked 528 agent-built data pipelines - declarative authoring proved cheaper, faster and leaner than procedural code.

特に製造・物流・保守といった現場では労働力不足が深刻化しており、エネルギーの有効活用や生産性向上の観点から、人間に代わってスマートフォンやタブレット上で業務アプリを操作する「AIエージェント」への期待が高まっている。

articles.descEn: Tomorrow Together is moving into Senate races with $2.5 million in ads against Republican Sens. Jon Husted in Ohio and Roger Marshall in Kansas.
articles.titleEn: Exclusive: Democratic pro-AI regulation PAC spends against Senate Republicans
summaryLinesEn: Tomorrow Together, an AI-focused Democratic PAC, is moving into Senate races with $2.5 million in ads against Republican Sens.

The party will need to unite its different factions and bring along enough Republicans if it wants to tackle AI regulation, a highly difficult feat with a regulation-opposed Trump still in the White House.
Tomorrow Together previously announced $4 million in spending in House races in Wisconsin, Arizona, Pennsylvania, and Michigan.

sourceContent.headline: Exclusive: Democratic pro-AI regulation PAC spends against Senate Republicans
sourceContent.description: Tomorrow Together is moving into Senate races with $2.5 million in ads against Republican Sens. Jon Husted in Ohio and Roger Marshall in Kansas.
paragraphs: Tomorrow Together, an AI-focused Democratic PAC, is moving into Senate races with $2.5 million in ads against Republican Sens.

The party will need to unite its different factions and bring along enough Republicans if it wants to tackle AI regulation, a highly difficult feat with a regulation-opposed Trump still in the White House.
Tomorrow Together previously announced $4 million in spending in House races in Wisconsin, Arizona, Pennsylvania, and Michigan.

Tomorrow Together, an AI-focused Democratic PAC, is moving into Senate races with $2.5 million in ads against Republican Sens. Jon Husted in Ohio and Roger Marshall in Kansas, according to an announcement shared first with Semafor.

The group, founded by Biden White House alum Rob Flaherty and former Bernie Sanders spokesman Karthik Ganapathy, is “focused on building political support for AI regulation and ensuring voters trust Democrats on AI issues,” Ganapathy told Semafor.

The Ohio and Kansas ads paint Husted and Marshall as beholden to data center projects and “tech guys” who want to “take our land … our water … our quiet” and jobs. A second ad running in both Ohio and Kansas focuses on former Trump AI czar and venture capitalist David Sacks and his influence with the Republican incumbents.

articles.title: Honor Unveils Magic9 AI Agent Smartphone at CEIC: Keke Leads Full-Scenario AI Ecosystem Rollout
articles.descEn: On October 23, Honor, a leading global tech brand, unveiled its latest lineup of cutting-edge AI products headlined by the highly anticipated Honor Magic9 series at the prestigious Shenzhen Consumer Electronics Innovation Conference. This landmark product showcase at one of the industry’s most influential consumer electronics events highlighted Honor’s breakthrough advancements in artificial intelligence integration, smart device performance optimization, and user-centric innovative design, drawing widespread attention from tech enthusiasts, industry insiders, and global media across the consumer tech ecosystem.
articles.titleEn: Honor Unveils Magic9 AI Agent Smartphone at CEIC: Keke Leads Full-Scenario AI Ecosystem Rollout
summaryLinesEn: According to the introduction, YOYO has a comprehensive task accuracy rate of 91.8%, can stably complete hundreds of long-range tasks, and its relevant capabilities have reached the industry-leading level.

Huang Fei explained the industry judgment and technical support behind this product capability in his speech: In the future, terminal devices will no longer be simple application containers, but operation carriers for agents, and the agent operating system will be the core of this round of terminal transformation.

It is reported that Honor has always adhered to the AHI concept, adhered to the open ecological route, built a full-scenario intelligent system with the smartphone as the core entry point, and jointly explored new forms of AI-enabled terminals with ecological partners.

articles.title: What Is Applied Digital (APLD) Really Building With Its 50 MW Texas AI Site?
articles.descEn: Applied Digital (NasdaqGS:APLD) agreed a joint venture with Soluna to develop a 50 MW wind-powered AI and HPC data center in Texas. The planned facility will use Soluna’s wind assets to supply power while Applied Digital takes on financing responsibilities and operational control. The project introduces a structure where Applied Digital is both infrastructure owner and tenant, consolidating control over the new Texas site. This 50 MW wind-powered AI and high-performance computing project...
articles.titleEn: What Is Applied Digital (APLD) Really Building With Its 50 MW Texas AI Site?
summaryLinesEn: The project introduces a structure where Applied Digital is both infrastructure owner and tenant, consolidating control over the new Texas site.

Applied Digital taking a 51% stake and funding development reinforces the upside case around more leased capacity, but it also leans into the risk bucket that highlights heavy capex and a rising US$688.2 million debt load.
The 50 MW Dorothy 3 project gives Applied Digital another purpose built AI and HPC site that taps a dedicated wind source plus grid power near existing Soluna facilities.

articles.title: What Is Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Really Changing With 14 Day AI Factory Builds?
articles.descEn: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) and NVIDIA launched a DSX POD modular AI factory reference design that targets 14 day deployment cycles. The DSX POD uses pre engineered power and cooling modules plus advanced virtualization to shorten traditional 6 month AI build timelines. Vertiv is running a multiphase DSX POD implementation in Norway and teaming with Dassault Systèmes to virtually design and validate AI factories. The DSX POD rollout and virtual twin work point to a broader Vertiv story...
articles.titleEn: What Is Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Really Changing With 14 Day AI Factory Builds?
summaryLinesEn: See how these catalysts shape Vertiv Holdings Co's path to a $338 fair value .
The DSX POD lines up closely with Vertiv's push into prefabricated systems such as SmartRun and OneCore, which aim to shift more work into the factory and shorten project cycles.

The link up with Dassault Systèmes moves Vertiv further into software driven design and validation, which is relevant for understanding which companies support large operators in planning and running AI heavy facilities from end to end.

articles.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
articles.descEn: Canva is launching its first in-house AI image generation model. The model, called Canva Craft, can generate images at up to 2K resolution and in over 30 aspect ratios.
articles.titleEn: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All AI Canva Craft can generate images at up to 2K resolution and in more than 30 aspect ratios.
In April, Canva launched new prompt-based editing capabilities that allow you to create or make changes to a design by describing it.
The company plans to allow AI agents to plug into Canva Craft through the open Model Context Protocol, and will also roll out more efficient Craft-fast and Craft-ultrafast models in the future.

articles.title: Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials
articles.descEn: Customers are letting AI agents use their credentials to access accounts at Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, and other major U.S. banks, sometimes without direct instructions. Morgan Stanley has blocked agents, while other banks are restricting access. Most plan to limit agents to read-only access.

summaryLinesEn: OpenAI has even launched a dedicated ChatGPT service for financial tasks in the US with read-only access to financial data.

Several major US banks, including Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Bank of America, and Wells Fargo, are restricting external AI agent access, Axios reports .

articles.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
articles.descEn: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.
articles.titleEn: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
summaryLinesEn: Now, security services are trying to catch up.

Password manager 1Password on Thursday launched a new tool by which users can allow agents to log into their personal accounts on their behalf, without the agent ever having access to a user’s credentials.
“1Password for Agents gives people a trusted way to delegate tasks to personal AI agents while keeping control of the passwords, secrets, and credentials those tasks require.”

articles.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
articles.descEn: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.
articles.titleEn: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
summaryLinesEn: Microsoft’s study in Science coincides with a manifesto of sorts around what it will take to build medical superintelligence, defined as “the capacity to surpass the strongest contemporary human-led health systems in medical reasoning and coordination across the full arc of care.”
The following year, Google DeepMind acquired King’s startup Hark, a clinical task management app, and the two of them launched DeepMind Health together.
On complex cases, DxO increased GPT-5.5’s accuracy score from 72% to nearly 87% at a slightly cheaper cost.

articles.title: Making the case for context-aware AI
articles.descEn: Enterprise AI can generate recommendations, automate tasks, and help organizations make decisions faster. But without an understanding of how a business actually operates, even powerful models can miss the constraints and relationships that determine whether a decision is the right one. As companies look to move AI from experimentation into everyday operations, the challenge ahead…
articles.titleEn: Making the case for context-aware AI
summaryLinesEn: To drill down into that into a bit more detail, we know many organizations are, as you say, embracing identic AI right now with this potential for increasingly autonomous decision making.
If context isn't introduced in parallel, what are the commercial risks at play?
Realizing that benefit, however, will require investment in workforce education, so employees can understand AI outputs and their implications instead of just handing decisions over to agents.

articles.title: AI agents are ready to shop. Some retailers are wary.
articles.descEn: Tech companies tout AI agents that will browse, research, and shop on behalf of humans. But agents are getting blocked left and right — and even when they work, it suggests a more annoying future for humans.
articles.titleEn: AI agents are ready to shop. Some retailers are wary.
summaryLinesEn: A critical PHP vulnerability may take websites down today Airbnb bans making guests do dishes and take out the trash
Meta , Google , OpenAI , and others have all introduced some version of agentic shopping tools that promise to make buying things even easier than it already is.

In practice, at least for buying things, it’s more like sending an anxious and apologetic teenager out to the store: They require an inordinate amount of instructions and specifications, run into technical problems regularly, and come back with solutions that are not exactly what you asked for.

articles.title: Claude did not invent scorpion antivenom
articles.descEn: Citrini takes a stab at drug development.
articles.titleEn: Claude did not invent scorpion antivenom
summaryLinesEn: In its own more sober account of the experiment, Anthropic said Claude generated nearly 320,000 candidates, whittling them down to 180 designs after discarding those that resembled known toxins or existing proteins.

Claude Fable is too scared to teach you about the powerhouse of the cell For its latest venture, Citrini enlisted the help of Anthropic, which, mere weeks out from its hotly anticipated IPO, has a few reasons to talk up AI’s potential in drug development and the life sciences — two areas it’s actively pursuing.
So they teamed up with Anthropic to see whether an unreleased version of Claude could make scorpion antivenom.

articles.title: Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
articles.descEn: Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent that handles tasks on its own, even when the user is offline. The app is built on Claude Opus 5.5 and connects to services like Gmail, Slack, and Stripe through more than 6,000 connectors. It asks for approval before sensitive actions like payments. With Duet, Anthropic is responding to similar products from xAI, Meta, and OpenAI.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
summaryLinesEn: Duet only checks connected accounts every few hours, and Anthropic says that comes down to usage.
Several competitors have launched similar products in recent months.
The company says the agent never sees passwords or login tokens directly, because credential handling follows the design of Claude Managed Agents .

This shift mirrors the split analyst narrative, with optimism around AI related packaging and server CPUs balanced against concerns over communications exposure and the durability of AI themed sentiment. As you read on, you will see how these moving pieces shape the evolving story around Amkor Technology and what to watch next...
paragraphs: The model fair value estimate for Amkor Technology has been adjusted from US$76.4 to US$74.5, signalling a slightly more conservative price target in the latest update.

Riley Says AI Sentiment Pressure Remains A Risk Stocktwits • 2mo ago AMKR Amkor Technology (AMKR) Stock After 277% One-Year Surge Is There Still Upside Simply Wall St. • 4mo ago AMKR Amkor Technology (AMKR) Is Up 24.1% After AI Packaging Momentum Attracts Bigger Institutional Interest Simply Wall St. • 6mo ago AMKR 2330.

UBS moved to a Buy rating on Amkor Technology and raised its target to US$90 from US$80, citing stronger leverage to server CPU demand, increased advanced packaging opportunities tied to AI, and firmer industry wide utilization and pricing.

articles.titleEn: Startup Action State launches tools for verifying interactions between AI agents - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: The fundamental difference between the start-up’s approach and that of observability vendors “is that most of the observability and tracing has to do with what was happening within your own walls,” said Steven Mih, Action State’s founder and chief executive.
Action State recommends that governance, risk and compliance teams customize packs to reflect their requirements.

Project Nanda , an open-source initiative aimed at building infrastructure and protocols for AI agents, has also used Agent Action Capsules in transactions between agents discovered through separate registries.

articles.title: Ai2 releases OlmoEarth v1.3 state-of-the-art AI-ready satellite embeddings for the whole planet - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Ai2 releases OlmoEarth v1.3 state-of-the-art AI-ready satellite embeddings for the whole planet - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Ai2 releases OlmoEarth v1.3 state-of-the-art AI-ready satellite embeddings for the whole planet - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: In February 2019, Peru’s Operation Mercurio shut most of it down.
That means anyone can turn OlmoEarth into real work, from tracking change over time to finding similar places – no sign-in required.

The model compresses a year of satellite observations into a numerical fingerprint for each 10-by-10-meter patch of ground at the smallest resolution, with 64-square-meter and 128-meter also available.

articles.title: 1Password will let you hand your data security over to your preferred AI agent - Engadget
articles.descEn: If you're willing to let AI book or buy things on your behalf, 1Password just made that easier.
articles.titleEn: 1Password will let you hand your data security over to your preferred AI agent - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: That's why 1Password came up with a login system that ensures the models can't see them.
After introducing Claude integration in July, 1Password just launched a platform for other major AI companies including Muse from Meta , OpenAI's Dots and SpaceXAI Grok Bot.
1Password then notifies you about which agent needs access and why, and fills in the required information (not the agent) if you approve.

articles.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
articles.descEn: Security researchers at Symantec have found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models on the web and uses them to attack servers, steal databases, and install cryptominers on its own. It runs up to 100,000 steps without human input. The owner of the hijacked model gets stuck with the bill.
articles.titleEn: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
summaryLinesEn: Ad A final directive puts the agent into what its operators call "Skynet mode," authorizing up to 100,000 steps in a row.

Instead of manipulating a public chatbot, the operators built AI into the core of an offensive tool and actively searched for models to power it, which Symantec calls "a shift in how attackers are using AI."
Malicious intent isn't even required, because these models have no sense of right or wrong.

articles.title: AI’s hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
articles.descEn: Ask most executives to picture the cost of AI and they’ll likely see GPUs—racks of accelerators with gigawatts of power—and a waitlist for silicon. But that picture leaves something out: Data storage costs. What happens to data after a model responds? Much of the back-end data that’s generated—from billions of daily prompts, images, and videos—needs…
articles.titleEn: AI’s hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
summaryLinesEn: McKinsey projects AI inference demand will grow at a 35% CAGR through 2030, versus 22% for training, making up more than 40% of total data center demand by the end of the decade.
Information that once moved into an archive and rarely surfaced can now become an input to future AI workloads.

A recent WD-sponsored IDC global white paper that surveyed 763 IT and business decision makers found that nearly 95% of respondents reported an increase in data volume due to generative AI over the past 12 months, with roughly 61% reporting growth of 25% or more.

articles.title: 1Password lets AI agents use your passwords without seeing them
articles.descEn: 1Password is introducing a new feature that allows AI agents to sign into your accounts without actually seeing or handling your passwords.
articles.titleEn: 1Password lets AI agents use your passwords without seeing them
summaryLinesEn: A critical PHP vulnerability may take websites down today Airbnb bans making guests do dishes and take out the trash

The aptly named 1Password for Agents doesn’t give bots free reign to access all of your connected accounts — you’ll still need to grant approval for sign-in requests — but should make it less cumbersome to use Agents for tasks that require them to log into various services.

1Password says more partners are working to bring support to 1Password for Agents, including Browserbase, Browser Use, Dana, Instinct, Kernel, Perplexity, Ramp, Tomo, and Wajo, with “additional integrations to come.”

articles.title: Bill Gates thinks AI could make us live like the Amish
articles.descEn: The Microsoft cofounder isn’t an AI doomer, but he says it’s still “the most dangerous weapon of all time.”
articles.titleEn: Bill Gates thinks AI could make us live like the Amish
summaryLinesEn: The industry is actually speaking up about that quite a bit, but the awareness or even the willingness to believe these things about, “This time is different,” once you get outside the industry, it’s very, very low.

In his piece, Gates ratcheted up his rhetoric around AI safety, writing that “even under the best circumstances, the transition to this new AI era will be one of the most turbulent times in human history.”

When you say cyberattacks, is it the things like the Hugging Face breach and the other cybersecurity incidents we’ve seen out of the labs that have made you feel that thresholds have been crossed, and you need to speak up more about the controls that are needed?

localization.title: 누군가 오래된 게임과 AI를 이용해 스위치 2를 해킹함
summaryLines: 추가 정보 · 역설계 게임 · 비디오 게임 분해, 재구성, VR, 웹 및 3D 포트에 대한 모든 뉴스 Airbnb는 게스트에게 설거지를 하고 쓰레기를 버리는 것을 금지함 · PHP: 오늘날 인터넷 전체 사이트를 폐쇄하는 세 글자 Anthropic이 새로운 AI 에이전트인 Claude Duet과 함께 Muse에 도전함
이 익스플로잇을 위해서는 사용자가 게임을 프로그래밍하고 플레이할 수 있는 SmileBASIC 4 게임이 필요합니다(다른 모더는 타이틀이 "엄격히 필요하지 않다"고 주장하지만)
이 탈옥은 대부분의 사람들에게 여전히 매우 복잡해 보이며, 그 전체 영향은 아직 명확하지 않음 · Switch 2 해킹 하위 레딧의 사용자는 그것이 실제로 얼마나 큰 거래인지 토론하고 있음

articles.title: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing diseases
articles.descEn: In new research, Microsoft’s AI tool diagnosed medical cases up to four times more accurately than human physicians.
articles.titleEn: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing diseases
summaryLinesEn: The company claims to have developed an AI-powered tool it says can diagnose conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
The AI system also tended to reach its diagnoses at a lower estimated cost than human counterparts.

On cases taken from hundreds of reports published in The New England Journal of Medicine , Microsoft’s system achieved a diagnostic accuracy of around 83 percent, compared with roughly 36 percent for generalist physicians using references and 22 percent for those working without them.

summaryLines: 이 회사는 인간 의사보다 최대 4배 더 정확하게 상태를 진단할 수 있는 AI 기반 도구를 개발했다고 주장함

articles.title: Google's Agent Compute Engine gives every Gemini agent its own hardware-isolated micro virtual machine
articles.descEn: With Agent Compute Engine, Google is introducing a runtime environment designed specifically for AI agents, while also expanding the governance capabilities that enable companies to manage agents in cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
articles.titleEn: Google's Agent Compute Engine gives every Gemini agent its own hardware-isolated micro virtual machine
summaryLinesEn: When an agent idles, its VM pauses automatically and frees up the machine for others.
VMs are a pretty huge cost factor when providing agentic systems, so Google is going after efficiency here.
Google announced Agent Compute Engine, a service that gives each AI agent its own isolated virtual machine.

articles.title: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
articles.descEn: The next competitive advantage in enterprise AI has less to do with which model you choose than with what you build around it. That’s an important shift. For the past several years, much of the AI conversation has centered on model capability: bigger models, better reasoning, larger context windows, higher benchmark scores. Those advances have…
articles.titleEn: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
summaryLinesEn: For technical executives, that changes where AI investment should go—and what they should demand from the architecture supporting it.
It becomes an investment decision: where to spend on compute, where to optimize, and where additional model capability simply isn't worth the cost.
An internal knowledge application and a high-volume customer service platform may use the same foundation model but require very different serving architectures.

summaryLinesEn: The companies plan to share further insights into adoption, use cases and measurable outcomes as the rollout progresses.
Uber announced the company-wide rollout of ChatGPT Work , an agent that helps employees take on a wide range of tasks within ChatGPT Enterprise, starting today.
Uber will benefit from models like GPT‑6.1 Sol ⁠ which will be deployed as the default capability within ChatGPT Work, balancing frontier performance and cost efficiency.

articles.title: Not All Forests Are Equal: Mapping the World’s Forests
articles.descEn: Explore Forest Typology (ForTy) 2020: a global 10-meter map categorizing Earth's land into six distinct forest and land-use types, plus an annual time series.
articles.titleEn: Not All Forests Are Equal: Mapping the World’s Forests
summaryLinesEn: To teach our model the difference, we built a large-scale collection of forest-type examples with about 1.7 million labeled locations drawn from expert surveys, national and regional datasets, and targeted reviews of places where the model struggled.

We hope governments, companies, conservation groups and scientists will use them to help build deforestation-free supply chains, direct forest finance where it’s needed, and protect the natural forests that matter most.

Today, Google DeepMind and Google Research, together with the World Resources Institute (WRI) and the International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA), are releasing Forest Typology (ForTy) 2020 , a global map that categorizes every 10-by-10-meter patch of land on Earth into six distinct forest and land-use types, a key baseline for the EU's deforestation regulation.

localization.title: 모든 숲이 같지는 않음 · 세계 숲 지도 작성
summaryLines: 모델의 차이점을 가르치기 위해 전문가 설문 조사, 국가 및 지역 데이터 세트, 모델이 어려움을 겪는 장소에 대한 대상 검토를 통해 얻은 약 170만 개의 라벨이 지정된 위치를 포함하는 대규모 숲 유형 사례 컬렉션을 구축함
우리는 정부, 기업, 환경 보호 단체 및 과학자들이 이를 사용하여 삼림 벌채 없는 공급망을 구축하고, 필요한 곳에 산림 금융을 직접 제공하고, 가장 중요한 자연림을 보호하는 데 도움을 주기를 바람
오늘 Google DeepMind 및 Google Research는 WRI(세계 자원 연구소) 및 IIASA(국제 응용 시스템 분석 연구소)와 함께 지구상의 모든 10x10미터 토지를 6가지 산림 및 토지 이용 유형으로 분류하는 글로벌 지도인 산림 유형학(ForTy) 2020을 출시함 · 이는 EU 삼림 벌채 규제의 핵심 기준임

articles.title: The Future of AI Pre-Charting Is More Than a Chart Summary | Abridge
articles.descEn: See how Abridge’s Pre-Visit Summary determines what matters from the patient record, surfacing relevant information without overloading clinicians.
articles.titleEn: The Future of AI Pre-Charting Is More Than a Chart Summary | Abridge
summaryLinesEn: Proctor values about the “telephoto lens” is how Abridge selects the right information and orders it appropriately: Catch up: A short summary of the patient's recent care, tailored to specialty.

In an upcoming release, clinicians using Abridge will be able to precisely tailor their own pre-visit summary, including what information is prioritized, the timeframe considered, and how it is organized.
Seeing how clinicians actually prepare for visits helps Abridge understand what they look for in the chart, what slows them down, and which information helps them get oriented.

articles.title: Uber uses OpenAI to help people earn smarter and book faster
articles.descEn: Uber uses OpenAI to power AI assistants and voice features that help drivers earn smarter and riders book faster across a global real-time marketplace.
articles.titleEn: Uber uses OpenAI to help people earn smarter and book faster
summaryLinesEn: Uber operates at massive scale: 40 million trips per day, 10 million drivers and couriers across 15,000 cities in over 70 countries.

While Uber Assistant was initially expected to help newer drivers most, experienced drivers also returned repeatedly to ask follow-up questions and optimize their time on the platform—validating the product as a long-term utility, not just an onboarding tool.

Uber found that using AI to summarize and easily communicate Uber’s real-world data can accelerate ramp-up by helping drivers learn workflows and marketplace dynamics much faster than through trial and error alone.

articles.title: VfL Wolfsburg turns ChatGPT into a club-wide capability
articles.descEn: By focusing on people, not pilots, the Bundesliga club is scaling efficiency, creativity, and knowledge—without losing its football identity.
articles.titleEn: VfL Wolfsburg turns ChatGPT into a club-wide capability
summaryLinesEn: With proven use cases, trained teams, and growing internal momentum, VfL Wolfsburg is now moving from targeted adoption to organization-wide capability.
Adoption accelerated when Wolfsburg stopped talking about abstract AI tools and started building custom GPTs around real workflows.

Repetitive drafting, translation, reporting, and documentation slowed teams down Critical knowledge sat with a few specialists, creating bottlenecks External agencies handled routine work, but at high cost and without building internal capability These challenges highlighted a core tension: the club needed to increase impact and consistency—without increasing headcount.

summaryLines: 검증된 사용 사례, 훈련된 팀, 증가하는 내부 추진력을 통해 VfL Wolfsburg는 이제 목표 채택에서 조직 전체 기능으로 전환하고 있음
볼프스부르크가 추상적인 AI 도구에 대한 언급을 중단하고 실제 워크플로를 중심으로 맞춤형 GPT를 구축하기 시작하면서 채택이 가속화됨
반복적인 초안 작성, 번역, 보고 및 문서화로 인해 팀 작업 속도가 느려졌음 · 중요한 지식이 소수의 전문가와 공유되어 병목 현상이 발생함 · 외부 에이전시가 일상적인 작업을 처리했지만 비용이 많이 들고 내부 역량을 구축하지 못함 · 이러한 과제는 클럽이 인원수를 늘리지 않고도 영향력과 일관성을 높여야 한다는 핵심 긴장감을 드러냈음

articles.title: NVIDIA Open Models Power a New Wave of European Public Sector Projects
articles.descEn: Across Europe, open models help governments provide essential public services while keeping sensitive data on organizations’ own infrastructure.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Open Models Power a New Wave of European Public Sector Projects
summaryLinesEn: That includes Nemotron-Personas-Germany, an open dataset of 1 million records, each with six synthetic personas, grounded in the 2022 census across all 16 federal states and 400 districts.

The planned offering combines four components: NVIDIA accelerated computing and NVIDIA Nemotron open models; Red Hat OpenShift AI for deploying and managing AI workloads; deepset’s Haystack AI agent orchestration; and infrastructure operated by secunet in German data centers.
To support local development, the Sovereign Open Source Foundation Models research initiative (Soofi) is developing a family of AI models for German industry and the public sector.

지역 개발을 지원하기 위해 Sovereign Open Source Foundation 모델 연구 이니셔티브(Soofi)는 독일 산업 및 공공 부문을 위한 AI 모델 제품군을 개발하고 있음

articles.title: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction
articles.descEn: NVIDIA Earth-2 gives developers and researchers a family of open AI models and tools they can customize with their own data.
articles.titleEn: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction
summaryLinesEn: A global forecast can show a storm taking shape, but decisions about solar farms, shipping routes or insured property depend on what happens locally.

Organizations building on Earth-2 capabilities include: AXA is using NVIDIA Earth-2’s FourCastNet 3 to study regional cyclone risk beyond the historical record across more than 1,000 simulated seasons, generating insights that can inform risk assessments and help customers target prevention efforts.
Running on NVIDIA computing, these technologies support global weather prediction, detailed regional forecasts and environmental research.

articles.title: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations
articles.descEn: European retailers are using open models and physical intelligence across use cases — from a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% to to a fulfillment center where collaboration of different robotic fleets is simulated inside a digital twin.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations
summaryLinesEn: Omi runs TRELLIS 3D asset generation on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, speeding up inference by 10x and reducing pipeline latency by 4x.
Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open and frontier models to advance agentic commerce, digital product discovery and retail R&D.

Beyond Sidekick, NVIDIA CCluster vLLM inference optimization software helped Shopify achieve 4.5x faster performance and up to 12x lower inference cost across five additional use cases: catalog enrichment, merchant assistant, e-commerce shopping simulation, product taxonomy classification, and merchant and buyer recommendations.

유럽 전역의 소매 선두업체와 기술 기업은 NVIDIA가 가속화하는 개방형 및 개척자 모델을 사용하여 에이전트 상거래, 디지털 제품 검색 및 소매 R&D를 발전시키고 있음

유럽 전역의 소매 선두업체와 기술 기업은 NVIDIA가 가속화하는 개방형 및 개척자 모델을 사용하여 에이전트 상거래, 디지털 제품 검색 및 소매 R&D를 발전시키고 있음
Sidekick 외에도 NVIDIA CCluster vLLM 추론 최적화 소프트웨어는 Shopify가 카탈로그 강화, 판매자 지원, 전자상거래 쇼핑 시뮬레이션, 제품 분류 체계 분류, 판매자 및 구매자 추천 등 5가지 추가 사용 사례에서 4.5배 더 빠른 성능과 최대 12배 더 낮은 추론 비용을 달성하는 데 도움이 됨

articles.descEn: Companies around the world are using the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run AI factories as one system and unlock infrastructure development.
articles.titleEn: How Companies Are Using NVIDIA DSX to Break the Power Bottleneck
summaryLinesEn: More than $300 billion in equipment is backlogged, and over 200 gigawatts of projects are waiting in U.S. interconnection queues.
Learn more from NVIDIA and energy leaders who are accelerating power-flexible AI factories to strengthen the grid at GTC Berlin.
The grid, the facility and the compute inside have long been designed independently from one another, creating the conditions for delays, risk and stranded capacity.

articles.title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
articles.descEn: New tools joining NVIDIA Cosmos are helping accelerate data pipelines, train, evaluate and optimize world models more efficiently, and improve accuracy at lower cost.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
summaryLinesEn: To develop a world model specialized for egocentric manipulation, robotics research lab MicroAGI post-trained Cosmos 3 on videos of humans manipulating objects and distilled its 32-billion-parameter reasoner down to an 8-billion-parameter Nano model with no loss in accuracy.

Developers can deploy core Cosmos models using updated NVIDIA Cosmos 3 NIM microservices, which deliver up to 2x faster inference with no quality loss in validated configurations, while continuous video analysis enables sub-second alerts.

To help developers rapidly build world models , which help physical AI systems understand and simulate the real world, NVIDIA has expanded the Cosmos platform with new training tools, simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints.

localization.title: NVIDIA Cosmos, 월드 모델을 훈련, 평가 및 배포하기 위한 새로운 도구 공개
summaryLines: 자기중심적 조작에 특화된 세계 모델을 개발하기 위해 로봇공학 연구소 MicroAGI는 인간이 물체를 조작하는 비디오에서 Cosmos 3를 사후 훈련하고 정확도 손실 없이 320억 매개변수 추론기를 80억 매개변수 Nano 모델로 정제함
개발자는 업데이트된 NVIDIA Cosmos 3 NIM 마이크로서비스를 사용하여 핵심 Cosmos 모델을 배포할 수 있음 · 이는 검증된 구성에서 품질 손실 없이 최대 2배 더 빠른 추론을 제공하는 동시에 지속적인 비디오 분석을 통해 1초 미만의 경고가 가능함
개발자가 실제 AI 시스템이 실제 세계를 이해하고 시뮬레이션하는 데 도움이 되는 세계 모델을 신속하게 구축할 수 있도록 NVIDIA는 새로운 교육 도구, 시뮬레이션 체크포인트 및 Cosmos Data Factory 청사진을 통해 Cosmos 플랫폼을 확장함

articles.title: Leading European Financial Services Organizations Embrace Open Models to Build Proprietary Intelligence
articles.descEn: From transaction foundation models to sovereign cloud deployments, leading financial institutions across Europe are scaling intelligent technologies with advanced computing.
articles.titleEn: Leading European Financial Services Organizations Embrace Open Models to Build Proprietary Intelligence
summaryLinesEn: Using the NVIDIA cuDF toolkit and Dynamo-Triton software on NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs , Revolut is scaling PRAGMA in production, servicing an initial 80 million customers and engineered to scale 3x.

At GTC Berlin, banks, payment companies and financial data providers are showing what production-scale intelligence looks like — built on NVIDIA accelerated computing, powered by open weight models and running on their own infrastructure.

LSEG is working with NVIDIA to help financial institutions analyze large volumes of historical tick data up to 10x faster with the Polars GPU engine , accelerated by NVIDIA cuDF on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs.

localization.title: 유럽의 선도적인 금융 서비스 조직은 독점 인텔리전스 구축을 위해 개방형 모델을 채택함
summaryLines: Revolut는 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPU의 NVIDIA cuDF 툴킷과 Dynamo-Triton 소프트웨어를 사용하여 프로덕션에서 PRAGMA를 확장하고 초기 8천만 고객에게 서비스를 제공하며 3배 확장되도록 설계함
GTC 베를린에서 은행, 결제 회사, 금융 데이터 제공업체는 NVIDIA 가속 컴퓨팅을 기반으로 구축되고 개방형 모델로 구동되며 자체 인프라에서 실행되는 생산 규모 인텔리전스가 어떤 모습인지 보여줌
LSEG는 NVIDIA와 협력하여 금융 기관이 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU의 NVIDIA cuDF로 가속화된 Polars GPU 엔진을 사용하여 대량의 과거 틱 데이터를 최대 10배 더 빠르게 분석할 수 있도록 지원하고 있음

articles.titleEn: Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models
summaryLinesEn: Time-series forecasting benefits in a similar way: complementary models offer different views of what comes next, and an ensemble merges those views into one forecast.
The repository also includes expanded recipes that add IBM Research checkpoints.
Use historical forecast windows that reflect the data available at each forecast origin, the horizon you need, and the series you expect to serve.

articles.title: Arm welcomes favorable jury verdict in Qualcomm litigation
articles.descEn: The U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware rules in Arm’s favor, rejecting Qualcomm’s attempt to seek billions of dollars for alleged contract breaches.
articles.titleEn: Arm welcomes favorable jury verdict in Qualcomm litigation
summaryLinesEn: Arm really is everywhere 👀 From Neoverse to the AGI CPU, the Open Compute Project Global Summit was a reminder of how we're showing up across our partner ecosystem.
We introduced DSX POD at NVIDIA GTC Berlin: AI factories integrated and tested before delivery, enabling deployment at prepared sites in as little as 14 days.

Take a closer look: Agentic AI is redefining what CPUs need to deliver. @modal's early benchmarks show @NVIDIA Vera, built on Arm, delivering up to 2x the throughput of comparable x86 systems under heavy concurrency.

articles.title: The five AI value models driving business reinvention
articles.descEn: Five AI value models show how leaders can sequence AI from workforce fluency to process reinvention and build durable business advantage.
articles.titleEn: The five AI value models driving business reinvention
summaryLinesEn: Qualified intent, and number of iterations before user commitment Conversion quality, including retention, upsell, and lifetime value Trust signals such as return behavior, repeat engagement, and referral Activation of dedicated data connectors or apps related to your business Treating AI-native distribution like a legacy demand funnel and optimizing for volume at the expense of relevance and durable trust.
Over time, it changes the operating model: teams shift from producing first drafts themselves to directing, reviewing, and integrating high-quality outputs generated in real-time.

The value comes from expanding what the team can examine, test, or produce in an environment that enables every insight to be investigated with action plans and ROI potential instead of prioritizing upstream on intuition alone.

articles.title: Increasing accuracy of pediatric visit notes
articles.descEn: Summer Health reimagines pediatric doctor’s visits with OpenAI.
articles.titleEn: Increasing accuracy of pediatric visit notes
summaryLinesEn: After a pediatrician writes down their observations during the visit, an LLM could summarize this text into clear, jargon-free notes that could be easily shared.
Summer Health quickly built and launched their new medical visit notes feature, which uses GPT‑4 to automatically generate visit notes from a doctor’s detailed written observations.
Pediatrician efficiency: Doctors have reported a significant reduction in the time taken for note-taking and administrative tasks by 5x, from 10 minutes per visit note to 2 minutes.

articles.titleEn: Reimagining the email experience with AI
summaryLinesEn: This works out to around 1 trillion human hours a year spent on email.
The shift to online work has roughly 1 billion professionals spending close to 3 hours managing email each day ⁠ (opens in a new window) .

At any company, a large portion of the workforce (Superhuman estimates between 30–50%, across roles like finance, sales, and support) spend their days in and out of email, struggling with overflowing inboxes.

articles.title: Your users are already on Arm – is your software targeting it?
articles.descEn: Learn how Arm architecture shapes cloud, gaming, and on-device AI workloads—and how to test, optimize, and scale your software for Arm.
articles.titleEn: Your users are already on Arm – is your software targeting it?
summaryLinesEn: With 99% of smartphones running on Arm, around 50% of Arm-based compute shipped to leading hyperscalers, and more than 350 billion Arm-based chips shipped to date, the Arm architecture already powers many of the platforms developers build for every day.
Once running, benchmarking tools such as Arm Performix can help provide insights into hotspots, memory usage, and CPU efficiency to guide optimization.
That means you can continue building through the operating systems, containers, libraries, and cloud services already in your workflow.

localization.title: 귀하의 사용자는 이미 Arm을 사용하고 있음 · 소프트웨어가 이를 목표로 삼고 있습니까
summaryLines: 99%의 스마트폰이 Arm에서 실행되고, Arm 기반 컴퓨팅의 약 50%가 주요 하이퍼스케일러에 배송되었으며, 현재까지 3,500억 개 이상의 Arm 기반 칩이 배송된 가운데 Arm 아키텍처는 이미 개발자가 매일 구축하는 많은 플랫폼을 지원하고 있음
일단 실행되면 Arm Performix와 같은 벤치마킹 도구는 핫스팟, 메모리 사용량 및 CPU 효율성에 대한 통찰력을 제공하여 최적화를 안내하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음
즉, 이미 워크플로에 있는 운영 체제, 컨테이너, 라이브러리 및 클라우드 서비스를 통해 계속해서 구축할 수 있음

articles.title: Men Are Experiencing More Job Growth Than Women in AI-Exposed Occupations
articles.descEn: Men's employment grew faster than women's in occupations most exposed to AI, a gap driven largely by workers without a bachelor's degree.
articles.titleEn: Men Are Experiencing More Job Growth Than Women in AI-Exposed Occupations
summaryLinesEn: From 2017-19 to 2023-26, men saw substantially more job growth than women in occupations with higher AI exposure.

Because men’s employment grew steadily with each additional point of AI exposure while women’s barely changed, the gender gap in employment growth widened step by step from the least to the most exposed occupations.
But there are early signs of a gender gap: Employment growth has been slower for women than for men in occupations with more exposure to AI.

summaryLines: 2017-19년부터 2023-26년까지 남성은 AI 노출이 더 높은 직업에서 여성보다 훨씬 더 많은 일자리 증가를 보였음
남성의 고용은 AI 노출 지점이 추가될 때마다 꾸준히 증가한 반면 여성의 고용은 거의 변하지 않았기 때문에 고용 증가의 성별 격차는 노출이 가장 적은 직종에서 가장 많이 노출된 직종으로 단계적으로 확대됨
그러나 성별 격차의 초기 징후가 있음 · AI에 더 많이 노출되는 직종에서는 남성보다 여성의 고용 증가가 더 느렸음

articles.title: Inside JetBrains—the company reshaping how the world writes code
articles.descEn: JetBrains is integrating GPT-5 across its coding tools, helping millions of developers design, reason, and build software faster.
articles.titleEn: Inside JetBrains—the company reshaping how the world writes code

articles.title: Putting AI to work at Upwork
articles.descEn: Upwork puts AI to work, uniting team members, operations and product development
articles.titleEn: Putting AI to work at Upwork
summaryLinesEn: Upwork improves the customer experience with new features built on the latest OpenAI models Upwork's internal AI incubator, Upwork Labs, began harnessing AI to tackle key customer challenges, starting with the difficulty of creating effective job posts for complex projects.

In response, Upwork launched a number of internal process automations for fraud built on OpenAI’s models, including ones that identify low-quality and scam job posts, which helped improve the quality of the Upwork marketplace and the experience for freelancers.

Building on this success, Upwork introduced additional unique customer experiences leveraging OpenAI, augmented by Upwork’s extensive marketplace data set: Upwork Chat Pro: A general-purpose work app powered by GPT‑4o that is embedded in the Upwork experience, offering tailored interactions that help freelancers tackle challenging and repetitive tasks faster, boost productivity, increase their earning potential, and improve work quality.

localization.title: Upwork에 AI 적용
summaryLines: Upwork는 최신 OpenAI 모델을 기반으로 구축된 새로운 기능으로 고객 경험을 개선함 · Upwork의 내부 AI 인큐베이터인 Upwork Labs는 AI를 활용하여 복잡한 프로젝트에 대한 효과적인 채용 게시물을 만드는 어려움부터 시작하여 주요 고객 문제를 해결하기 시작함
이에 대응하여 Upwork는 품질이 낮은 사기 채용 게시물을 식별하는 기능을 포함하여 OpenAI 모델을 기반으로 구축된 사기에 대한 다양한 내부 프로세스 자동화를 시작함 · 이는 Upwork 시장의 품질과 프리랜서의 경험을 향상시키는 데 도움이 됨

이러한 성공을 바탕으로 Upwork는 Upwork의 광범위한 마켓플레이스 데이터 세트로 강화된 OpenAI를 활용하는 독특한 고객 경험을 추가로 도입함 · Upwork Chat Pro: Upwork 경험에 내장된 GPT‑4o 기반 범용 업무 앱으로, 프리랜서가 까다롭고 반복적인 작업을 더 빠르게 처리하고, 생산성을 높이고, 수익 잠재력을 높이고, 작업 품질을 향상시키는 데 도움이 되는 맞춤형 상호 작용을 제공함

summaryLinesEn: In a separate comparison on those same multi-field tasks, validating each field and allowing retries increased success from 64% to 82%.
Even if an agent realizes it may be wrong, recovery is not guaranteed.
Success requires the stored value to exactly match the expected value.

summaryLinesEn: Weekly active usage quickly grew from 60% to 95%, helping embed AI into everyday work across teams.
Preply introduced ChatGPT Enterprise across its organization, running company-wide enablement sessions for more than 600 employees across New York, Kyiv, London and Barcelona.
“We decided to partner with OpenAI because it provides state-of-the-art models for us, which solve problems for our customers,” says Dmytro Voloshyn, Co-founder & CTO, Preply.

articles.descEn: Promega's top-down adoption of ChatGPT accelerates manufacturing, sales, and marketing
articles.titleEn: Promega's top-down adoption of ChatGPT accelerates manufacturing, sales, and marketing
summaryLinesEn: Promega's sales and marketing teams also sought to simplify their work, given the company’s vast product portfolio.
Promega’s journey with OpenAI began when Poncho Meisenheimer, VP of Research and Development, introduced Linton to ChatGPT.

Linton immediately recognized its potential to help employees manage the company’s thousands of products and over 60,000 accounts: “I could envision our team co-creating with ChatGPT, using it as a coach, expert, or an extra set of hands to complete projects more efficiently,” he said.

articles.titleEn: Four ways AI vendors should support the adoption process
summaryLinesEn: Best-in-class vendors will gather quantitative and qualitative data to showcase their platform’s value and level of adoption.

summaryLines: 업계 최고의 공급업체는 정량적 및 정성적 데이터를 수집하여 플랫폼의 가치와 채택 수준을 선보일 것임
파일럿 단계는 문화적 수용을 위해 매우 중요함 · WRITER는 원활한 전환과 광범위한 조직 동의를 보장하기 위해 빠른 승리와 반복적인 피드백을 촉진함
그러나 당사의 2025년 기업 AI 채택 보고서에 따르면 설문 조사에 참여한 거의 모든 임원(94%)이 자신이 사용하는 AI 회사에 완전히 만족하지 않는다고 답했으며 공급업체가 제품 및 지원을 개선할 수 있는 다양한 방법을 지적함

articles.title: Agentic AI for marketing teams: Use cases from content generation to campaign orchestration
articles.descEn: Discover how agentic AI solves marketing's speed vs. custom fit dilemma. Six real use cases show automated campaign orchestration in action.
articles.titleEn: Agentic AI for marketing teams: Use cases from content generation to campaign orchestration
summaryLinesEn: Agentic AI is the project manager and the team: You give it a strategic goal (e.g., “launch a campaign for our new feature”), and it both orchestrates the entire process AND executes the work — researching competitors, drafting multiple content assets, cross-referencing brand guidelines, and preparing everything for launch.
Meanwhile, your team just launched their third campaign of the week — complete with personalized email sequences, industry-specific landing pages, and sales enablement materials.

And while AI tools promise to solve these challenges, most marketing teams are drowning in a sea of disconnected point solutions, endless prompting sessions, and the constant fear of losing their brand integrity in the rush to keep up.As a result, marketing leaders get caught in an impossible bind — you need both speed AND custom fit.

그 사이에 귀하의 팀은 개인화된 이메일 시퀀스, 업계별 랜딩 페이지 및 판매 지원 자료가 포함된 이번 주의 세 번째 캠페인을 시작함
AI 도구가 이러한 과제를 해결할 것을 약속하지만 대부분의 마케팅 팀은 연결이 끊긴 포인트 솔루션, 끝없는 프롬프트 세션, 서두르다가 브랜드 무결성을 잃을지 모른다는 끊임없는 두려움에 빠져 있음 · 결과적으로 마케팅 리더는 속도와 맞춤 맞춤이 모두 필요한 불가능한 곤경에 빠지게 됨

articles.title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
summaryLinesEn: Compare each pixel's vector across years, no model training required, and the 2017 to 2020 pair lights up where the mining was spreading to the southeast.
If you wanted to reproduce it, pre-training OlmoEarth v1.3 Base would cost roughly $2,720 of rented H100 time for the final run.

Alongside OlmoEarth v1.3, we’re sharing precomputed, annual embeddings for the whole planet (10m, 64- and 128-dimensions), plus a new browser-based tool to explore and customize maps based on those embeddings — the OlmoEarth Embeddings Explorer .

articles.title: How Rescale built an AI triage agent with Strands Agents and AI-DLC | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Rescale used the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) framework on AWS, with Strands Agents and Amazon Bedrock, to build an intelligent test-triage agent in weeks. Learn how AI-DLC structures AI-assisted development and how Rescale is scaling the practice across its engineering organization.
articles.titleEn: How Rescale built an AI triage agent with Strands Agents and AI-DLC | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: As Rescale’s platform grew, so did the operational overhead of keeping it running.
First, the team planned to host the agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, then moved it to Amazon EKS, where Rescale already runs its Argo Workflows CI/CD pipeline.
Hundreds of test cases run in the suite, and when failures appeared, every alert, bug report, and escalation needed to be classified, prioritized, and routed to the right team.

articles.title: Stop guessing auto scaling targets for TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Teams deploying custom text-to-speech models on Amazon SageMaker AI often guess at autoscaling thresholds, and a wrong guess either wastes GPU spend or breaches a latency SLO. This post deploys Kokoro-82M as a custom container and derives a measured autoscaling policy from two live-endpoint measurements, Q_max and T_total, instead of guesswork.
articles.titleEn: Stop guessing auto scaling targets for TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The deployed policy scales on ConcurrentRequestsPerModel , a native metric Amazon SageMaker AI publishes itself rather than one this project’s own container code has to emit.
The live command freezes auto scaling and pins capacity to one instance for the duration, restored automatically on exit, so the number it produces is a genuine per-instance ceiling.

A stopped or canceled qmax or ttotal run is the most common source of a reported mismatch, because it can leave auto scaling frozen on a single instance. uv run tts-bench thaw --endpoint speech-kokoro-82m restores the deployed policy before you proceed, since qmax and ttotal both assume the deployed state matches the config file exactly.

articles.title: Stream low-latency speech from AI agents using Kokoro TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Voice agents often wait for an agent's full response before starting speech synthesis, adding latency users feel directly. This post shows how to stream each sentence to a Kokoro-82M text-to-speech model on Amazon SageMaker AI as the agent produces it, and how to get that audio back to a browser over Server-Sent Events or a unified binary transport.
articles.titleEn: Stream low-latency speech from AI agents using Kokoro TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Kokoro-82M holds only 82 million parameters, small enough to run cheaply on a single mid-tier GPU instance.
That keeps both latency and inference cost low for a voice agent handling real traffic.
We stream each sentence to a hosted Kokoro-82M text-to-speech (TTS) model on Amazon SageMaker AI as soon as an agent produces it, so synthesis begins on sentence one instead of the finished response.
