articles.title: Deploy AI in a HIPAA-eligible environment with Amazon Quick | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Quick is a HIPAA-eligible service, but eligibility is not the same as compliance. This post explains who HIPAA applies to, how PHI flows through Amazon Quick, what the platform provides for regulated environments, and a step-by-step guide to deploying compliant AI agents in a healthcare environment.
articles.titleEn: Deploy AI in a HIPAA-eligible environment with Amazon Quick | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: From there, we cover what Amazon Quick provides for regulated environments and what it doesn’t, walk through a fictional health plan (AnyCompany) deployment, and distill the best practices and irreversible decisions you should make up front.
Amazon Quick is often introduced through its chat agents, but HIPAA eligibility applies to the entire workspace, not to a single feature, so a platform-level view matters for compliance.
Amazon Quick is HIPAA eligible, and we outline what that means in practice.

summaryLinesEn: So far, 1 million skills have been published and nearly 280 million installed.
A skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file that teaches an agent a specific task or domain, along with any scripts or reference material it needs.
More than 70 agent platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code, have integrated Agent Skills since we published the standard in December 2025.

articles.title: Write your own training loop — without managing GPUs — with Amazon SageMaker training session APIs | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker AI training session APIs let you write your own LLM training loop (SFT, RL, or custom objectives) in a Python script while the service runs the GPUs. This post introduces the programming model and three SDK clients, then walks through a GRPO loop on GSM8K and a reinforcement learning workload on competitive programming.
articles.titleEn: Write your own training loop — without managing GPUs — with Amazon SageMaker training session APIs | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Usage is billed per token processed, so you’re charged only for the compute your loop consumes.
The service handles runtime setup, distributed execution, gradient synchronization, fault recovery, tenant isolation, and the operations of running GPUs at scale.
Second, cost scales with your dataset and generation volume, not with wall-clock time or cluster size, which makes spend easier to forecast and experiments easier to compare.

articles.title: Announcing new ways to customize models with SageMaker AI, without managing GPUs | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization now includes training sessions, generally available today. You write and coordinate your own post-training loop (custom loss functions, reward signals, or multi-turn reinforcement learning) while SageMaker AI handles GPU allocation, distributed execution, fault recovery, and checkpoint storage.
articles.titleEn: Announcing new ways to customize models with SageMaker AI, without managing GPUs | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: You must choose the right technique, set up and manage GPU infrastructure, and, for agents, build environments for multi-turn reinforcement learning.
We launched Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization to solve these challenges, and today, we’re expanding it with the general availability launch of training sessions.
For example, an agent that books travel, triages support tickets, or runs a multi-step research task needs several rounds of interaction before you can judge whether it reached the right outcome.

articles.descEn: Learn how IskayPet, a leading pet care company in Iberia, built a multilingual corporate knowledge assistant on Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Bases. The assistant answers employee questions across retail, veterinary, onboarding, and procurement in four languages and three countries, with no RAG infrastructure to manage.
articles.titleEn: How IskayPet unified corporate knowledge with Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Bases | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: With more than 4,500 employees and 7 million customers, IskayPet runs operations that span retail, veterinary clinics, animal care, procurement, and people and onboarding.
IskayPet chose Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Bases for its managed RAG infrastructure, which removed the need to run vector stores, embeddings, or ingestion pipelines.
There was no reliable way to query corporate knowledge, and the problem grew with every country, area, or document added.

articles.title: Amazon Polly delivers a major upgrade to its Generative engine | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: The Amazon Polly Generative engine gets a major upgrade: more expressive, more accurate speech with low latency, plus 14 new voices across 9 locales and general availability of Hindi and Finnish. This drop-in upgrade requires no code changes and is now generally available in production.
articles.titleEn: Amazon Polly delivers a major upgrade to its Generative engine | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Your total was $1,284.50 and your confirmation code is K-7-Q-2-X-9.”

The Amazon Polly Generative engine now delivers more natural, expressive speech alongside low-latency streaming for real-time applications, Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) support for fine-grained control, and the operational reliability of a fully managed AWS service.

A larger catalog overall for Amazon Polly Generative engine – Totaling 57 generative voices across 11 languages and 25 locales. 14 new voices across 9 locales – US English (Kenneth, Nate), Australian English (Russell, Curtis), Indian English (Kiara, Arjun), German (Tina), US Spanish (Carlos), Brazilian Portuguese (Leo, Carolina), Korean (Hyunduk), Hindi (Kiara, Arjun) and Finnish (Suvi).

articles.title: The AI Bill is coming | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Databricks co-founder Patrick Wendell on why AI coding costs grow exponentially, and the four levers that cut unit costs by up to 90%.
articles.titleEn: The AI Bill is coming | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Catherine: You run Databricks' AI products, and you've also been the internal champion for AI adoption.
Unlimited tokens and hard spend caps both fail, and Databricks has moved to visibility plus progressive friction instead.

In this conversation, Catherine Brown talks with Patrick about what happened when Databricks went all in on AI coding agents: how costs initially spiraled with growing usage , what actually brought unit costs down by as much as 90%, and why every engineering organization needs a control layer between its developers and its models.

articles.title: The Fraud Analyst AI Coworker: Detecting Telecom Fraud in Real-Time on One Platform | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Telecom fraud moves at machine speed. Learn how Databricks Lakebase, Apps, and Genie unify real-time fraud detection with an AI coworker for fraud analysts.
articles.titleEn: The Fraud Analyst AI Coworker: Detecting Telecom Fraud in Real-Time on One Platform | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: According to the Communications Fraud Control Association's 2025 survey, telecom fraud losses have climbed to $41.82 billion 1 , and the broader fraud economy is growing fast: U.S. consumers alone reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% jump in a single year 2 .
It’s revenue leakage, regulatory exposure, accelerated churn, and an operations tax that rarely shows up cleanly in a loss report.

Breaches are getting more expensive too; the global average cost of a data breach hit a record $4.88 million in 2024 3 ; Every dollar of fraud costs a carrier roughly 3.4x once you count chargebacks, replacement costs, and the operational overhead of investigating it.

summaryLines: 통신 사기 통제 협회(Communications Fraud Control Association)의 2025년 조사에 따르면, 통신 사기 손실은 418억 2천만 달러로 증가했으며1 , 광범위한 사기 경제는 빠르게 성장하고 있음 · 미국 소비자만 해도 2024년에 사기로 인해 125억 달러 이상 손실을 입었다고 보고했는데, 이는 1년 만에 25% 증가한 수치임

articles.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
articles.descEn: Fast, focused, low-cost decisions for any application.
articles.titleEn: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
summaryLinesEn: Built with GPT‑6 Luna , the Decisions API focuses Luna’s intelligence on questions with bounded answers, helping applications and agents make near real-time decisions from text, images, and structured inputs up to 10x faster than GPT‑6 Luna through the Responses API.

Decisions API supports three answer types: Estimate the probability that a condition is true, such as whether a product has visible damage. probability : an estimate from 0 to 1 that the condition is true.
Decisions API costs $0.10 per million input tokens.

articles.title: The new economics of AI cost management | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Kevin Stumpf on cost attribution, smart routing, spend guardrails and growing AI spend responsibly for enterprise AI teams.
articles.titleEn: The new economics of AI cost management | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: A lot of people were reluctant to start using AI, so showing that the leaders everyone looked up to were heavy AI users gave others a reason to follow.

AI observability that once measured success by token volume is starting to measure success by return on investment, and the enterprises that figure out cost management first are the ones that will be able to scale AI without their spend outrunning their revenue.

We sat down with Kevin Stumpf, a Senior Staff Engineer at Databricks and Technical Lead for Unity Gateway, to talk through how teams should actually put that discipline into practice: not treating AI cost as a line item to minimize, but as a system to manage.

localization.title: AI 비용 관리의 새로운 경제학 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: 많은 사람들이 AI 사용을 꺼려했기 때문에 모두가 존경하는 리더가 AI를 많이 사용하는 사람이라는 사실을 보여 다른 사람들도 따라야 할 이유를 제공함
한때 토큰 양으로 성공을 측정했던 AI 관찰 가능성은 투자 수익으로 성공을 측정하기 시작했으며, 비용 관리를 먼저 파악하는 기업은 비용을 지출하지 않고도 수익을 초과하지 않고 AI를 확장할 수 있는 기업임
우리는 Databricks의 선임 엔지니어이자 Unity Gateway의 기술 리드인 Kevin Stumpf와 함께 AI 비용을 최소화해야 하는 항목이 아니라 관리해야 하는 시스템으로 처리하는 원칙을 팀이 실제로 어떻게 실행해야 하는지에 대해 이야기함

articles.title: Boosting the customer retail experience with GPT-4o mini
articles.descEn: Zalando boosts the customer experience with its Assistant, powered by GPT-4o mini
articles.titleEn: Boosting the customer retail experience with GPT-4o mini
summaryLinesEn: The combination of GPT‑4o mini and the improved evaluation process led to measurable outcomes that exceeded expectations in comparison to previous versions of the assistant: Improved engagement : Product clicks increased by 23% within the recommendation carousel, and wishlist additions rose by 41%, demonstrating stronger user interaction.

With GPT‑4o mini and a robust evaluation framework, and compared to the previous version, the latest iteration of the Assistant has delivered: Scaled availability to 25 markets featuring local languages The first iteration of the Zalando Assistant launched in 4 German and English-speaking markets in 2023.
Better cost efficiency : By transitioning from GPT‑3.5 to GPT‑4o mini, Zalando was able to scale its traffic 12x by deploying the Assistant to more markets, and without spending significantly more.

localization.title: GPT-4o mini로 고객 소매 경험 향상
summaryLines: GPT‑4o mini와 개선된 평가 프로세스의 결합으로 이전 버전의 어시스턴트에 비해 기대치를 뛰어넘는 측정 가능한 결과가 나왔음 · 참여도 향상 · 추천 캐러셀 내에서 제품 클릭이 23% 증가하고 위시리스트 추가가 41% 증가하여 더 강력한 사용자 상호 작용을 보여주었음
GPT‑4o mini 및 강력한 평가 프레임워크를 사용하고 이전 버전과 비교하여 최신 Assistant 반복은 다음을 제공함 · 현지 언어를 사용하는 25개 시장으로 가용성 확장 Zalando Assistant의 첫 번째 반복은 2023년 4개 독일어 및 영어권 시장에서 출시됨
비용 효율성 향상 · Zalando는 GPT‑3.5에서 GPT‑4o mini로 전환함으로써 더 많은 비용을 지출하지 않고도 더 많은 시장에 Assistant를 배포하여 트래픽을 12배 확장할 수 있었음

articles.title: Zenken boosts a lean sales team with ChatGPT Enterprise
articles.descEn: By rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise company-wide, Zenken has boosted sales performance, cut preparation time, and increased proposal success rates. AI-supported workflows are helping a lean team deliver more personalized, effective customer engagement.
articles.titleEn: Zenken boosts a lean sales team with ChatGPT Enterprise
summaryLinesEn: Before using ChatGPT Enterprise, the sales team had to spend large amounts of time on preparation work such as researching prospects, creating proposal materials, and writing sales emails.

Deciding to adopt ChatGPT Enterprise that meets twelve critical requirements Transforming sales activities with AI supported workflows Shifting from routine tasks to creative, high value work Zenken combines GPT‑5, custom GPTs, image generation, and the latest OpenAI models and tools to accelerate both of its core businesses: web marketing and the fast growing overseas human resources business.

More than 90% weekly active usage of ChatGPT Enterprise Average time savings of 30 to 50% across knowledge work tasks 5 to 15 additional hours per employee every month, reinvested in higher value work 50 million yen in annual outsourcing cost savings compared with the previous year Before adopting ChatGPT Enterprise, Zenken relied on manual processes for a wide range of knowledge tasks.

localization.title: Zenken은 ChatGPT Enterprise를 통해 효율적인 영업팀을 강화함
summaryLines: ChatGPT Enterprise를 사용하기 전에 영업팀은 잠재 고객 조사, 제안 자료 작성, 영업 이메일 작성 등 준비 작업에 많은 시간을 소비해야 함
12가지 주요 요구 사항을 충족하는 ChatGPT Enterprise 채택 결정 AI 지원 워크플로로 영업 활동 전환 일상적인 작업에서 창의적이고 가치 있는 작업으로 전환 Zenken은 GPT-5, 맞춤형 GPT, 이미지 생성, 최신 OpenAI 모델 및 도구를 결합하여 핵심 비즈니스인 웹 마케팅과 빠르게 성장하는 해외 인적 자원 사업을 가속화함
ChatGPT Enterprise를 매주 90% 이상 적극적으로 사용 지식 작업 작업 전체에서 평균 시간 30~50% 절약 매달 직원당 5~15시간 추가, 더 높은 가치의 작업에 재투자 전년 대비 연간 아웃소싱 비용 5,000만 엔 절감 ChatGPT Enterprise를 채택하기 전에 Zenken은 광범위한 지식 작업에 대해 수동 프로세스에 의존함

articles.title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
articles.descEn: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.
articles.titleEn: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
summaryLinesEn: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.

With ChatGPT, Ted accelerates time-consuming tasks like research and drafting, and he uses ChatGPT Work to gather and analyze volumes of data across pricing, sales, forecasts, schedules, and labor and to get recommendations on where each restaurant needs attention , reducing repricing time by 95% and shaving 4 hours off payroll runs.

Reduction in time required for pricing analysis, from 5 days to 1 to 2 hours Maximum annual cash flow that could be freed up with optimized labor workflow Ted Taylor entered the restaurant business after a 25-year career in the semiconductor industry.

articles.title: How Deutsche Telekom is rewiring telecommunications with AI
articles.descEn: How Deutsche Telekom is becoming an AI-native telco with OpenAI-transforming customer service, employee workflows, network operations, and the future of voice.
articles.titleEn: How Deutsche Telekom is rewiring telecommunications with AI
summaryLinesEn: Reimagining employee workflows, customer service, and network operations, for an AI-native future Deutsche Telekom ⁠ (opens in a new window) is one of the world's largest telecommunications companies, serving more than 300 million customers across Europe and the United States and employing more than 200,000 people across the group.
As generative AI capabilities accelerated, Deutsche Telekom saw an opportunity that went beyond productivity gains.

We sat down with Jonathan Abrahamson, Chief Product & Digital Officer at Deutsche Telekom, to discuss how the company is redesigning the operating model of the entire organization-from customer care and employee workflows to network operations and the future of voice communications.

localization.title: Deutsche Telekom이 AI를 통해 통신을 재배선하는 방법
summaryLines: AI 기반 미래를 위해 직원 워크플로우, 고객 서비스, 네트워크 운영 재구상 Deutsche Telekom ⁠(새 창에서 열림)은 유럽과 미국 전역에서 3억 명 이상의 고객에게 서비스를 제공하고 그룹 전체에서 20만 명 이상의 직원을 고용하고 있는 세계 최대의 통신 회사 중 하나임
생성 AI 기능이 가속화되면서 Deutsche Telekom은 생산성 향상 이상의 기회를 발견함
우리는 Deutsche Telekom의 최고 제품 및 디지털 책임자인 Jonathan Abrahamson과 함께 회사가 고객 관리 및 직원 워크플로부터 네트워크 운영 및 음성 통신의 미래에 이르기까지 전체 조직의 운영 모델을 어떻게 재설계하고 있는지 논의함

articles.title: Plex Coffee delivers fast, personal service with ChatGPT
articles.descEn: Learn how Plex Coffee uses ChatGPT Business to centralize knowledge, train staff faster, and preserve personal connections while expanding.
articles.titleEn: Plex Coffee delivers fast, personal service with ChatGPT
summaryLinesEn: Expansion research: As Plex grows, Cheng uses ChatGPT Business to evaluate new locations: “I use the deep research tools to make revenue potential estimations on customer volumes over time.”

Understanding demand shift: If there’s a particularly slow or strong day or week, “ChatGPT usually gives an amazing explanation, like how many students are leaving, or what events are happening that week.

But beyond pure efficiency, AI is creating space for the human side of hospitality to thrive—baristas spending time with guests, sharing good vibes, and keeping the café experience personal even as the company grows.

summaryLines: 확장 연구 · Plex가 성장함에 따라 Cheng은 ChatGPT Business를 사용하여 새로운 위치를 평가함 · "저는 심층적인 연구 도구를 사용하여 시간 경과에 따른 고객 수에 대한 수익 잠재력을 추정함"
수요 변화 이해 · 특히 느리거나 강한 날이나 주가 있는 경우, “ChatGPT는 일반적으로 얼마나 많은 학생이 학교를 떠나는지, 그 주에 어떤 행사가 일어나고 있는지와 같은 놀라운 설명을 제공함
그러나 AI는 순수한 효율성을 넘어서 환대의 인간적 측면이 번창할 수 있는 공간을 만들고 있음 · 즉, 바리스타가 손님과 시간을 보내고, 좋은 분위기를 공유하고, 회사가 성장하는 동안에도 카페 경험을 개인적인 것으로 유지하는 것임

articles.title: Databricks brings GPT-5.5 to enterprise agent workflows
articles.descEn: Databricks uses GPT-5.5 for enterprise agent workflows after the model set a new state of the art on the OfficeQA Pro benchmark.
articles.titleEn: Databricks brings GPT-5.5 to enterprise agent workflows
summaryLinesEn: In the agent-harness setting, GPT‑5.5 reduced errors by 46% compared to GPT‑5.4 and became the first model to surpass 50% accuracy on OfficeQA Pro.
GPT‑5.5 set a new state of the art on OfficeQA Pro, Databricks’ benchmark for complex enterprise agent tasks.
Databricks now makes GPT‑5.5 available through AI Unity Gateway, where customers use the model inside workflows built with AgentBricks and the Agent Supervisor API.

sourceContent.headline: Databricks brings GPT-5.5 to enterprise agent workflows
sourceContent.description: Databricks uses GPT-5.5 for enterprise agent workflows after the model set a new state of the art on the OfficeQA Pro benchmark.
paragraphs: In the agent-harness setting, GPT‑5.5 reduced errors by 46% compared to GPT‑5.4 and became the first model to surpass 50% accuracy on OfficeQA Pro.
GPT‑5.5 set a new state of the art on OfficeQA Pro, Databricks’ benchmark for complex enterprise agent tasks.
Databricks now makes GPT‑5.5 available through AI Unity Gateway, where customers use the model inside workflows built with AgentBricks and the Agent Supervisor API.

Databricks now makes GPT‑5.5 available through AI Unity Gateway, where customers use the model inside workflows built with AgentBricks and the Agent Supervisor API.

localization.title: Databricks는 엔터프라이즈 에이전트 워크플로에 GPT-5.5를 도입함
summaryLines: 에이전트 하네스 설정에서 GPT-5.5는 GPT-5.4에 비해 오류를 46% 줄였으며 OfficeQA Pro에서 정확도 50%를 넘은 최초의 모델이 됨
GPT‑5.5는 복잡한 엔터프라이즈 에이전트 작업에 대한 Databricks의 벤치마크인 OfficeQA Pro에 새로운 최첨단 기술을 설정함
Databricks는 이제 AI Unity Gateway를 통해 GPT‑5.5를 제공함 · 여기서 고객은 AgentBricks 및 Agent Supervisor API로 구축된 워크플로 내에서 모델을 사용할 수 있음

articles.title: How Localiza reorganized work around generative AI
articles.descEn: See how Localiza uses ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and 60+ specialized agents to reorganize work and build AI-native mobility experiences.
articles.titleEn: How Localiza reorganized work around generative AI
summaryLinesEn: But adoption did not stop there: analysts, managers, PMOs, lawyers, and other business specialists began building their own prototypes and automations to test hypotheses within their areas of expertise.
Localiza’s internal data confirms this shift: traffic originating from LLMs has been growing rapidly since 2024, with ChatGPT emerging as the main channel.

Pillar 2: customers describe their needs in natural language When generative AI arrived, Localiza took a view that defined everything that followed: this was more than another piece of software in the toolkit; it was a change in the way the company operates.

localization.title: Localiza가 생성 AI 관련 작업을 재구성한 방법
summaryLines: 그러나 채택은 여기서 끝나지 않았음 · 분석가, 관리자, PMO, 변호사 및 기타 비즈니스 전문가는 자신의 전문 분야 내에서 가설을 테스트하기 위해 자체 프로토타입과 자동화를 구축하기 시작함
Localiza의 내부 데이터는 이러한 변화를 확인시켜 줌 · LLM에서 발생하는 트래픽은 2024년부터 ChatGPT가 주요 채널로 떠오르면서 빠르게 증가하고 있음
원칙 2: 고객은 자신의 요구 사항을 자연어로 설명함 · 생성 AI가 출시되었을 때 Localiza는 이후의 모든 것을 정의하는 관점을 취함 · 이는 툴킷에 있는 또 다른 소프트웨어 이상의 것이었음 · 그것은 회사 운영 방식의 변화였음

articles.title: Singular Bank helps bankers move fast with ChatGPT and Codex
articles.descEn: Singular Bank built Singularity, an internal assistant using ChatGPT and Codex to help bankers save 60–90 minutes daily on meeting prep, portfolio analysis, and follow-up.
articles.titleEn: Singular Bank helps bankers move fast with ChatGPT and Codex
summaryLinesEn: Instead of spending meetings reviewing data, bankers can focus on advising clients and discussing next steps.
By reducing prep work and accelerating decision-making, Singular Bank gives bankers more time to advise clients and build relationships.

Singular Bank, a private bank based in Madrid, built Singularity—an internal assistant powered by ChatGPT and Codex—that helps bankers analyze portfolios in real time, prepare for meetings, and generate compliant follow-up communications.

localization.title: Singular Bank는 ChatGPT와 Codex를 통해 은행가가 빠르게 움직일 수 있도록 지원함
summaryLines: 은행가는 데이터를 검토하는 데 회의를 보내는 대신 고객에게 조언하고 다음 단계를 논의하는 데 집중할 수 있음
Singular Bank는 준비 작업을 줄이고 의사 결정을 가속화함으로써 은행가가 고객에게 조언하고 관계를 구축할 수 있는 더 많은 시간을 제공함
마드리드에 본사를 둔 민간 은행인 Singular Bank는 은행가가 실시간으로 포트폴리오를 분석하고, 회의를 준비하고, 규정을 준수하는 후속 커뮤니케이션을 생성하는 데 도움이 되는 ChatGPT 및 Codex를 기반으로 하는 내부 비서인 Singularity를 구축함

articles.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
articles.descEn: Claude formally proved security properties in the compiled code of 123 open-source libraries. Along the way, it found bugs that had eluded detection for years.
articles.titleEn: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
summaryLinesEn: Formal software verification could provide this guarantee, but it has historically required years of expert effort, making it impractical for most real-world projects.

Theorem , our collaborator on this project, is also offering to run the same pipeline for other open-source projects , and is publishing a Claude skill to help developers get started with verifying their own code.
As model capabilities continue to improve, we expect formal verification to become an essential part of secure software development.

localization.title: LLM은 훨씬 더 큰 규모로 공식적인 소프트웨어 검증을 가능하게 만들고 있음
summaryLines: 공식적인 소프트웨어 검증은 이러한 보장을 제공할 수 있지만 역사적으로 수년간의 전문가 노력이 필요했기 때문에 대부분의 실제 프로젝트에서는 실용적이지 않음
이 프로젝트의 공동 작업자인 Theorem은 다른 오픈 소스 프로젝트에도 동일한 파이프라인을 실행할 것을 제안하고 있으며 개발자가 자신의 코드 확인을 시작하는 데 도움이 되는 Claude 기술을 게시하고 있음
모델 기능이 지속적으로 향상됨에 따라 공식적인 검증이 보안 소프트웨어 개발의 필수적인 부분이 될 것으로 기대함

articles.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
articles.descEn: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.
articles.titleEn: Building advertising for the way people use AI
summaryLinesEn: Through images showing product inspiration, product usage, or the experiences they make possible, people can discover a new brand, understand what makes an offering distinctive, and decide what to buy.
A new visual ad format helps people explore products and services, with expanded measurement to help businesses understand ad impact.
According to DV Rockerbox, WeightWatchers’ attributed cost per acquisition on ChatGPT Ads was 15.3% lower than its blended paid-search benchmark.

localization.title: 사람들이 AI를 사용하는 방식에 맞춰 광고 구축
summaryLines: 제품에 대한 영감, 제품 사용법 또는 이를 통해 가능한 경험을 보여주는 이미지를 통해 사람들은 새로운 브랜드를 발견하고, 제품을 차별화시키는 요소가 무엇인지 이해하고, 무엇을 구매할지 결정할 수 있음
새로운 시각적 광고 형식은 기업이 광고 영향을 이해하는 데 도움이 되는 확장된 측정 기능을 통해 사람들이 제품과 서비스를 탐색하는 데 도움이 됨
DV Rockerbox에 따르면 ChatGPT 광고에서 WeightWatchers의 획득당 비용은 혼합 유료 검색 벤치마크보다 15.3% 낮았음

summaryLinesEn: This can speed up research, analysis, and coding tasks that benefit from parallel work, without requiring you to build your own orchestration.
Tool search ⁠ (opens in a new window) loads relevant tool definitions as needed, helping reduce token usage and cost while preserving the model’s cache.
Useful agents need a powerful harness that manages context, uses tools efficiently, and coordinates subagents.

하지만 특히 인상 깊었던 iOS 27의 추가 기능 중 하나는 바로 통화 컨텍스트(Call Context)라는 새로운 전화 기능임 · iOS 27의 통화 컨텍스트(Call Context) 기능은 회사와 통화 중일 때 주요 정보를 화면에 표시함 · 저는 전화 통화를 별로 좋아하지 않기 때문에 전화 앱을 사용하는 데 많은 시간을 소비하지 않음
올해 iOS 27을 통해 Apple은 새로운 전화 앱 기능으로 다시 한 번 깊은 인상을 받았음

articles.title: DeepSeek 10B Yuan Financing Nears Completion: Partners with Perfect World, SMIC PES Capital & Industrial Capitals, Doubles Raised Funds to Bet Big on Embodied Intelligence
articles.descEn: Leading Chinese game industry limited partners Perfect World and Century Huatong, alongside prominent semiconductor-focused investment institutions including Stony Creek Capital and SMIC Private Equity, have been newly added as key participants in this lineup. This expanded roster brings together top-tier gaming sector capital resources and specialized semiconductor industrial investment expertise, forming a more robust cross-industry investment ecosystem that integrates digital entertainment and core chip technology strengths to drive collaborative innovation across related high-growth tech sectors.
articles.titleEn: DeepSeek 10B Yuan Financing Nears Completion: Partners with Perfect World, SMIC PES Capital & Industrial Capitals, Doubles Raised Funds to Bet Big on Embodied Intelligence
summaryLinesEn: If the 100-billion-yuan scale of this round is added to the RMB 51 billion first-round financing finalized by Liang Wenfeng and core institutions at the end of June, DeepSeek has cumulatively absorbed more than RMB 1500 billion of capital in just over 100 days, setting a brand new record for capital throughput speed in the global artificial intelligence field .
In August this year, DeepSeek once launched a high-paying recruitment in the fields of game development and 3D rendering , which attracted widespread attention in the game industry.

sourceContent.description: Leading Chinese game industry limited partners Perfect World and Century Huatong, alongside prominent semiconductor-focused investment institutions including Stony Creek Capital and SMIC Private Equity, have been newly added as key participants in this lineup. This expanded roster brings together top-tier gaming sector capital resources and specialized semiconductor industrial investment expertise, forming a more robust cross-industry investment ecosystem that integrates digital entertainment and core chip technology strengths to drive collaborative innovation across related high-growth tech sectors.
paragraphs: If the 100-billion-yuan scale of this round is added to the RMB 51 billion first-round financing finalized by Liang Wenfeng and core institutions at the end of June, DeepSeek has cumulatively absorbed more than RMB 1500 billion of capital in just over 100 days, setting a brand new record for capital throughput speed in the global artificial intelligence field .
In August this year, DeepSeek once launched a high-paying recruitment in the fields of game development and 3D rendering , which attracted widespread attention in the game industry.

Sources familiar with the matter revealed that the transaction underwent drastic dynamic adjustments during the promotion process: the initial planned fundraising amount was RMB 500 billion , then under the competition of industrial capital from all parties and existing shareholders, the target was raised twice , and the final financing amount directly doubled to the hundred-billion-yuan level .

Barely less than four months have passed since DeepSeek closed its industry-record RMB 51 billion first-round financing, the leading large model enterprise is nearing the closing stage of its second super-sized financing round.

According to Bloomberg's latest report today (October 22), the size of DeepSeek's current financing round has been locked at around RMB 1000 billion , with the pre-money valuation remaining at approximately RMB 5000 billion . Sources familiar with the matter revealed that the transaction underwent drastic dynamic adjustments during the promotion process: the initial planned fundraising amount was RMB 500 billion , then under the competition of industrial capital from all parties and existing shareholders, the target was raised twice , and the final financing amount directly doubled to the hundred-billion-yuan level .

In terms of the capital allocation, the capital contribution of new and existing shareholders shows a 50-50 split . Existing shareholders Tencent and CATL each increased their capital contribution by about RMB 100 billion , becoming the cornerstone investors of this round; while the new entrants are all from the hard technology camp, including Stony Creek Capital, SMIC PE, CPE Yuanfeng, Legend Capital as well as automotive giant Geely , etc.

articles.title: LattePanda Launches LattePanda Sigma 2: The Embeddable AI Single Board Server
articles.descEn: The LattePanda Team today launched LattePanda Sigma 2, an x86 single-board server designed to bring high-performance local AI computing directly into intelligent products and systems. Built around the Intel® Core™ Ultra X7 358H processor with Intel Arc™ B390 graphics, LattePanda Sigma 2 delivers up to 180 TOPS of total AI performance at INT8 in a compact form factor.

articles.title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
articles.descEn: The new open-source model speaks the language of DNA and can help researchers understand the effects of any changes on gene activity and health.
articles.titleEn: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
summaryLinesEn: Researchers face restrictions when it comes to uploading identifiable or sensitive patient data to frontier AI models, so Tunstall says his team intentionally designed a small model with 14 billion parameters.
The team started with an existing language model and expanded its vocabulary to read DNA in groups of six letters.

Lewis Tunstall, a senior research scientist at Hugging Face, says the tool is meant to help researchers design new drugs and genetic therapies, and it could potentially aid patients in interpreting their own genomes.

summaryLinesEn: Nvidia ( NVDA ) is expanding its efforts to prevent AI agents from going rogue and teaming up with Agile Robots on a new humanoid robot reference design.

Nvidia has repeatedly claimed that physical AI could revolutionize the $50 trillion manufacturing and logistics industries, and the company wants to be at the center of it all.

localization.title: Palantir, 새로운 고객에게 Sovereign AI 제공 가속화
summaryLines: Insider Monkey • 1개월 전 PLTR NVDA Palantir-Nvidia Sovereign AI 거래로 월스트리트 24시간 AI 인프라 경쟁에서 누가 승리할지가 바뀔 것임 · • 3개월 전 PLTR NVDA Nvidia와 Palantir는 AI 구축 속도를 높이고 싶어함

지난 달 Palantir와 NVIDIA가 파운드리, 온톨로지, AIP가 NVIDIA의 자체 공급망과 웨이퍼에서 첫 번째 토큰으로의 경로를 어떻게 가속화하는지 강조한 이전 발표 이후, L3Harris, McCarthy Building Companies Inc., NVIDIA, Ondas 및 Regna AI, Tampa General Hospital을 비롯한 새로운 주력 고객이 자체 주권 노력을 가속화함
우리는 McCarthy의 160년 경험을 바탕으로 이 모델을 구축했으며 더 낮은 비용으로 개척지보다 뛰어난 성능을 발휘함" · 라고 Strategic Initiatives의 부사장인 Rico Bertucci는 말함

articles.title: AI Guardrails Aren’t Stopping Criminal Hackers
articles.descEn: Hackers around the world are all-in on using agentic AI to wage attacks—and manipulating tools like Anthropic’s Claude to help them carry out their crimes.
articles.titleEn: AI Guardrails Aren’t Stopping Criminal Hackers
summaryLinesEn: As AI adoption spreads among both malicious hackers and defenders , even relatively unsophisticated cybercriminals are incorporating agentic AI into their campaigns and getting around model safeguards, according to new details published on Wednesday about recent successful attacks by four different threat groups.
The former two exhibited sophisticated AI “harnesses,” the software that supports and guides a model to carry out tasks.

Using models including Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Deepseek V4 Pro, the group set up a full infrastructure for autonomous attacks involving a “Supervisor” Claude Code agent to direct the steps of an attack and an “Executor” agent to carry them out.

localization.title: AI 가드레일은 해커 범죄를 막지 못함
summaryLines: 최근 4개 위협 그룹의 성공적인 공격에 대해 수요일에 발표된 새로운 세부 정보에 따르면, 악의적인 해커와 방어자 모두에게 AI 채택이 확산됨에 따라 비교적 정교하지 않은 사이버 범죄자도 에이전트 AI를 캠페인에 통합하고 모델 보호 장치를 우회하고 있다고 수요일에 발표됨
전자의 두 회사는 작업을 수행하기 위해 모델을 지원하고 안내하는 소프트웨어인 정교한 AI "하네스"를 전시함
Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Haiku 4.5 및 Deepseek V4 Pro를 포함한 모델을 사용하여 그룹은 공격 단계를 지시하는 "감독자" Claude Code 에이전트와 이를 수행하는 "Executor" 에이전트가 포함된 자율 공격을 위한 전체 인프라를 설정함

articles.title: Claude Duet is Anthropic's answer to Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots - Engadget
articles.descEn: Anthropic subscribers in the US can join a waitlist to try the company's new agent.
articles.titleEn: Claude Duet is Anthropic's answer to Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Duet shares usage with all your other Claude tools, including Code, which sounds like a recipe for the new agent to blow through your rate limits, but Anthropic at least appears to be thinking ahead.

"You can also hand it tasks of all shapes — from simple administrative tasks of scheduling meetings to more complex ones, such as building dashboards with dozens of tools, creating financial or sales forecasts, prototyping, and building web apps," the company writes, promising Duet will only message you when something requires your attention.

According to Anthropic, Duet will never directly see your passwords or sign-in tokens, and information that might relate to your health or personal finances is only let through if you explicitly tell Duet to share it.

localization.title: Claude Duet은 Meta Muse 및 OpenAI Dots에 대한 Anthropic의 답변임 · - Engadget
summaryLines: Duet은 코드를 포함하여 다른 모든 Claude 도구와 사용법을 공유함 · 이는 새로운 에이전트가 속도 제한을 뛰어넘을 수 있는 방법처럼 들리지만 적어도 Anthropic은 미리 생각하고 있는 것으로 전망
"또한 회의 일정을 잡는 간단한 관리 작업부터 수십 가지 도구를 사용하여 대시보드 구축, 재무 또는 판매 예측 생성, 프로토타이핑, 웹 앱 구축과 같은 보다 복잡한 작업에 이르기까지 모든 형태의 작업을 처리할 수 있음" · 라고 회사에서는 Duet이 사용자의 주의가 필요한 경우에만 메시지를 보낼 것이라고 약속함
Anthropic에 따르면 Duet은 귀하의 비밀번호나 로그인 토큰을 직접 볼 수 없으며 귀하의 건강이나 개인 재정과 관련될 수 있는 정보는 귀하가 Duet에 공유하도록 명시적으로 지시한 경우에만 공개됨

articles.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
articles.descEn: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.
articles.titleEn: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
summaryLinesEn: Recursive said that Eureka’s contributions include a sparser model shape, low-bit training that shrank Flint by 71% with almost no loss in quality and custom kernels, which are specialized programs that speed up the underlying computations.

Because Flint runs on a user’s own computer rather than a company’s cloud servers, developers can use it offline, keep their code private, and avoid the usage fees that AI cloud services charge based on how much text the model processes.
Flint is a mixture-of-experts model, meaning it uses only a small slice of itself for any given task: just 2.5 billion of its 40 billion settings, known as parameters, at a time.

localization.title: Recursive는 주로 AI로 제작된 노트북 코딩 모델인 Flint를 출시함
summaryLines: Recursive는 Eureka의 기여에는 더 희박한 모델 형태, 품질 손실 없이 Flint를 71%까지 축소한 낮은 비트 교육, 기본 계산 속도를 높이는 특수 프로그램인 맞춤형 커널이 포함되어 있다고 말함
Flint는 회사의 클라우드 서버가 아닌 사용자 자신의 컴퓨터에서 실행되기 때문에 개발자는 이를 오프라인으로 사용할 수 있고, 코드를 비공개로 유지할 수 있으며, 모델이 처리하는 텍스트 양에 따라 AI 클라우드 서비스에서 부과하는 사용 요금을 피할 수 있음
Flint는 전문가가 혼합된 모델임 · 즉, 특정 작업에 대해 자신의 작은 부분만 사용함 · 매개변수라고 알려진 400억 개의 설정 중 한 번에 25억 개만 사용함

articles.title: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
articles.descEn: Google Cloud is the first major cloud provider to offer Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI's GPTs on a single platform. At launch, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna are available as a private preview for enterprise customers.
articles.titleEn: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
summaryLinesEn: The move highlights a recurring tension at Google: compute capacity spent serving cloud customers strengthens the biggest rivals of its own Gemini team.

Three OpenAI models are available starting today : GPT-6 Astra for demanding tasks like coding and research, GPT-6.1 Sol as a cheaper alternative with similar performance, and GPT-6 Luna as a fast, cost-efficient option for everyday use.
Google Cloud is now the only major cloud provider offering Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI models on one platform.
articles.summary:
The move highlights a recurring tension at Google: compute capacity spent serving cloud customers strengthens the biggest rivals of its own Gemini team.
Three OpenAI models are available starting today : GPT-6 Astra for demanding tasks like coding and research, GPT-6.1 Sol as a cheaper alternative with similar performance, and GPT-6 Luna as a fast, cost-efficient option for everyday use.

articles.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
articles.descEn: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol discovered a critical PHP vulnerability as part of the Patch the Planet initiative that could affect millions of websites. Security firm Wiz independently found the same flaw using Google's Gemini 4 Argon. OpenAI warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
summaryLinesEn: GPT-5.6 Sol tracked down the flaw as part of the Patch-the-Planet initiative , which OpenAI calls one of the "most impactful security issues in recent memory."
The company expects findings on the scale of the PHP2Shell flaw to "increase sharply in the coming months," but warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too.
Security firm Wiz found the same flaws independently, using its own Wiz Atlas platform alongside Google's Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol.

articles.descEn: Anthropic just announced Claude Duet, an AI agent competitor to Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots that’s designed for professionals and small business owners. It’s available as a “research preview.”

summaryLinesEn: Given that Duet may be taking action on sensitive information, it has a new “new dedicated classifier and safety system prompt” that are “designed to reject requests to share the strictest tier of information,” such as credit card numbers.
If you want to try Claude Duet, you can get on the waitlist , though you’ll need to be a Pro or Max subscriber in the US to use it.

articles.title: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
articles.descEn: Meta is creating a new class of shares to fund its AI initiatives as it pours billions into the industry.
articles.titleEn: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
summaryLinesEn: The company expects capital expenditures between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from the previous $130 billion and $145 billion estimate.
Meta says it would’ve made over $22 billion if it didn’t have to pay a child safety settlement It’s been a busy past few weeks for Meta, which launched its AI agent, Muse , in September.

Susan Li, Meta’s chief financial officer, added during an earnings call that the new class of shares will “expand our funding tools and give us flexibility to invest behind the unprecedented momentum we’re seeing across every part of our business driven by AI.”

summaryLines: 회사는 올해 자본 지출이 이전 추정치인 1,300억~1,450억 달러보다 증가한 1,350억~1,450억 달러에 이를 것으로 예상하고 있음
Meta는 아동 안전 합의금을 지불하지 않았다면 220억 달러 이상을 벌었을 것이라고 말함 · 지난 9월 AI 에이전트인 Muse를 출시한 Meta는 지난 몇 주 동안 바쁜 시간을 보냈음
Meta의 최고재무책임자(CFO)인 Susan Li는 수익 보고에서 "새로운 종류의 주식은 우리의 자금 조달 도구를 확장하고 AI가 주도하는 비즈니스의 모든 부분에서 볼 수 있는 전례 없는 모멘텀 뒤에 투자할 수 있는 유연성을 제공할 것"이라고 덧붙였음

summaryLinesEn: Despite having only “30 million of revenue and minimal profitability” at that time, according to Khaira, CoreWeave approached Blackstone for a $2.3 billion loan.

articles.titleEn: Investors are questioning neoclouds' business model but Nebius says AI computing prices are rising
summaryLinesEn: Nebius stock rose on Wednesday after SpaceX reported revenue at its AI business jumped ninefold to $7.56 billion.
Marc Boroditsky, chief revenue officer at Nebius, said his company wasn't in CoreWeave's position because "we're not carrying the kind of debt that they are."

BERLIN — Nebius is seeing AI computing prices rise more than expected, a top executive told CNBC on Wednesday, offering a bullish view as neocloud firms' business model comes under increasing scrutiny .

articles.title: いま、改めて「不安」に着目する
articles.titleEn: いま、改めて「不安」に着目する
summaryLinesEn: 一方、強い不安が続くと、考えすぎて眠れない、心身の疲れが抜けないなど、仕事や生活に影響を及ぼすことがあります。
しかし、こうした影響は「心配性」「気の持ちよう」といった個人の問題として扱われることも多く、十分に可視化されてきませんでした。
今回NRIは、不安の有無ではなく「強さ・頻度」と「それによる支障」に着目し、強い不安の実態、仕事への影響（経済規模換算）、対処の現状を、本邦初のデータを含む独自調査を基に整理しました。

신에너지차(NEV)가 수출이 전년 동기 대비 130% 급증하고 점유율도 가솔린차를 앞지르는 등 해외 성장의 핵심 동력이 되면서 NEV 중심의 글로벌 진출 방향으로 전환됨
한국 시장 · 외국 브랜드가 소비자 관심을 끌기 위한 경쟁을 심화함에 따라 EV 채택이 가속화됨 · 2026년 상반기에 한국의 전기 자동차로의 전환이 가속화되어 완전 전기 자동차 등록이 전년 대비 113.6% 급증하고 시장 점유율이 2025년 상반기 11.1%에서 23.3%로 급격하게 상승함

summaryLinesEn: This integration has led to time savings of around 2,400 hours per month — significantly boosting productivity and employee satisfaction. 84% of employees and 96% of executives expect potential employers to provide generative AI training opportunities, and Qualcomm’s proactive approach has not only met but exceeded these expectations.

articles.title: Southeast Asia’s digital economy to hit $368 billion
articles.descEn: AI drives Southeast Asia’s digital economy toward $1 trillion by 2035. See Google’s e-Conomy SEA report for the full growth outlook.
articles.titleEn: Southeast Asia’s digital economy to hit $368 billion
summaryLinesEn: Managing Director, Southeast Asia and South Asia Frontier Markets Southeast Asia’s digital economy is surging, with generative AI driving growth toward a projected $1 trillion valuation by 2035.
E-commerce ($226B GMV, +18% YoY) anchors this shift, as shoppers use multimodal discovery and in-app assistants to confidently navigate complex purchases.

To support a projected 60-fold increase in regional AI usage by 2030, the region's broader digital ecosystem must systematically evolve across four critical conditions: Accelerated agentic adoption and sustainable economics: Businesses need to move beyond using AI to answer single questions and start using it to help complete multi-step tasks from start to finish, backed by strong privacy safeguards and clear safety rules.

localization.title: 동남아시아의 디지털 경제 규모는 3,680억 달러에 이를 것으로 예상
summaryLines: 동남아시아 및 남아시아 프런티어 마켓 상무 이사 동남아시아의 디지털 경제는 생성 AI가 2035년까지 예상 가치 1조 달러를 향해 성장을 주도하면서 급증하고 있음
전자상거래(GMV 2,260억 달러, YoY +18%)는 쇼핑객이 다중 모드 검색 및 인앱 도우미를 사용하여 복잡한 구매를 자신있게 탐색함에 따라 이러한 변화의 중심이 됨

2030년까지 지역 AI 사용량이 60배 증가할 것으로 예상되는 것을 지원하려면 지역의 광범위한 디지털 생태계가 네 가지 중요한 조건에 걸쳐 체계적으로 발전해야 함 · 가속화된 에이전트 채택 및 지속 가능한 경제 · 기업은 AI를 사용하여 단일 질문에 답하는 것을 넘어 강력한 개인정보 보호 장치와 명확한 안전 규칙을 바탕으로 AI를 사용하여 처음부터 끝까지 다단계 작업을 완료하도록 지원해야 함

articles.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
articles.descEn: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.
articles.titleEn: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
summaryLinesEn: As the workload grew, the single agent searched less of the literature, citing only 11 references at the largest workload, while the distributed agents cited more than 700 references.

How OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to help scientists identify promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research deployed thousands of AI agents in parallel to identify promising biological connections in complex data from millions of brain cells.

The agents connected the effects of gene disruptions with findings from scientific literature, uncovering unexpected biological connections that can help scientists understand disease and identify research directions for new treatments.

summaryLines: 작업 부하가 증가함에 따라 단일 에이전트는 가장 큰 작업 부하에서 11개의 참고 문헌만 인용하여 문헌 검색을 줄인 반면, 분산 에이전트는 700개 이상의 참고 문헌을 인용함

OpenAI, PerturbAI 및 Scripps Research가 분산 AI 에이전트를 사용하여 과학자들이 수백만 개의 뇌 세포 데이터에서 유망한 연구 리드를 식별하는 데 도움을 준 방법 OpenAI, PerturbAI 및 Scripps Research가 수천 개의 AI 에이전트를 병렬로 배포하여 수백만 개의 뇌 세포의 복잡한 데이터에서 유망한 생물학적 연결을 식별하는 방법을 알아보세요
에이전트는 유전자 파괴의 영향을 과학 문헌의 발견과 연결하여 과학자들이 질병을 이해하고 새로운 치료법에 대한 연구 방향을 식별하는 데 도움이 될 수 있는 예상치 못한 생물학적 연관성을 밝혀냈음

articles.title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
articles.descEn: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.
articles.titleEn: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
summaryLinesEn: While bootstrapping a self-improving ads system like this used to take years, ChatGPT Ads reached $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate less than 200 days after launch ; now, more than 100,000 advertisers have run ads on ChatGPT since launch.
This means the ads system can’t take down or delay the ChatGPT product.
ChatGPT has no dependency on the ads system—the services are in no way intertwined and don’t share a content generation model.

summaryLines: 이전에는 이와 같은 자체 개선 광고 시스템을 부트스트랩하는 데 수년이 걸렸지만 ChatGPT 광고는 출시 후 200일이 채 안 되어 연간 수익 실행률이 10억 달러에 도달함 · 현재 ChatGPT 출시 이후 100,000명이 넘는 광고주가 ChatGPT에 광고를 게재함

articles.descEn: New model families for vision and language, retrieval, tabular data, biology, robotics and quantum computing supercharge development in Europe.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Open Models Advance Europe’s Sovereign Intelligence Across Industries
summaryLinesEn: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is expected to be available on Friday, Oct.

NVIDIA Kumo Speeds Agents’ Work With Structured Enterprise Data NVIDIA Kumo open foundation models, libraries and tools help agents and applications forecast outcomes, score fraud risk and recommend actions from structured business data.

The NVIDIA Ising family of open models provides a common, extensible foundation to speed the breakthroughs needed to develop useful quantum supercomputers, from real-time hardware calibration to error correction, across different qubit modalities and tailored to individual hardware needs.

articles.title: NVIDIA Agent Toolkit Expands, Grounding Enterprise Agents in Company Data
articles.descEn: Leading enterprises are using the open source NVIDIA Agent Toolkit — now expanded with new tools — to customize and control agents, use company data to inform their answers and actions, monitor what they do and govern how they operate.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Agent Toolkit Expands, Grounding Enterprise Agents in Company Data
summaryLinesEn: With Palantir , NVIDIA’s supply chain organization is using Agent Knowledge Foundation through Palantir Foundry, Ontology and AIP to deploy specialized agents, create actionable intelligence from proprietary data, predict outcomes and optimize decision-making.

Leading enterprises are using the open source NVIDIA Agent Toolkit — now expanded with new tools — to customize and control agents, use company data to inform their answers and actions, monitor what they do and govern how they operate.

It also includes NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever and Kumo Structured open models — Kumo Tabular, Kumo Relational, Kumo Time Series and Kumo Forecast — which help agents find relevant company information to answer questions and make predictions.
articles.summary:
With Palantir , NVIDIA’s supply chain organization is using Agent Knowledge Foundation through Palantir Foundry, Ontology and AIP to deploy specialized agents, create actionable intelligence from proprietary data, predict outcomes and optimize decision-making.
Leading enterprises are using the open source NVIDIA Agent Toolkit — now expanded with new tools — to customize and control agents, use company data to inform their answers and actions, monitor what they do and govern how they operate.
It also includes NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever and Kumo Structured open models — Kumo Tabular, Kumo Relational, Kumo Time Series and Kumo Forecast — which help agents find relevant company information to answer questions and make predictions.

It also includes NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever and Kumo Structured open models — Kumo Tabular, Kumo Relational, Kumo Time Series and Kumo Forecast — which help agents find relevant company information to answer questions and make predictions.

articles.descEn: Let's compare the fastest-selling PC/Console games of 2026 to the year prior, to see which genres have been gaining steam & which developers are responsible.
articles.titleEn: Top Games of 2026: Indie and New IP Break Out, Without Denting AAA
summaryLinesEn: The first games in new series made up 53% of breakouts, up from 38% (40 vs 21). 35 breakouts were new IP, and indie studios made 27 of them.

More new PlayStation, Steam and Xbox games are breaking out than a year ago, and indie studios account for almost all of the growth. 76 games launched between September 2025 and August 2026 sold 500,000+ paid units in their first 30 days, up from 55 a year earlier.

articles.title: NVIDIA Confidential Computing Expands, Enabling Frontier Model Builders to Securely Scale Across Global Infrastructure
articles.descEn: New Confidential Bare Metal with NVIDIA Confidential Computing protects models and data across cloud, neocloud and enterprise infrastructure — plus, NVIDIA Confidential Computing is expanding across NVIDIA Grace Blackwell and Rubin systems as well as NVIDIA DSX OS.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Confidential Computing Expands, Enabling Frontier Model Builders to Securely Scale Across Global Infrastructure
summaryLinesEn: These new controls let frontier model builders use bare-metal instances to own and operate their bespoke software stack, including host and platform infrastructure software, when operating on NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure across third-party cloud, neocloud and enterprise infrastructure.

Today, NVIDIA is expanding that layer with Confidential Bare Metal, a new deployment option with NVIDIA Confidential Computing that enables frontier model builders to run sensitive workloads on dedicated third-party infrastructure while retaining control of their models and data.
Confidential Computing Expands Across the NVIDIA Platform NVIDIA Confidential Computing uses hardware-rooted isolation and cryptographic attestation to help protect models and data during execution.

summaryLines: 이러한 새로운 컨트롤을 통해 선두 모델 빌더는 타사 클라우드, 네오클라우드 및 엔터프라이즈 인프라 전반에 걸쳐 NVIDIA 가속 컴퓨팅 인프라에서 운영할 때 베어 메탈 인스턴스를 사용하여 호스트 및 플랫폼 인프라 소프트웨어를 포함한 맞춤형 소프트웨어 스택을 소유하고 운영할 수 있음
현재 NVIDIA는 최첨단 모델 빌더가 모델과 데이터에 대한 제어권을 유지하면서 전용 타사 인프라에서 민감한 워크로드를 실행할 수 있도록 지원하는 NVIDIA Confidential Computing의 새로운 배포 옵션인 Confidential Bare Metal을 통해 해당 계층을 확장하고 있음
기밀 컴퓨팅은 NVIDIA 플랫폼 전체로 확장됨 · NVIDIA 기밀 컴퓨팅은 하드웨어 기반 격리 및 암호화 증명을 사용하여 실행 중에 모델과 데이터를 보호함

articles.title: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations
articles.descEn: NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations
summaryLinesEn: Industry leaders are already integrating NVIDIA cuDSS into their tools to transform workflows for their end customers: Applied Materials: With cuDSS, Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in Ginestra, its physics-based, defect-centric simulation platform, by up to 10x versus CPU-only approaches, speeding exploration of semiconductor materials and device reliability.

This lets applications reduce time to results and increase simulation throughput, enabling end users to explore larger more realistic models, more accurate representations and a wider design space at a reduced cost.

summaryLines: 업계 선두업체들은 이미 NVIDIA cuDSS를 자사 도구에 통합하여 최종 고객을 위한 워크플로를 혁신하고 있음 · Applied Materials: cuDSS를 사용하면 Applied Materials 가속 희소 솔루션은 물리 기반 결함 중심 시뮬레이션 플랫폼인 Ginestra에서 CPU 전용 접근 방식에 비해 최대 10배 더 빠른 속도로 반도체 소재 탐색 및 장치 신뢰성을 가속화함
이를 통해 응용 프로그램은 결과 도출 시간을 단축하고 시뮬레이션 처리량을 높여 최종 사용자가 더 큰 실제 모델, 더 정확한 표현 및 더 넓은 설계 공간을 저렴한 비용으로 탐색할 수 있음

articles.descEn: To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries, as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle.
articles.titleEn: Europe’s Industrial Leaders Reinvent Engineering and Manufacturing With NVIDIA
summaryLinesEn: To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries , as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle.

localization.title: 유럽의 산업 리더들은 NVIDIA를 통해 엔지니어링 및 제조를 재창조함
summaryLines: 생산성을 높이고 혁신을 가속화하며 경제 성장을 위한 새로운 기회를 창출하기 위해 유럽의 산업 리더들은 엔지니어링 및 제조 라이프사이클 전반에 걸쳐 NVIDIA CUDA-X 및 Omniverse 라이브러리는 물론 NVIDIA Cosmos 및 Nemotron 개방형 모델을 활용하고 있음
GTC 베를린에서 NVIDIA는 구조적 응력, 유체 흐름, 전자기장 및 반도체 장치 동작의 복잡한 시뮬레이션 뒤에 있는 까다로운 계산을 가속화하는 cuDSS를 일반 출시용으로 출시함
Siemens는 근본 원인을 식별하고 공장 운영을 조정하기 위해 FOX를 사용하여 구축된 에이전트를 에이전트 엔터프라이즈 시스템인 Intelligence Center X에 통합하여 예상 비용을 20% 절감하고 있음

articles.descEn: Growing ecosystem of AI clouds across Europe, Nordics, Africa and Central Asia build full-stack NVIDIA DSX Vera Rubin AI factories as AI-native companies drive demand for sovereign compute, training, inference and post-training services.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Cloud Partners Scale Across Europe — Sovereign, Open and Built for Safe AI Agents
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do.

summaryLines: 유럽, 북유럽, 아프리카, 중앙아시아의 NVIDIA 클라우드 파트너는 모델 교육 및 추론을 위한 지역적 컴퓨팅 용량을 확장하고 개발자가 에이전트 및 물리적 AI 애플리케이션을 구축하도록 돕고 에이전트가 액세스하고 수행할 수 있는 경계를 설정하고 있음
확장된 용량은 빌더에게 워크로드를 실행할 수 있는 더 많은 공간을 제공함
소버린 · 유럽의 AI 인프라를 구축하는 AI 클라우드 유럽은 세계적 수준의 연구, 엔지니어링 인재, 산업 전문 지식, 데이터, 지식이 있는 곳과 가까운 대규모 컴퓨팅이 필요한 차세대 모델 및 애플리케이션의 본거지임

articles.title: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
articles.descEn: Google Cloud A5X instances, accelerated by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, support European innovators with next-generation agentic and reinforcement learning infrastructure.
articles.titleEn: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
summaryLinesEn: To support energy-efficient deployment at scale, Google Cloud and NVIDIA are exploring NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS capabilities for Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to help optimize performance per watt and expand capacity within available data-center power budgets.
A5X brings Vera Rubin into Google Cloud’s AI Hypercomputer as an integrated system, combining compute, networking and storage to support experience-driven learning at scale.
Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites.
articles.summary:

A5X brings Vera Rubin into Google Cloud’s AI Hypercomputer as an integrated system, combining compute, networking and storage to support experience-driven learning at scale.
Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites.

summaryLines: 대규모로 에너지 효율적인 배포를 지원하기 위해 Google Cloud와 NVIDIA는 Vera Rubin 기반 인프라를 위한 NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS 기능을 탐색하여 와트당 성능을 최적화하고 사용 가능한 데이터 센터 전력 예산 내에서 용량을 확장하는 데 도움을 주고 있음

Google Cloud는 Vera Rubin 기반 인프라를 여러 사이트에 걸쳐 최대 960,000개의 Rubin GPU로 확장할 계획임

articles.title: Bringing the Spark to Europe: Local Intelligence Powers Next Wave of Agents
articles.descEn: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is highlighting secure, local systems across RTX Spark, DGX Spark and DGX Station systems to accelerate coding, engineering, robotics and AI factory development.
articles.titleEn: Bringing the Spark to Europe: Local Intelligence Powers Next Wave of Agents
summaryLinesEn: For larger teams, DGX Station offers 748GB of coherent memory and up to 20 petaflops of AI performance, enabling developers to run advanced models like GLM 5.3 and serve 30+ users at speeds comparable to those provided by cloud models.
RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — running personal agents, accelerated content creation and 1440p 100 frames-per-second gaming with up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute.

RTX Spark , which launched last week , powers personal agents on Windows PCs; DGX Spark supports developers building and scaling applications on Linux; and DGX Station serves enterprise teams running frontier workloads on Linux, with a Windows version arriving in December.

RTX Spark는 PC를 위한 새로운 시작임 · 최대 128GB의 통합 메모리와 1페타플롭의 AI 컴퓨팅을 통해 개인 에이전트 실행, 가속화된 콘텐츠 생성, 초당 1440p 100프레임 게임을 실행할 수 있음
지난주에 출시된 RTX Spark는 Windows PC의 개인 에이전트를 강화함 · DGX Spark는 개발자가 Linux에서 애플리케이션을 구축하고 확장할 수 있도록 지원함 · DGX Station은 12월에 출시될 Windows 버전을 통해 Linux에서 프런티어 워크로드를 실행하는 기업 팀에 서비스를 제공함

articles.titleEn: AI Runtime is Generally Available | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Too often, AI teams spend more time securing GPU capacity, managing failures, and waiting for experiments to launch than improving their models.
Running GPU infrastructure separately from their Lakehouse adds governance gaps and puts sensitive training data at risk.

Today, we’re excited to announce the General Availability of AI Runtime (AIR), bringing fully managed GPU infrastructure directly into Databricks so customers can train their most demanding models where their enterprise data already lives.

localization.title: AI 런타임이 정식 출시되었습니다 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: AI 팀은 모델을 개선하는 것보다 GPU 용량을 확보하고, 오류를 관리하고, 실험이 시작되기를 기다리는 데 더 많은 시간을 소비하는 경우가 많음
Lakehouse와 별도로 GPU 인프라를 실행하면 거버넌스 격차가 늘어나고 민감한 훈련 데이터가 위험에 처하게 됨
오늘 우리는 완전히 관리되는 GPU 인프라를 Databricks에 직접 도입하는 AIR(AI 런타임)의 일반 가용성을 발표하게 되어 기쁘게 생각함 · 고객은 이미 엔터프라이즈 데이터가 있는 가장 까다로운 모델을 교육할 수 있음

articles.title: Databricks AI Runtime and NVIDIA make it easier to customize open models with enterprise data | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: GPUs
articles.titleEn: Databricks AI Runtime and NVIDIA make it easier to customize open models with enterprise data | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: AIR supports NVIDIA NeMo and containers so teams can train and fine tune models on serverless NVIDIA GPUs alongside governed enterprise data.
For teams that need to customize models, AI Runtime (AIR) brings NVIDIA’s AI software ecosystem and serverless GPUs to enterprise data.
Increasingly, enterprises are adapting open models to their own data and business needs.

articles.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
articles.descEn: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
summaryLinesEn: By expanding access through Google Cloud, we are giving enterprises greater choice in how they discover and use frontier models, with a path from evaluation to broader adoption.

The integration will pair OpenAI’s frontier models with Google Cloud’s built-in access controls, centralized data governance, and high-performance infrastructure to support demanding enterprise workloads.
Google Cloud’s longstanding investment in machine learning and AI has made it a destination for AI workloads and the developers and data scientists building them.

localization.title: OpenAI 모델이 Google Cloud에 출시됨
summaryLines: Google Cloud를 통해 액세스를 확장함으로써 기업이 평가부터 폭넓은 채택까지의 경로를 통해 프론티어 모델을 발견하고 사용하는 방법에 대한 더 많은 선택권을 제공하고 있음
이번 통합을 통해 OpenAI의 프론티어 모델과 Google Cloud의 기본 제공 액세스 제어, 중앙 집중식 데이터 거버넌스, 고성능 인프라가 결합되어 까다로운 기업 워크로드를 지원하게 됨
Google Cloud는 머신러닝 및 AI에 대한 오랜 투자를 통해 AI 워크로드와 이를 구축하는 개발자 및 데이터 과학자의 목적지가 됨

articles.descEn: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

summaryLinesEn: More than 1.2 billion people use ChatGPT each week to explore ideas, compare options and make decisions.

articles.descEn: A Blog post by IBM Granite on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Granite Speech 5.0: Transcribe, Translate, and Attribute more Accurately and Faster
summaryLinesEn: Granite Speech 5.0 2B: more accurate, more robust, more control Granite Speech 5.0 Turbo CTC: now multilingual, more robust, and even faster Granite Speech 4.1 2B Plus: better at who said what, and when We're excited to share three updates to IBM's Granite Speech collection: a new speech-language model, granite-speech-5.0-2b , and revised versions of two models the community already uses, granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc and granite-speech-4.1-2b-plus .
Timestamps: Average timestamp shift (AAS) is cut by more than half, yielding tighter timing in captions, search, and review.
The updated granite-speech-4.1-2b-plus is tuned for the recordings enterprises actually have: meetings, support calls, and interviews with several speakers running long.

summaryLines: Granite Speech 5.0 2B: 더 정확하고, 더 강력하고, 더 많은 제어 기능 Granite Speech 5.0 Turbo CTC: 이제 다국어, 더 강력하고 더 빨라졌음 · Granite Speech 4.1 2B Plus: 누가 무엇을 말했는지, 언제에 대해 더 잘 설명함 · IBM의 Granite Speech 컬렉션에 대한 세 가지 업데이트를 공유하게 되어 기쁘게 생각함 · 새로운 음성 언어 모델인 granite-speech-5.0-2b와 이미 커뮤니티에서 두 모델의 수정된 버전임 · granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc 및 granite-speech-4.1-2b-plus를 사용함
타임스탬프 · AAS(평균 타임스탬프 이동)가 절반 이상 줄어들어 캡션, 검색 및 검토 시간이 더 촉박해졌음

articles.title: Pace of Trump’s Judicial Appointments Has Slowed in His Second Term
articles.descEn: President Trump has appointed fewer federal judges in this term than at this point in his first, and his pace trails that of most recent presidents.
articles.titleEn: Pace of Trump’s Judicial Appointments Has Slowed in His Second Term
summaryLinesEn: At the appeals court level, for example, only three judges stepped down or announced their intention to do so between the 2024 presidential election and the end of Trump’s first year back in the White House.
Judges are an important part of every president’s legacy because they have lifetime appointments, so they can serve long after the president who appointed them leaves office.
In fact, Trump’s pace of judicial appointments trails that of most other recent presidents, according to a Pew Research Center analysis of data from the Federal Judicial Center .

President Donald Trump has appointed fewer federal judges so far in his second term than at the same point in his first term. In fact, Trump’s pace of judicial appointments trails that of most other recent presidents, according to a Pew Research Center analysis of data from the Federal Judicial Center .

The analysis comes ahead of midterm elections that will decide control of the U.S. Senate. If Democrats take control of the chamber from Republicans in November, they could further slow Trump’s judicial appointments. articles.title: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins
articles.descEn: The decades-old mystery of the origins of one of the most popular cryptographic standards has been explained.
articles.titleEn: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins
summaryLinesEn: The $36,864 for finding the seeds will be donated to the Internet Security Research Group .
Each recovered 48-bit state regenerates all 160 bits of its seed, which does not happen by chance.
Because the number of skipped candidates is small, we do not believe it is plausible that weakened curves were selected.

articles.title: An opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
articles.descEn: We’re launching OSS Scanner, an opt-in vulnerability scanner for the open-source ecosystem informed by our experience using Claude to find vulnerabilities during Project Glasswing. Projects that join will receive thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost.
articles.titleEn: An opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
summaryLinesEn: We’re launching OSS Scanner , an opt-in vulnerability scanner for the open-source ecosystem informed by our experience using Claude to find vulnerabilities during Project Glasswing .

Each report contains a self-contained reproducer, explanation of the vulnerability (including a bisection to determine when the bug was introduced, where possible), and candidate patch (when available) for how the bug can be fixed.

Inspired by the positive impact on the open source ecosystem of Google's OSS-Fuzz , a project that scans open-source software for vulnerabilities with fuzzers, we are launching OSS Scanner to find vulnerabilities in open-source code with our strongest language models.

articles.titleEn: Claude computes a nine-loop amplitude in N=4 super-Yang-Mills
summaryLinesEn: The one the folks at Anthropic chose to tackle was to go up to nine loops with a particular toy model theory, called N=4 super Yang-Mills.
Either approach would have cost an end-user around one or two thousand dollars, mostly due to the expense of running Claude for so long.
That meant that Lance was already well set up to check if someone had handed him the next amplitude formula, with nine loops.

articles.title: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Dharma-AI on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications
summaryLinesEn: An expression that appears 37 times in 50,000 documents shows up in a 400-document sample only about 26% of the time.

This article previews some results from the VocabX paper, which we will publish soon: how we specialized the vocabulary around the cost of each token rather than its frequency, and cut measured inference cost by 77% without changing the base model.
Quality, measured by the bench score, which combines grading accuracy and the accuracy of screening off-topic or rule-breaking essays, rose from 0.703 to 0.810.

articles.title: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
articles.descEn: Dr. Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Dean of Science at Harvard University, has joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust. He brings to the Trust decades of scientific expertise across observational cosmology and precision measurement. He has also advised the US government on national security and arms control. “I am honored to join Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust and to help the company deliver on its public benefit mission,” said Stubbs. “I use AI tools in my research every day and see what they make possible, and as an educator I have confronted some of the hard questions they raise. As a grandfather, I want to help ensure that AI is developed and deployed for the long-term benefit of humanity.” Stubbs is the Samuel C. Moncher Professor of Physics and of Astronomy at Harvard, where he served as Dean of Science from 2018 to 2024. In 1998, as a member of the High-Z Supernova Search Team, he helped discover the accelerating expansion of the universe, work that later earned the team the Breakthrough Prize in Fundamental Physics. He was also the inaugural project scientist for what is now the Vera C. Rubin Observatory, which started a 10-year survey of the southern sky in June. One of its aims is to study the accelerating expansion he helped discover. More recently, he’s written about how to keep AI-assisted research reproducible when models can give different answers to the same question. He’s a member of JASON, an independent group of scientists who have advised the US government on defense and technology since 1960. "When Chris found evidence that the universe was expanding at a rate no one expected, he and his team followed the data even when it went against the prevailing wisdom of the field. As AI starts to transform how science itself is done, Chris’s intellectual honesty, rigor, and commitment to the truth are the values we want shaping the future of this technology, and I’m grateful he’s bringing his deep expertise to the Trust," said Daniela Amodei, Co-founder and President of Anthropic. Anthropic is a Public Benefit Corporation, which means we’re structured to balance commercial growth with our public benefit purpose. The Trust exists to help us hold that balance over the long term. It has the authority to appoint a majority of Anthropic’s board, and Trustees advise the board and our leadership on critical decisions, particularly those involving risks and societal impacts of AI. This week we published our first Public Benefit Report [link], a public account of how we’re working toward our mission and where we’re falling short. The Trustees helped define the five mission pillars it measures us against, and the report closes with their assessment of our progress to date. Subject to stockholder approval, we’ve also committed to setting aside a portion of Anthropic’s shares to Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows. “Anthropic's Public Benefit Report sets out what we’re all working toward: helping the world build powerful AI safely, and making sure the technology drives advances that meaningfully improve people’s lives and society as a whole,” added Neil Buddy Shah, Chair of the Long-Term Benefit Trust. “Both goals depend on a deep understanding of frontier science and leading with integrity. Not only has Chris worked on some of the hardest problems in science, but he has consistently been a high-integrity leader of large, complex, collaborative scientific endeavors across academia, government, and the national laboratories. That will be of great value to the Trust as we support Anthropic in developing AI for the long-term benefit of humanity.” Stubbs, the Trust’s first physicist, joins Shah, national security expert Richard Fontaine, and former Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke. Trustees are independent of the company’s management and investors.

articles.title: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required
articles.descEn: A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required
summaryLinesEn: It is pre-trained once on synthetic relational data that reflects real-world datasets and adapts to each new task through in-context learning , reading up to 10,000 context examples at inference time.
The same shift is now underway for structured data.

Across 41 tasks on 15 databases, it beats supervised relational deep learning models and expert-engineered gradient-boosted tree pipelines, and on the SAP SALT enterprise benchmark it surpasses AutoGluon ensembles by 8% in mean reciprocal rank (MRR).

summaryLinesEn: Mythos-class models, like Claude Fable 5.1 , represent a major increase in intelligence and agentic capabilities.

articles.title: Train Qwen3 on AWS Trainium with torchtitan | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Train Qwen3 on AWS Trainium with torchtitan three ways on a single trn2.48xlarge: the Hugging Face Transformers v5 modeling backend, torchtitan's native Qwen3, and NKI mixture-of-experts kernels. The same torchrun launcher and config structure work unchanged across all three paths, including loading and saving published Hugging Face safetensors.
articles.titleEn: Train Qwen3 on AWS Trainium with torchtitan | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Create my_neuron_kernels.py in the repository root, where you launch training. torchtitan stores query and key as [batch, seq, heads, head_dim] , whereas rope_hf expects [batch, heads, seq, head_dim] .
Using torchtitan on AWS Trainium means using it the way you always have.
This example uses rope_hf from nkilib.core.embeddings , which expects the Hugging Face tensor layout and supports its own backward mode.

articles.title: Broad access through consistent standards
articles.descEn: How OpenAI works with distribution partners to uphold consistent safeguards, support responsible access, and clarify expectations in our Usage Policies.
articles.titleEn: Broad access through consistent standards
summaryLinesEn: We’re also updating our Usage Policies , effective November 20, 2026, to clarify the rules for safe model development and sensitive uses of AI.
Both need to be effective whether people access our models directly or through a partner.

The updated Usage Policies build on that work by requiring services that provide direct access to our models such as model routers or AI gateways to get our review and approval before offering that access.

articles.title: CIO Executive Council Resources
articles.titleEn: CIO Executive Council Resources
summaryLinesEn: This IDC Survey Spotlight, prepared by Gina Smith , PhD, Senior Research Director, IT Skills for Digital Business, examines data from IDC’s 2026 Future Enterprise Resiliency and Spending Survey to explore how organizations are grappling with IT skills validation across four key regions: North America, Asia Pacific, Western Europe, and the Middle East and North Africa.
As AI becomes integral to enterprise operations, CIOs are shifting focus from rapid deployment to engineering sustainable AI economics.

The survey highlights that leadership perspectives on modernization priorities, business drivers, obstacles, IT budget allocation, decision criteria, data architecture maturity, data quality, and the data-related initiatives organizations are prioritizing to enable AI use cases over the next 12–18 months.

summaryLines: 디지털 비즈니스를 위한 IT 기술 수석 연구 이사인 Gina Smith 박사가 준비한 이 IDC 설문 조사 스포트라이트는 IDC의 2026년 미래 기업 탄력성 및 지출 설문 조사의 데이터를 검토하여 조직이 북미, 아시아 태평양, 서유럽, 중동 및 북아프리카의 4개 주요 지역에서 IT 기술 검증과 어떻게 씨름하고 있는지 살펴봄
AI가 기업 운영에 필수적인 요소가 되면서 CIO는 신속한 배포에서 지속 가능한 AI 경제성 엔지니어링으로 초점을 옮기고 있음
설문조사에서는 조직이 향후 12~18개월 동안 AI 사용 사례를 활성화하기 위해 우선순위를 정하는 현대화 우선 순위, 비즈니스 동인, 장애물, IT 예산 할당, 결정 기준, 데이터 아키텍처 성숙도, 데이터 품질 및 데이터 관련 이니셔티브에 대한 리더십 관점을 강조함

articles.descEn: The advent of AI chatbots has transformed the way doctors and patients search for information after receiving a diagnosis. In this piece, we lay out a strategy for improving your share of voice across AI search and realigning your traditional web and SEO strategy with this new reality.
articles.titleEn: AI engines don't rank your website. They rank your evidence
summaryLinesEn: When a physician asks OpenEvidence about your therapeutic area, does your evidence show up?
Research on author journal-choice behavior also found that prioritizing fit and speed of dissemination yields greater odds of acceptance at the first journal submitted to.
This is also a field intelligence tool: your sales reps need to know what AI engines say about your therapy, because that’s the conversation they’re walking into.

articles.title: Adaptive agentic intelligence framework using Strands Agents | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: The Adaptive Agentic Intelligence Framework (AAIF), built with Strands Agents, handles routine tasks locally with small language models and routes complex requests to cloud models through Amazon Bedrock. This post walks through building AAIF with local SLMs through Ollama and Amazon Bedrock, using an Internet of Things monitoring scenario.
articles.titleEn: Adaptive agentic intelligence framework using Strands Agents | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: This one-size-fits-all approach can drive up API costs, introduce unpredictable latency, and remove the possibility of offline operation.
Built on Strands Agents, the framework demonstrates how intelligent model orchestration can help reduce costs while maintaining low latency for local operations.
Cost savings can come from the roughly 80 percent of traffic that doesn’t hit a paid API endpoint.

articles.title: 5 production challenges in multi-agent systems and how Deep Insight solved them | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Many teams build a multi-agent AI prototype in days but hit a wall in production. This post defines five production challenges (orchestration, per-agent model selection, reliable operation, secure code execution, and monitoring) and shows how Deep Insight, an open source multi-agent system on AWS, solves each.
articles.titleEn: 5 production challenges in multi-agent systems and how Deep Insight solved them | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: All three share the same multi-agent architecture, so an agent validated in development deploys to production as-is.
Because the agents generate both code and report content, we also cover responsible AI controls for production in Solution detail 2.
Thanks to open source frameworks and cloud services, you can set up an agent in a matter of days.

articles.title: Powering Agentic AI with the Arm AGI CPU Software Ecosystem
articles.descEn: Explore the agentic AI software stack on Arm AGI CPU, from orchestration and retrieval to model serving, and learn how developers can build on Arm.
articles.titleEn: Powering Agentic AI with the Arm AGI CPU Software Ecosystem
summaryLinesEn: While agentic AI applications share a common software foundation, their infrastructure requirements vary significantly based on the tasks they perform.

At OCP Global Summit, Arm introduced a new CPU evaluation methodology with support from Fujitsu, Meta and OpenAI, alongside independently verified results showing Arm AGI CPU delivers up to 2x performance per rack versus leading x86 server processor.

Take a closer look: Agentic AI is redefining what CPUs need to deliver. @modal's early benchmarks show @NVIDIA Vera, built on Arm, delivering up to 2x the throughput of comparable x86 systems under heavy concurrency.
