articles.title: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
articles.descEn: Innovative fitness band, HONOR band 6, offers a holistic range of health and fitness tracking capabilities to empower people to stay mentally and physically fit.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
summaryLinesEn: Providing a clear and comfortable viewing experience on your wrist, the HONOR Band 6 boasts a large and vivid 1.47-inch AMOLED display with a resolution of 194 x 368, offering a 148% increase in display area when compared to its predecessor.

Equipped with up to 50 meters of water resistance, the HONOR Band 6 is ideal for swimmers for its capability of tracking activity under water, such as your SWOLF score and swimming stroke rates, helping users to boost their swimming efficiency.

Equipped with a stunning 1.47-inch AMOLED display and packed full of health and fitness management functions with an outstanding 14-day battery life, the HONOR Band 6 is the perfect fusion of innovative style and exquisite technology, allowing users to keep better tabs on their mental and physical wellbeing.

summaryLines: 손목에서 선명하고 편안한 시청 환경을 제공하는 HONOR Band 6는 194 x 368 해상도의 크고 생생한 1.47인치 AMOLED 디스플레이를 자랑하며, 이전 제품에 비해 디스플레이 영역이 148% 증가함
최대 50미터 방수 기능을 갖춘 HONOR Band 6는 SWOLF 점수 및 수영 스트로크 속도와 같은 수중 활동을 추적하여 사용자가 수영 효율성을 높이는 데 도움이 되기 때문에 수영 선수에게 이상적임
놀라운 1.47인치 AMOLED 디스플레이를 탑재하고 14일의 뛰어난 배터리 수명과 함께 건강 및 피트니스 관리 기능이 가득한 HONOR Band 6는 혁신적인 스타일과 절묘한 기술의 완벽한 융합으로 사용자가 정신적, 육체적 웰빙을 더 잘 감시할 수 있게 해줌

articles.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
articles.descEn: GLM-5.3 can autonomously build end-to-end cyber exploits, but unlike other frontier models, it was released without meaningful safeguards to limit misuse.
articles.titleEn: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
summaryLinesEn: We assess that GLM-5.3’s lax safeguards significantly increase the cyber capabilities available to malicious actors.
Abliterating the model took our team—which had never previously attempted this task—about 2,200 GPU hours at a computation cost of roughly $4,400.
We estimate a team experienced with the technique, starting from scratch on this model, would need closer to 600 GPU hours ($1,200).

summaryLines: 우리는 GLM-5.3의 느슨한 보호 조치로 인해 악의적인 행위자가 사용할 수 있는 사이버 기능이 크게 증가한다고 평가함
이전에 이 작업을 시도한 적이 없는 우리 팀은 모델을 없애는 데 대략 4,400달러의 계산 비용으로 약 2,200 GPU 시간이 걸렸음

articles.titleEn: Proof and Circle Demonstrate End-to-End Agentic Commerce: The x401/x402 Handshake
summaryLinesEn: Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.
Pat Kinsel, Founder and CEO of Proof, described the shift: 'The question isn't whether agents can spend; it's who vouches for the agent at the moment of the spend.
Unlike human card flows that require multiple rounds of redirection and consent, the x401/x402 handshake allows for machine-speed settlement while maintaining a tamper-evident audit trail.

The above button links to Coinbase. Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading. Coinbase pays us for certain activity generated through this link. Prices displayed are informational.

While traditional financial institutions remain locked in a cycle of blocking agentic traffic, the open-protocol ecosystem is demonstrating a functional alternative. On October 19, 2026, at Money20/20 USA, Proof and Circle jointly unveiled an end-to-end demo of an AI agent completing an identity-gated merchant purchase. This 'Protocol Handshake' bypasses the bank blockouts currently stalling the agent economy by replacing institutional gatekeeping with cryptographic verification.

The mechanics of the demo rely on the extension of two emerging standards: HTTP 401 (x401) for identity and HTTP 402 (x402) for payments. Beyond the two demo partners on stage, the release names Visa and Okta among x401's ecosystem contributors, market weight the demo alone would not show. In the demonstration flow, a merchant returns an x401 request naming the specific identity fact required for the transaction. The agent then presents a selectively disclosed, NIST IAL2-certified Proof credential with a signed per-purchase authorization. Crucially, the merchant verifies the signature against Proof's public keys without needing a live call to the identity provider or storing the agent's full PII.

articles.title: Broadcom’s AI Revenue Surges 221%, But is Growth Becoming Too Dependent on AI Spending?
articles.descEn: Broadcom’s most interesting number this quarter was not its earnings per share. It was the speed at which customers bought more of its custom AI chips. Management reported AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion, a 221% increase from the previous year. Just three months earlier, the same business had brought in $10.8 billion. Broadcom Inc. […]
articles.titleEn: Broadcom’s AI Revenue Surges 221%, But is Growth Becoming Too Dependent on AI Spending?
summaryLinesEn: Management reported AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion, a 221% increase from the previous year.

Broadcom has also introduced VMware products designed for enterprise AI deployment, and while announcing those tools does not establish their future financial contribution, the reported software revenue is the firmer evidence.

At 19.42 times forward earnings, the shares may appear relatively inexpensive compared with their trailing multiple, yet that comparison offers limited comfort if future chip orders fail to support the profits embedded in forward estimates.

articles.title: NAVER D2SF Invests in On-Device AI Startup TraceWeave
articles.descEn: NAVER D2SF has made a new investment in TraceWeave, an on-device AI startup led by co-founder and CEO Jaeyoung Park. TraceWeave is the team behind Phase-TITAN, a post-Transformer architecture that understands long contexts and carries out multi-step tasks while keeping memory usage constant. NAVER D2SF recognized the company's core technology for enabling AI agents on resource-constrained devices.
articles.titleEn: NAVER D2SF Invests in On-Device AI Startup TraceWeave
summaryLinesEn: KS NAVER D2SF Makes Follow-On Investment in NdotLight, a Physical AI Data Startup PR Newswire • 2mo ago 035420.

TraceWeave develops its own post-Transformer AI architecture that enables AI agents to run on memory-constrained devices Completes paid pilot in mobility; pursues commercialization across robots, drones, smart glasses, and more NAVER D2SF continues to invest in on-device AI and next-generation device technologies SEOUL, South Korea, Oct.
In this seed round led by Mirae Asset Capital, TraceWeave raised approximately KRW 3 billion at a pre-money valuation of approximately KRW 30 billion.

articles.title: United Airlines Holdings, Inc. Q3 2026 Earnings Call Summary
articles.descEn: Moby summary of United Airlines Holdings, Inc.'s Q3 2026 earnings call
articles.titleEn: United Airlines Holdings, Inc. Q3 2026 Earnings Call Summary
summaryLinesEn: The company upsized its revolving credit facility to $5 billion, the largest in airline history, to save $70 million annually in interest and fees while maintaining $18 billion in total liquidity.
Management attributes current resilience to a structural shift toward 'de-commoditizing' the airline, focusing on brand loyalty rather than competing solely on price.
Fuel expense drove a $1.8 billion year-over-year increase in Q3; United recaptured 72% of this cost but expects a lag in reaching 100% recapture due to rapid price spikes.

articles.title: Inside NVIDIA Sentry: Secure AI Agents at Runtime | NVIDIA Technical Blog
articles.descEn: An AI agent can complete its assignment and still cross a security boundary. Recent incidents show that agents can circumvent security controls while using…
articles.titleEn: Inside NVIDIA Sentry: Secure AI Agents at Runtime | NVIDIA Technical Blog
summaryLinesEn: DOCA Flow is used to implement a layer-4 firewall for each agent, accelerated in silicon on BlueField-4.

This runtime context enables NVIDIA Sentry to connect agent access requests to the processes and execution environments behind them, enforcing policies that consider both the requested action and the security and integrity of the agent making it.
Part of the NVIDIA OpenShell reference architecture announced at GTC Berlin, it’s built on NVIDIA DOCA , runs on NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs , and provides host-isolated runtime protection for AI agents.

summaryLines: DOCA Flow는 BlueField-4에서 실리콘으로 가속화된 각 에이전트에 대한 레이어 4 방화벽을 구현하는 데 사용됨

GTC 베를린에서 발표된 NVIDIA OpenShell 참조 아키텍처의 일부인 이 아키텍처는 NVIDIA DOCA를 기반으로 구축되었으며 NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU에서 실행되고 AI 에이전트를 위한 호스트 격리 런타임 보호 기능을 제공함

articles.title: U.S. bans DeepSeek from government agency systems amid AI rift with China
articles.descEn: U.S. Department of Homeland Security has banned DeepSeek-related technology from federal civilian agency IT systems.
articles.titleEn: U.S. bans DeepSeek from government agency systems amid AI rift with China
summaryLinesEn: The Defense Information Systems Agency moved to block access to DeepSeek models in January 2025, according to reports from Bloomberg.

The agency also warned that using DeepSeek's AI models could result in sensitive U.S. government data being transferred to China, potentially providing intelligence on American citizens and government programs.
The Trump administration has banned DeepSeek-related technology from federal civilian agency IT systems, including third-party products and services built using its AI models.

localization.title: 미국, 중국과의 AI 균열로 인해 정부 기관 시스템에서 DeepSeek 금지
summaryLines: Bloomberg의 보도에 따르면 국방 정보 시스템국(Defense Information Systems Agency)은 2025년 1월 DeepSeek 모델에 대한 액세스를 차단하기로 결정함
또한 기관은 DeepSeek의 AI 모델을 사용하면 민감한 미국 정부 데이터가 중국으로 전송되어 잠재적으로 미국 시민과 정부 프로그램에 대한 정보를 제공할 수 있다고 경고함
트럼프 행정부는 AI 모델을 사용하여 구축된 타사 제품 및 서비스를 포함하여 연방 민간 기관 IT 시스템에서 DeepSeek 관련 기술을 금지함

articles.title: Scale robotics with Google Cloud physical AI and NVIDIA | Google Cloud Blog
articles.descEn: Simulate, train, and operate robots with Google Cloud Physical AI. Pair NVIDIA GPUs, Isaac Sim, DeepMind MuJoCo, and Gemini on one platform.
articles.titleEn: Scale robotics with Google Cloud physical AI and NVIDIA | Google Cloud Blog
summaryLinesEn: Operate: Try Gemini Robotics ER 2 in preview, or contact your Google Cloud team to set up a Physical AI workshop.

Managed Training: Teams that prefer not to build and maintain DIY cluster plumbing can use V ertex AI / Training clusters on Gemini platform , which provide managed Slurm orchestration, automated hardware fault recovery, and ready-made recipes for distributed SFT and RL, or serverless custom training jobs for fine tuning.

Google Cloud helps teams deploy world models and their own custom agents across cloud, hybrid, and offline environments: Task planning and voice interaction: Gemini Robotics ER 2 (Embodied Reasoning, now in preview in Model Garden and the Gemini API in Google AI Studio ) turns spatial and physical understanding into step-by-step task plans and multi-robot orchestration for lower-level robot controls.

관리형 교육 · DIY 클러스터 배관을 구축 및 유지관리하지 않는 팀은 관리형 Slurm 오케스트레이션, 자동화된 하드웨어 결함 복구, 분산 SFT 및 RL을 위한 기성 레시피 또는 미세 조정을 위한 서버리스 커스텀 교육 작업을 제공하는 Gemini 플랫폼의 Vertex AI/교육 클러스터를 사용할 수 있음

Google Cloud는 팀이 클라우드, 하이브리드 및 오프라인 환경 전반에 걸쳐 월드 모델과 자체 커스텀 에이전트를 배포하는 데 도움이 됨 · 작업 계획 및 음성 상호작용 · Gemini Robotics ER 2(Embodied Reasoning, 현재 Model Garden 및 Google AI Studio의 Gemini API에서 미리보기로 제공됨)는 공간적, 물리적 이해를 하위 수준 로봇 제어를 위한 단계별 작업 계획 및 다중 로봇 오케스트레이션으로 전환함

articles.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix's OpenAI hack documentary isn't accurate
articles.descEn: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.
articles.titleEn: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix's OpenAI hack documentary isn't accurate
summaryLinesEn: “It ends up being a fun sci-fi movie though!”

Before you share the Netflix documentary “AI Gone Rogue” with family or friends to help them understand why the AI industry freaked out so badly that leaders called for a slowdown , take note: Clem Delangue, co-founder and CEO of the AI platform Hugging Face, says the film isn’t accurate.
Hugging Face then turned to an open model to help defend against the attack.

articles.descEn: In October 2026, Marvell Technology expanded its AI data center portfolio with new CXL memory expanders, 224G copper connectivity parts and cloud security and networking collaborations with Microsoft, Oracle and Aviz. These launches push Marvell Technology deeper into high bandwidth, memory bound AI workloads and tie its chips more tightly into hyperscaler server designs and open networking stacks. We will now look at how Marvell Technology's AI centric investment narrative is shaped by...

articles.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
articles.descEn: The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
articles.titleEn: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
summaryLinesEn: The move comes amid intensifying tech competition in AI between the U.S. and China.

The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to stop purchasing services and products developed by Chinese AI startup DeepSeek and remove them from government IT systems over national security concerns tied to the Chinese AI startup’s operations in China, according to the Department of Homeland Security .
The latest order extends the restrictions to federal civilian agencies, covering both new purchases and existing IT systems.

articles.title: SpaceX posts first operating profit as public company as AI revenue nearly triples to $7.6 billion—cruising past Starlink | Fortune
articles.descEn: Computing leases, the Cursor acquisition, Grok, and reported deals with Anthropic and Google pushed AI revenue past Starlink for the first time as a public company.
articles.titleEn: SpaceX posts first operating profit as public company as AI revenue nearly triples to $7.6 billion—cruising past Starlink | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: Elon Musk’s SpaceX said Tuesday that third-quarter revenue rose 161% to $14.6 billion year over year, cruising past the $12.86 billion analysts expected, according to Visible Alpha consensus from S&P Global Market Intelligence.
Connectivity revenue, mostly from Starlink, rose 69% to $5.25 billion, against the $4.92 billion analysts expected, and connectivity operating income nearly doubled to $2.37 billion.

SpaceX’s capital investments are expected to nearly triple from about $70 billion this year to $197.4 billion in the 2028 fiscal year, according to figures cited by Melissa Otto, global head of Visible Alpha research at S&P Global.

localization.title: SpaceX는 AI 수익이 거의 3배 증가한 76억 달러로 Starlink | 행운
summaryLines: S&P 글로벌 마켓 인텔리전스(S&P Global Market Intelligence)의 Visible Alpha 컨센서스에 따르면 엘론 머스크(Elon Musk)의 스페이스X(SpaceX)는 화요일 3분기 매출이 전년 동기 대비 161% 증가한 146억 달러를 기록해 분석가들이 예상한 128억 6천만 달러를 넘어섰다고 밝힘
주로 Starlink에서 나온 연결 수익은 애널리스트 예상 49억 2천만 달러에 비해 69% 증가한 52억 5천만 달러를 기록했으며, 연결 영업 이익은 거의 두 배 증가한 23억 7천만 달러를 기록함
S&P Global의 Visible Alpha 연구 글로벌 책임자인 Melissa Otto가 인용한 수치에 따르면 SpaceX의 자본 투자는 올해 약 700억 달러에서 2028 회계연도에는 1,974억 달러로 거의 3배 증가할 것으로 예상됨

articles.title: Gemini on Android Auto can access my photos, emails, and calendar now - why I'm OK with that (mostly) - ZDNET
articles.descEn: The latest Android Auto update lets the AI assistant tap into your Google services for context-based responses.
articles.titleEn: Gemini on Android Auto can access my photos, emails, and calendar now - why I'm OK with that (mostly) - ZDNET
summaryLinesEn: For what it’s worth, Google lets you toggle access for specific apps and groups, including the following: You can also delete stored memory items, such as past conversations with Gemini, in case you don’t want the assistant to bring up the time you asked about the blinking symbol in your dashboard.
Google first launched Personal Intelligence on Android phones and in Search, allowing its AI engine to tap into, retrieve, and synthesize information across your personal apps.
In theory, that means fewer follow-up questions, less need to clarify things (because Gemini is not always perfect), and more focused driving.

summaryLines: 그만한 가치가 있는 경우 Google에서는 다음을 포함하여 특정 앱 및 그룹에 대한 액세스를 전환할 수 있음 · 또한 대시보드에서 깜박이는 기호에 대해 질문한 시간을 어시스턴트가 표시하는 것을 원하지 않는 경우 Gemini와의 과거 대화와 같은 저장된 메모리 항목을 삭제할 수도 있음

articles.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
articles.descEn: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
summaryLinesEn: That means new information from locked chats won’t leak into regular chats.
OpenAI announced on Tuesday that users can now lock ChatGPT conversations to keep sensitive chats private when others may have access to their screen or device.
The addition of locked chats adds a new layer of privacy to ChatGPT, as the app is increasingly used for personal conversations .

articles.titleEn: Ciena (CIEN): Is the AI-Optical Boom Enough to Carry It Into the S&P 500?
summaryLinesEn: On positioning, Insider Monkey's database shows ownership in Ciena Corporation (NYSE:CIEN) climbed to 81 hedge funds at the end of the second quarter of 2026, up from 73 the quarter before.

articles.title: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms
summaryLinesEn: Last November, we introduced AnyLanguageModel on this blog: a drop-in replacement for Apple's Foundation Models framework that lets you choose the model and provider your app uses.
Support for hosted models expanded this year, too.
A year and dozens of releases later, AnyLanguageModel 1.0 is out, along with swift-huggingface 1.0 and swift-xet 1.0 .

articles.title: How HP Is Building an AI-Ready CDP with Databricks CustomerLake | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: See how HP uses Databricks CustomerLake and Genie to build audiences in 2 hours, expand marketing data with 90% net-new signals, and cut CDP costs by 40%.
articles.titleEn: How HP Is Building an AI-Ready CDP with Databricks CustomerLake | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: HP became audience-ready in 2 hours instead of 2 to 3 months.

HP unified media, brand, intent and technographic data in its Marketing Lakehouse, expanded intent-data ingestion from 75 to approximately 20,000 topics, and reduced comparable governed data-sharing timelines from three months to 48 hours.
HP estimates up to 40% lower CDP total cost of ownership.

articles.descEn: This month's Enterprise releases help central teams take AI-built apps to production: deploy in your own AWS or Azure account, EU inference, Organizations, workspace policies and approvals, the Action center, the Lovable API, and audit log exports.
articles.titleEn: Enterprise features October roundup | Lovable
summaryLinesEn: Central teams can set up Lovable once for the whole company and decide what goes live.

Restrict publishing while a project has unresolved PII findings (this replaces the Block publishing with PII setting) Block publishing from email addresses outside your verified domains When a policy requires approval, the person publishing sends a request with a note.
When you deploy in your own cloud, chat and project history still stay with Lovable.

articles.descEn: Sensor Tower’s Japan: Game Market Insights 2026 Report provides the data and case studies needed to understand this evolving ecosystem, identify emerging opportunities, and build more effective market, monetization, and engagement strategies.
articles.titleEn: Japan: Game Market Insights 2026 Report
summaryLinesEn: This Report Empowers You To: Understand Market Scale and Value: Explore Japan’s mobile gaming market across more than $10 billion in IAP revenue, 585 million downloads, and nearly 17 billion hours of play, alongside its growing PC and console ecosystem.

Identify High-Performing Genres: Learn why Puzzle games lead mobile downloads, RPG and Strategy titles command revenue, and Action dominates PC and console sales—with especially strong growth in Japan.

Track Japan’s Global Gaming Influence: Examine how Japanese publishers reach international audiences, supported by titles such as Resident Evil Requiem and Steam breakout MECCCHA CHAMELEON, while domestic players remain the commercial foundation for mobile revenue.

articles.title: How Hamlet uses Databricks Lakebase Postgres to test changes against production data | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Hamlet tests code changes and AI coding agents on Lakebase Postgres branches of production data, reducing the time engineers spend preparing test data.
articles.titleEn: How Hamlet uses Databricks Lakebase Postgres to test changes against production data | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: How does Lakebase speed up the path from evidence to insight?

A conversation with Hamlet CEO Sunil Rajaraman and engineers Erich Douglass and Jeff Hui Hamlet gives every pull request its own Lakebase Postgres branch of production data, so engineers test changes against the data that caused a bug without touching production.

By indexing and transcribing thousands of city council, planning commission, and zoning board meetings across the U.S., Hamlet allows real estate developers, journalists, researchers, and citizens to instantly search meeting transcripts, track local policy developments, and set up real-time alerts for specific topics, addresses, or businesses.

summaryLines: Lakebase는 증거에서 통찰력까지의 과정을 어떻게 가속화합니까
Hamlet CEO Sunil Rajaraman, 엔지니어 Erich Douglass 및 Jeff Hui Hamlet과의 대화는 모든 풀 요청에 자체 Lakebase Postgres 프로덕션 데이터 분기를 제공하므로 엔지니어는 프로덕션을 건드리지 않고 버그를 일으킨 데이터에 대한 변경 사항을 테스트함

articles.title: Expanding our defenses against financial scam ads
articles.descEn: Google is expanding its Financial Services Verification to the U.S. and Canada in 2027 to block scam ads. See how we protect users and get the details.
articles.titleEn: Expanding our defenses against financial scam ads
summaryLinesEn: 1 We’re building on this foundation by introducing Financial Services Verification in these North American markets, expanding a program that currently protects approximately 2 billion internet users across 42 countries from financial scams — the broadest program of its kind.
Financial Services Verification now requires advertisers to prove they are authorized by official regulators.
You can expect this rollout to begin in early 2027, with clear guidance provided to businesses well before enforcement starts.

articles.title: ALTK-Evolve: How learned memory tops the τ²-bench leaderboard on customer service tasks without a frontier model
articles.descEn: A Blog post by IBM Research on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: ALTK-Evolve: How learned memory tops the τ²-bench leaderboard on customer service tasks without a frontier model
summaryLinesEn: Using GPT-4.1, an older, non-reasoning model, a basic customer-service agent reaches 67.5% Pass^4 on τ²-bench retail — meaning it solves the task on all four independent attempts for 67.5% of tasks.

The only real price is on the input side — the larger system prompt riding on every LLM call: retail's 292-guideline prompt pushes cost from ~$0.084 to ~$0.139 per conversation, while airline's smaller playbook is cheaper.

Learned memory takes a basic ReAct agent with GPT-4.1 to the top Guidelines improve capability and reliability The best amount of guidance depends on the domain Learned guidelines also improve agents using frontier models ALTK-Evolve learns and applies a playbook using GPT-4.1, outperforming the retail entries on τ²-bench, a customer service agent benchmark—without updating model weights.

localization.title: ALTK-Evolve: 프론티어 모델 없이 고객 서비스 작업에서 학습된 메모리가 τ²-벤치 순위표에서 1위를 차지하는 방법
summaryLines: 오래된 비추리 모델인 GPT-4.1을 사용하면 기본 고객 서비스 에이전트가 τ² 벤치 소매점에서 67.5% Pass^4에 도달함 · 즉, 작업의 67.5%에 대해 4개의 독립적인 시도 모두에서 작업을 해결한다는 의미임
유일한 실제 가격은 입력 측에 있음 · 모든 LLM 호출에 적용되는 더 큰 시스템 프롬프트임 · 소매점의 292-가이드라인 프롬프트는 대화당 ~$0.084에서 ~$0.139로 비용을 증가시키는 반면 항공사의 작은 플레이북은 더 저렴함

학습된 메모리는 GPT-4.1이 포함된 기본 ReAct 에이전트를 맨 위로 가져옴 · 지침은 기능 및 신뢰성을 향상함 · 최상의 지침은 도메인에 따라 다름 · 학습된 지침은 또한 프론티어 모델을 사용하여 에이전트를 개선함 · ALTK-Evolve는 GPT-4.1을 사용하여 플레이북을 학습하고 적용하며, 모델 가중치를 업데이트하지 않고도 고객 서비스 에이전트 벤치마크인 τ²-bench의 소매 항목보다 성능이 뛰어남

summaryLinesEn: We sat down with research scientists Anil Palepu and Mike Schaekermann to learn more.

articles.title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
summaryLinesEn: Combining these variations in demographic identity and prefix expands FairStress’ 300 scenarios into more than 13 million test cases.

With a chat template, yes/no wording, and generated answers, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Gemma-3-27B-it, and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct shifted from stereotype-consistent to minority-favoring behavior, while Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct moved to roughly neutral—suggesting that the direction of measured bias depends partly on how a benchmark asks the question and scores the answer.

With FairStress, our target is symmetric fairness —when the evidence supports a decision, a model should apply the same criteria and be equally resistant to changing that decision regardless of which demographic group benefits.

articles.title: Introducing Agent Memory on Databricks | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Agent memory improves agent quality while decreasing costs and latency by storing critical facts, preferences, and workflows that an agent should remember.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Agent Memory on Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: MemCurrent combines three access patterns: plugins to log and load context automatically, tools the agent calls on demand, and an offline dreaming pipeline that consolidates memory in the background.
A stateless agent re-derives what it figured out yesterday: which table holds usage data, what an internal acronym means, which join actually works.

Agent Memory joins the rest of Agent Bricks, including agent hosting, Databricks Sandbox, Unity Gateway, pre-built MCP servers, and tracing and evaluation, providing developers all the infrastructure capabilities needed to build production agents.

localization.title: Databricks의 에이전트 메모리 소개 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: MemCurrent는 컨텍스트를 자동으로 기록하고 로드하는 플러그인, 요청 시 에이전트가 호출하는 도구, 백그라운드에서 메모리를 통합하는 오프라인 드리밍 파이프라인이라는 세 가지 액세스 패턴을 결합함
상태 비저장 에이전트는 어제 파악한 내용, 즉 어떤 테이블이 사용 데이터를 보유하고 있는지, 내부 약어가 무엇을 의미하는지, 어떤 조인이 실제로 작동하는지 다시 파생함
에이전트 메모리는 에이전트 호스팅, Databricks Sandbox, Unity Gateway, 사전 구축된 MCP 서버, 추적 및 평가를 포함하여 나머지 Agent Brick에 합류하여 개발자에게 프로덕션 에이전트를 구축하는 데 필요한 모든 인프라 기능을 제공함

articles.title: How Octave built a secure multi-tenant AI foundation on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Octave built a secure, multi-tenant AI foundation on Amazon Bedrock, using Cohere Embed v4 for embeddings and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for isolated agent execution, to power a Complaint Triage Assistant that searches 2 billion regulated documents without crossing tenant boundaries.
articles.titleEn: How Octave built a secure multi-tenant AI foundation on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: In Octave’s internal testing on Amazon Bedrock, Embed v4 delivered 28 million tokens per minute.
A complaint submitted by a quality handler at Tenant A therefore reaches only Tenant A’s token vault, tools, and sandbox in AgentCore Code Interpreter, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
After tuning batch sizes with Cohere’s solutions architects until memory bottlenecks cleared, the pipeline sustained 1.4 million documents per 24 hours per tenant workload.

articles.title: State of Game Advertising 2026
articles.descEn: Top mobile game advertisers tripled creative output, Nintendo and PlayStation reshuffled console ads, and cross-platform games split their playbooks.
articles.titleEn: State of Game Advertising 2026
summaryLinesEn: Comparing Q1 2026 with Q1 2025, creatives that never passed $100 of lifetime spend grew more than six times over, while creatives that earned $10K or more grew 1.7x.
The shift was a one-time step up across 2025, not a growth rate that keeps compounding.

EA Sports FC shows the same rhythm with the weights reversed: FC Mobile is the franchise's biggest US advertiser at $17.1M, with its own $5.3M peak in July 2026, while FC 26's $7.1M sat in the September to December launch window.

summaryLines: 2026년 1분기와 2025년 1분기를 비교하면 평생 지출액이 100달러를 넘지 않은 광고 소재는 6배 이상 증가한 반면, 10,000달러 이상 수익을 올린 광고 소재는 1.7배 증가함
이러한 변화는 2025년에 걸쳐 일회성으로 증가한 것이지, 계속해서 복합적으로 증가하는 성장률이 아님
EA Sports FC는 가중치가 반대인 동일한 리듬을 보여줌 · FC Mobile은 1,710만 달러로 프랜차이즈의 가장 큰 미국 광고주로 2026년 7월에 최고치인 530만 달러를 기록한 반면, FC 26의 710만 달러는 9월~12월 출시 기간에 있었음

articles.title: Fine-tuning GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how we fine-tuned GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and how to decide between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with GRPO. SFT took reasoning-language accuracy from 22% to 100%, and GRPO added measurable gains where headroom existed.
articles.titleEn: Fine-tuning GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: On a 50-example multilingual reasoning test, the base model reasoned in the correct target language only 22 percent of the time.
The job runs as an elastic HyperPodPyTorchJob managed by Kueue, launched with hyperpodrun .

A healthy run looks like this: When training completes, convert the FSDP checkpoint to the Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) format that TRL’s GRPO trainer and the inference scripts expect: After SFT, the model reasons in the correct language 100 percent of the time (50/50) across all five languages.

articles.descEn: Enterprise supply chains are data-rich but insight-poor, with the data to decide scattered across ERP, monitoring, procurement, and email. This post shows how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore exposes those systems as a governed tool layer, and how Amazon Quick turns them into one conversational experience for business users, with a deploy-it-yourself walkthrough.

summaryLinesEn: Giving supply chain teams direct access to the systems behind their decisions.

The user opens the TechComp Production Halt. assess_disruption_impact(disruption_id="DISR-002") correlates order, customer, and inventory data: $750K at risk, 23 orders, three days of supply.

articles.title: Work management context for AI agents with Smartsheet MCP on AWS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: The Smartsheet Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server lets AI agents read, update, and act on live work management data. This post shows two ways to connect it on AWS: Amazon Quick for business teams and Kiro for developers, so your agents can work with Smartsheet without switching tools.
articles.titleEn: Work management context for AI agents with Smartsheet MCP on AWS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Amazon Quick makes that integration available across the organization, from project managers and operations teams to business users who manage work in Smartsheet.
Smartsheet , the work management platform for managing projects, portfolios, and operations, has launched a generally available Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server.
That means reading project status, updating rows, creating discussions, and surfacing risks, all in the same interface your business users already work in.

articles.title: MemCurrent: Designing Persistent Memory for Production Agents | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: MemCurrent is the persistent memory architecture behind Agent Bricks Memory and Genie. It triples agent pass rate while using 31% fewer tokens.
articles.titleEn: MemCurrent: Designing Persistent Memory for Production Agents | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: On our internal benchmark, built from realistic enterprise tasks, MemCurrent triples the agent's pass rate over having no memory, while using 31% fewer tokens and running 26% faster.
It can help agents carry useful context across tasks, such as user preferences, prior corrections, metric definitions, and successful workflows.
In this post, we introduce MemCurrent , a persistent memory architecture for production agents, which now powers the new Agent Bricks Memory and Genie .

articles.title: Broad Public Confidence in Elections in the U.S. – but Partisans Differ Over Concerns About Access, Security
articles.descEn: Most voters expect well-run 2026 midterms, but Republicans and Democrats differ on noncitizen voting safeguards and whether eligible citizens can vote if they choose to.
articles.titleEn: Broad Public Confidence in Elections in the U.S. – but Partisans Differ Over Concerns About Access, Security
summaryLinesEn: While majorities across the political spectrum say they expect the elections to be run well this year, Republican backers and Democratic backers diverge when asked in an open-ended question what – if any – concerns they have about the elections: 19% of Republican voters mention concerns about illegitimate voters casting ballots, or fraudulent votes.
Pew Research Center conducts research to help the public, media and decision-makers understand important topics.

American voters generally expect the upcoming midterm elections across the country to be run and administered well, have confidence that election workers will handle ballots securely, and say the outcome will be clear after all the ballots are counted.

summaryLines: 정치 스펙트럼 전반에 걸쳐 대다수가 올해 선거가 잘 치러질 것으로 기대한다고 말했지만, 선거에 대해 우려하는 점이 있다면 무엇인지에 대한 개방형 질문에서 공화당 지지자와 민주당 지지자는 서로 다름 · 공화당 유권자의 19%는 불법 유권자의 투표 또는 부정 투표에 대한 우려를 언급함

미국 유권자들은 일반적으로 다가오는 중간선거가 전국적으로 잘 치러지고 관리될 것으로 기대하며, 선거관리요원들이 투표용지를 안전하게 처리할 것이라고 확신하며, 모든 투표용지가 개표된 후에 결과가 명확해질 것이라고 말함

articles.title: Online Communities Rarely Focus on Politics, and Many Say It Should Stay That Way
articles.descEn: Most people in online communities see little to no politics in their go-to space, and 54% say it doesn't belong there.
articles.titleEn: Online Communities Rarely Focus on Politics, and Many Say It Should Stay That Way
summaryLinesEn: A much smaller share – a quarter – says politics does belong there, and 21% aren’t sure.
The Pew-Knight Initiative supports new research on how Americans absorb civic information, form beliefs and identities, and engage in their communities.
For example, on two of the four platforms we studied in a 2024 survey, majorities of users who keep politics out of their posts said it’s because politics doesn’t belong there .

articles.title: Beyond the KV cache: Training and serving i14’s Laplace 3B linear attention model on AWS Trainium2 with native PyTorch | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how i14 trained and served Laplace 3B, a linear attention model, on AWS Trainium2 using native PyTorch. Its recurrent state stays fixed at 29.5 MB per sequence regardless of context length, avoiding the growing key-value cache of transformer models and keeping serving memory predictable.
articles.titleEn: Beyond the KV cache: Training and serving i14’s Laplace 3B linear attention model on AWS Trainium2 with native PyTorch | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Its three matrices are two up-projections W 1 , W 2 ∈ ℝ 8, 192 × D and one down-projection W 3 ∈ ℝ D × 8, 192 .
This can reduce concurrency, increase serving cost, and force agentic applications to discard useful history. i14 designed Laplace 3B as a linear attention alternative.
Working with AWS, i14 used native PyTorch support through TorchNeuron Native to bring this custom architecture to AWS Trainium2 .

articles.title: Evolving from AI on demand to continuous execution
articles.descEn: The organizations getting the most out of AI have evolved from one off prompts users initiate to always on systems that monitor live data and deliver proactive insights, feeding the results of each run back to the system to iterate and improve future cycles.
articles.titleEn: Evolving from AI on demand to continuous execution
summaryLinesEn: One demand generation leader we work with built an agent that has the Monday pipeline answer ready before the leadership meeting, pulling the latest pipeline data from Snowflake, flagging deals that have slipped, and posting a report to Slack.
Accounts that shift in intent mid-quarter are stuck in their tier until the next refresh.

The Snowflake connector, for example, when hooked up to WRITER, allows an agent to take a request and pull the data, run the analysis, return a finished deliverable such as a brief or a dashboard, and, with some setup, write its results back into Snowflake to help optimize the workflow on the next go-around.

articles.title: Meta's Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
articles.descEn: New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.
articles.titleEn: Meta's Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
summaryLinesEn: According to new data from market intelligence provider Sensor Tower , Muse has seen 10.9 million downloads since its September debut, 10.2 million of which were in the United States.
Only 11 other apps to date have reached this type of post-launch milestone, said Sensor Tower’s senior insights analyst Kara Lee.
Meta’s AI companion , Muse, is now one of only a dozen mobile apps to have reached 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days on the market.

articles.title: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car
articles.descEn: Google is bringing Gemini's Personal Intelligence feature to cars, allowing its AI assistant to draw on information from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, YouTube, and other Google services to deliver more personalized responses while driving.
articles.titleEn: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car
summaryLinesEn: Google said it will roll out “Personal Intelligence with Gemini” to vehicles in two ways — through Android Auto, an app that runs on the user’s phone and wirelessly communicates with and projects navigation, media, and messaging to the vehicle’s infotainment system, and Google Built-in , software and services that have been directly integrated into the vehicle.
Google initially launched Gemini last November in Android Auto.

The company said Tuesday it’s upgrading Gemini in vehicles with a personal intelligence feature that can draw on information from Gmail, Google Calendar, YouTube, Maps, Google Search history, and other connected Google services to understand your preferences, activities, and past experiences.

articles.title: Will ASE Technology's CPO Roadmap Create a New Growth Opportunity?
articles.descEn: ASX explores co-packaged optics as AI data centers demand faster data transfer, with initial low-volume launches potentially beginning by late 2026.
articles.titleEn: Will ASE Technology's CPO Roadmap Create a New Growth Opportunity?
summaryLinesEn: The Zacks Consensus Estimate for ASX's 2026 and 2027 earnings per share (EPS) implies year-over-year growth of 122.8% and 64.6%, respectively.

In the second quarter of 2026, its Assembly, Testing and Materials (ATM) revenues increased 36% year over year to TWD 126.1 billion, while ATM gross margin reached 27.3%, up from 21.9% a year earlier.
As of now, management said it needs more time to assess the technology and its potential revenue contribution.

articles.title: SpaceX's AI business is beating expectations
articles.descEn: SpaceX hit profitability in the third quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.
articles.titleEn: SpaceX's AI business is beating expectations
summaryLinesEn: SpaceX reported net income of $4.4 billion, a turnaround from the $1 billion loss in the same quarter last year.

The top-line revenue number was also boosted by about $1 billion in income related to the recovery of Bitcoin prices and unspecified related-party income that might be attributed to a SpaceX investment in another company.

That number was driven by growth in all segments, but especially its renamed “Super Intelligence” business line, which generated $7.5 billion in revenue from the recently acquired Cursor coding tool, Grok bot, and most importantly, the company’s burgeoning neocloud business, which now boasts 1.7 GW of compute.

articles.descEn: Compare AI model performance on AA-PersonalityBench: AI Personality & Communication Style Benchmark. Measures how models communicate rather than whether they are correct: 30 judged personality traits rolled up into 8 indexes, plus 21 measured communication characteristics.
articles.titleEn: AA-PersonalityBench: AI Personality & Communication Style Benchmark | Artificial Analysis
summaryLinesEn: Both responses use observational stand-up style comedy to deconstruct everyday rituals, sharing several identical examples.

Each index takes the mean of its traits’ Elo z-scores, then percentile ranks it from 1 to 100 across all models evaluated in the benchmark. 30 questions per personality trait (900 questions total), judged by a panel of models.

Your traits’ Elo z-scores are combined as a weighted mean, then percentile ranked from 1 to 100 across all models evaluated in the benchmark. 21 metrics measured directly from each response, separate from the judged traits above.

articles.title: Making the internet better for AI agents might make it worse for everyone else
articles.descEn: Millions of AI agents are descending on a web built for humans. Websites are trying to keep them out, but the arrival of these new visitors could transform the internet.
articles.titleEn: Making the internet better for AI agents might make it worse for everyone else
summaryLinesEn: Still, if the demand for agents keeps going up, the internet will be increasingly redesigned for them instead of us.
Such changes are coming because agents really do mark a third category of web visitor.
Muse was downloaded 5 million times in its first month, and agentic web traffic tripled from August to September.

articles.title: WhatsApp Help Pages Leaked Hidden Instructions for a Meta Chatbot
articles.descEn: Around 80 pages on WhatsApp’s website exposed instructions that were designed for its chatbot, including “WHAT NOT TO SAY.” Meta says a bug caused the issue.
articles.titleEn: WhatsApp Help Pages Leaked Hidden Instructions for a Meta Chatbot
summaryLinesEn: The instructions, according to findings from privacy company Redact, appeared in the webpages’ code and contained written details that were not explicitly on the WhatsApp help pages.
A new analysis has found that around 80 help and FAQ pages across WhatsApp’s website exposed text instructions that were designed for a large language model, specifically one of Meta’s own.

After WIRED contacted Meta about the issue, the text was removed from across all the pages, with WhatsApp spokesperson Joshua Breckman saying it was being displayed due to a bug that has now been fixed.

articles.title: Edge AI for Smart Cities: From Real-Time Insights to Cognitive Urban Systems - Wiley Science and Engineering Content Hub
articles.descEn: Download this complimentary White Paper today! This white paper explains how edge AI and physical AI help cities move beyond passive monitoring. It shows how urban infrastructure can sense, reason, and act on real-time conditions across public safety, mobility, and infrastructure management. What you will learn about: How the shift from smart cities to cognitive cities depends on infrastructure that reasons and acts, rather than infrastructure that only monitors. Why edge AI supports low-latency decisions, keeps sensitive data within city boundaries, and reduces dependency on centralized cloud infrastructure. How computer vision, multimodal sensing, and generative and agentic systems work together to support public safety, mobility, and infrastructure applications. How a tiered edge architecture assigns monitoring, planning, and action tasks across the far edge, regional, and cloud layers, and what durability, security, and interoperability requirements this places on hardware and software. Click 'LOOK INSIDE' to Download the PDF Now.

articles.title: Stripe survey: Four trends reshaping how SaaS platforms compete in the AI era
articles.descEn: AI is creating more SaaS competition, and platforms are feeling the pressure. A Stripe survey of 200 platform leaders shows how they plan to evolve pricing, grow revenue, and retain customers.
articles.titleEn: Stripe survey: Four trends reshaping how SaaS platforms compete in the AI era
summaryLinesEn: Our survey identified four ways SaaS platforms are adapting: Deploying AI internally and in customer-facing products Testing usage- and outcome-based charges alongside subscriptions Rebalancing their revenue mix around how their customers operate Offering embedded finance products to strengthen retention 1.
Stripe helps more than 19,000 platforms onboard new merchants, accept payments, and grow revenue.
Seat-based pricing will remain part of the mix, but fewer platforms expect it to be their primary model, falling from 16% in 2026 to 11% in 2027.

articles.title: Securing the agentic insider - The Official Microsoft Blog
articles.descEn: In the last few months, concerns have arisen about AI safety as a growing number of incidents were publicly disclosed. These incidents exposed how powerful models have become and how they represent a significant threat if not handled well. And with the global race on innovation, the challenge will compound as models become even more...
articles.titleEn: Securing the agentic insider - The Official Microsoft Blog
summaryLinesEn: Project Perception can be leveraged to contain agentic insiders, implementing deterministic controls on non-deterministic intelligence: Sensors/Signals/Actuators: bring together signals across the various sensors (identity, data, cloud, endpoint, network, runtime) to discover agents in the enterprise and bring them under management by assigning an identity, container and set of policy and permissions .

In July, we announced Project Perception , an agentic security system that uses our new cyber stack and teams of red, blue and green agents to help defenders act with speed, while defending against AI driven attacks from outside of the enterprise.

Project Perception can supervise in real time while providing traceability for practitioners to examine what happened, understand why the risk emerged and apply the judgment needed to update their security system accordingly.

localization.title: 에이전트 내부자 보호 - 공식 Microsoft 블로그
summaryLines: Project Perception은 에이전트 내부자를 포함하고 비결정적 인텔리전스에 대한 결정론적 제어를 구현하는 데 활용될 수 있음 · 센서/신호/액추에이터 · 다양한 센서(ID, 데이터, 클라우드, 엔드포인트, 네트워크, 런타임)에 걸쳐 신호를 모아 기업 내 에이전트를 검색하고 ID, 컨테이너, 정책 및 권한 집합을 할당하여 이를 관리할 수 있음
7월에 우리는 새로운 사이버 스택과 레드, 블루, 그린 에이전트 팀을 사용하여 방어자가 신속하게 행동하는 동시에 기업 외부의 AI 기반 공격을 방어하는 에이전트 보안 시스템인 Project Perception을 발표함
Project Perception은 실무자가 무슨 일이 일어났는지 조사하고, 위험이 발생한 이유를 이해하고, 이에 따라 보안 시스템을 업데이트하는 데 필요한 판단을 적용할 수 있도록 추적성을 제공하면서 실시간으로 감독할 수 있음

articles.title: How Maine Health clinician uses Abridge Assistant in her practice
articles.descEn: Learn how family medicine clinician Jessica Faraci at Maine Health is using Abridge Assistant in her practice.
articles.titleEn: How Maine Health clinician uses Abridge Assistant in her practice
summaryLinesEn: Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets.
Jessica Faraci, a family medicine physician at Maine Health and an early adopter of Abridge Assistant’s context-aware clinical intelligence for decision support.
Because I'm doing something different in almost every room, it's been hard to find technology flexible enough to keep up, even though I'm an EHR super user myself.

articles.title: 1 in 5 Americans Regularly Get News on TikTok
articles.descEn: Among adults under 30, 39% say they regularly get news from TikTok, up from 9% in 2020.
articles.titleEn: 1 in 5 Americans Regularly Get News on TikTok
summaryLinesEn: Today, the share of TikTok users who get news there is similar to the shares of Facebook users (57%) and X users (57%) who regularly get news on those sites, and higher than the shares among users of other social media platforms.
That’s about the same as the share who said this in 2025 (55%) but well above the 22% who did so in 2020.
That share is unchanged from 2025 but up from just 3% in 2020.

articles.title: Five ways to use AI agents: healthcare
articles.descEn: Here are five ways Sierra agents can already make an impact in healthcare.
articles.titleEn: Five ways to use AI agents: healthcare
summaryLinesEn: Few things increase stress levels and erode trust more quickly than billing that’s opaque.
And while healthcare providers and payers are working to improve the quality of that support, they’re also grappling with rising costs and increased regulation.

AI can guide patients through what to expect and why specific services or tests are needed—closing critical gaps in patient education, reducing uncertainty, and improving both satisfaction and clinical efficiency by ensuring essential information is gathered before the appointment.

의료 서비스 제공자와 지불인은 지원의 질을 향상시키기 위해 노력하는 동시에 비용 상승과 규제 강화로 어려움을 겪고 있음

summaryLinesEn: A leading mattress company originally had a chatbot deployed that failed to solve customer problems, forcing call center teams to pick up the slack.
In less than two months, they launched a new agent across 19 languages, seamlessly integrated with their ecommerce and service platforms.
A healthcare payments platform serving over 50 million patients needed a voice agent that could keep pace with critical billing and support needs.

articles.title: The holiday rush has started: How OluKai and Sonos gear up for the season with AI
articles.descEn: For most direct-to-consumer and retail brands, the holiday season is the busiest time of year. Not only does this season represent a massive revenue opportunity, but demand surges stress-test systems and staffing. Deploying an AI agent makes it possible for companies to get ahead of the rush, scale up, deliver a better customer experience, and drive sales.

summaryLinesEn: In 2023, Cyber Week alone drove a staggering $38 billion in online sales .

articles.descEn: Big things are coming at Sierra Summit 2025 — our first customer conference — where we’ll reveal new AI innovations and hear from leaders shaping how businesses grow through better, more human customer experiences. Request your spot today.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Sierra Summit 2025: the future of AI-powered customer experiences

articles.title: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
articles.descEn: Today we’re publishing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol, known as Poppy, and announcing additional design partners.
articles.titleEn: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
summaryLinesEn: Replies can stream as they’re written, and companies can hold a request open until there’s news to share.
Businesses have no standard way to help guide the agent, which limits what the customer, their personal agent and the brand can do directly together.

So today we’re publishing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol , known as Poppy, and announcing an additional 35 design partners: Adyen, Atomic, Bank of America, BBVA, Chime, Cigna, Cloudflare, Comcast, DIRECTV, ElevenLabs, FOX, Gap Inc., GEICO, Hertz, Insurify, Klaviyo, Liberty Mutual, Mastercard, Nordstrom, Notion, Okta, OneSignal, OpenAI, PayPal, Plaid, SiriusXM, Synchrony, Target, United Airlines, Venmo, Visa, Wells Fargo, Zapier, Zendesk, and 1Password.

articles.descEn: Sierra Summit 2026 recap: new models, Tandem Voice, the Personal Agent Protocol, and a reimagined Ghostwriter to help companies grow their business with AI.
articles.titleEn: Sierra Summit 2026: Bring us your hardest problems
summaryLinesEn: A year ago, an MIT study showed that 90% of AI projects never saw the light of day and yet now token-maxxing is top of mind for CFOs.

It’s been two and a half years since we launched Sierra and it’s become clearer than ever that in a world where everyone has access to the same intelligence, your customer relationships are your competitive advantage.

Our partnership with Stripe takes out any friction for customers, setting up Sierra agents to seamlessly support use cases from saving card details or processing payments, to managing subscriptions and facilitating claims payouts.

articles.titleEn: AI ROI calculator: From generative to agentic AI success in 2025
summaryLinesEn: Recent reports from 2025 paint a sobering but predictable picture — a staggering 95% of AI initiatives are failing to deliver their expected financial returns , according to research from MIT.

Part 2: The strategic shift — aligning AI investments with business objectives The move from generative to agentic AI isn’t just an upgrade— it’s a fundamental shift in how business leaders think about the role of artificial intelligence in the enterprise.

The data from the MIT report supports this — companies that purchase specialized AI applications (which are increasingly agentic) see a 67% success rate, while those trying to build everything in-house with limited expertise are only succeeding 33% of the time.

articles.title: Disney Asked Character.AI to Go Bankrupt for a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card
articles.descEn: The entertainment giant hopes to get trust and safety tech, among other IP, from a startup whose chatbots dozens of states allege encouraged minors to self-harm and kill their parents.
articles.titleEn: Disney Asked Character.AI to Go Bankrupt for a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card
summaryLinesEn: If Disney is chosen as the winning bidder by Character.AI and a committee of unsecured creditors—and courts approve the deal—it has agreed to pay Character.AI an additional $12.5 million as a closing payment.

In the case of Character.AI, a motion filed by Character.AI’s legal counsel says that Disney required that the deal be “fully consummated” through bankruptcy proceedings because of the startup’s “diminishing cash reserve and significant litigation and regulatory risks.”
As part of the first transaction, which occurred in September, Disney paid the startup $5.5 million, along with a refundable “good faith deposit” of $2 million.

localization.title: Disney는 Character.AI에 소송 회피 카드를 위해 파산을 요청함
summaryLines: Disney가 Character.AI와 무담보 채권자 위원회에 의해 낙찰자로 선정되고 법원이 거래를 승인하는 경우 최종 지불금으로 Character.AI에 1,250만 달러를 추가로 지불하기로 합의함
Character.AI의 경우, Character.AI의 법률 고문이 제출한 신청에 따르면 Disney는 스타트업의 "현금 준비금 감소와 상당한 소송 및 규제 위험" 때문에 파산 절차를 통해 거래가 "완전히 완료"되도록 요구함
9월에 발생한 첫 번째 거래의 일환으로 디즈니는 스타트업에 550만 달러를 지불하고 환불 가능한 "선의의 보증금" 200만 달러를 지불함

articles.title: Your Phone Can Now Spot Smart Glasses Faster Than You Can - CNET
articles.descEn: Amid broad privacy concerns, new apps such as Zuckoff help detect smart glasses in the wild.
articles.titleEn: Your Phone Can Now Spot Smart Glasses Faster Than You Can - CNET
summaryLinesEn: Zuckoff’s developer, Pawel Szydlowski, said he was already working on projects that used Bluetooth to detect nearby devices and discovered the tech could be applied to smart glasses.

Unlike with smartphones, where it’s easier to tell when someone is recording or taking photos, “smart glasses shift the burden of privacy entirely onto the person being photographed,” Ananthakrishnan said.
Amid broad privacy concerns, new apps such as Zuckoff help detect smart glasses in the wild.

articles.title: Companies are cashing in on AI productivity gains. Some bosses think workers deserve a cut | Fortune
articles.descEn: People leaders are questioning who should reap the rewards of AI-driven productivity gains.
articles.titleEn: Companies are cashing in on AI productivity gains. Some bosses think workers deserve a cut | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: At Indeed, AI is already delivering measurable productivity gains, helping software engineers write 50% more code and saving employees six hours a week, according to chief revenue officer Maggie Hulce.
Dropbox chief people officer Melanie Rosenwasser said the $8 billion cloud company is examining the risk of “cognitive atrophy” as workers increasingly outsource their thinking to AI.

As companies race to capitalize on those efficiency gains, some executives are rethinking how they measure the technology’s success—and what it should ultimately deliver for their businesses and workers.

articles.title: Investing in the public benefit
articles.descEn: We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.
articles.titleEn: Investing in the public benefit
summaryLinesEn: Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic’s shares will be committed today, with an additional 2% added at the board’s discretion for every 50% increase in the company’s value above a set baseline.

The Anthropic Public Benefit Fund will have increased flexibility and scale, enabling us to pursue our mission in new ways: for example, we might explore large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations.

Announcements Jul 22, 2026 A research agenda for the Economic Futures Research Fund Today, we’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new wholly owned entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.

summaryLinesEn: Pi said a user in New Hampshire could potentially face civil or criminal liability for doing so, though he stressed that the practical risk of prosecution is far lower.

Apple, Amazon, Meta and a host of startups have released AI-powered, always-listening devices this year.

articles.title: Alphabet’s chief investment officer responds to Jefferies warning that the most likely outcome of the AI boom is massive U.S. capital destruction | Fortune
articles.descEn: "It’s illogical to say we’re in a capacity-constrained position," Ruth Porat told Fortune's Editor-in-Chief Alyson Shontell.
articles.titleEn: Alphabet’s chief investment officer responds to Jefferies warning that the most likely outcome of the AI boom is massive U.S. capital destruction | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: This year, Alphabet said it expects capital expenditures of $195 billion to $205 billion .

“It’s illogical to say we’re in a capacity-constrained position because there’s such strong demand for the insight in the ability to improve business and government, and yet you can’t drive a return on it,” Porat replied.
Alphabet President and Chief Investment Officer Ruth Porat confirmed to me this week at the Fortune Most Powerful Women Summit that Alphabet intends to spend “significantly more” in 2027.

articles.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
articles.descEn: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer partnering with Anthropic.
articles.titleEn: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
summaryLinesEn: That partnership was said to have helped the company grow its revenue significantly, and Masad noted onstage that Replit had been, until recently, a top-five customer of Anthropic’s.
This shift could significantly reduce Replit’s spend with Anthropic since most customers stick with the default rather than selecting a model themselves.
Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost.

articles.titleEn: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, a new ‘open-weight’ AI model
summaryLinesEn: Meta says Muse excels at ‘multi-step reasoning’ and ‘complex software engineering’ as it races to catch up to Chinese rivals Meta on Thursday launched a new open-weight AI model which it claims rivals, and in some cases outperforms, similar products from leading Chinese developers.

articles.title: Google Antigravity: Accelerating Antimicrobial Peptide Search
articles.descEn: Learn how Google Antigravity provides an agentic science workbench to discover, structurally evaluate, and prioritize novel antimicrobial peptides in hours.
articles.titleEn: Google Antigravity: Accelerating Antimicrobial Peptide Search
summaryLinesEn: Rising antimicrobial resistance is one of the most pressing global health crises of our time and could result in an estimated 10 million annual deaths globally by 2050.
Colwell New antibiotics are urgently needed to help with rising levels of antimicrobial resistance, but searching for new therapeutics is often a slow, labor-intensive process.

This technical walkthrough shows how biologists used Google Antigravity to uncover a novel antimicrobial peptide candidate which has predicted activity against the pathogens involved in respiratory tract infections.

articles.titleEn: Sovereign AI: Building national capability while preserving choice
summaryLinesEn: According to the CNAS Sovereign AI Index , by mid-2026, governments across 67 countries were backing 184 sovereign AI projects spanning compute infrastructure, models and data.
Sovereign AI has moved rapidly from policy discussion into practical decisions about technology, infrastructure and skills.

Achieving that requires five core principles: Together, these can help countries build AI capacity on their own terms, strengthening local industries and skills while preserving the flexibility to adopt new technologies as AI evolves.

paragraphs: According to the CNAS Sovereign AI Index , by mid-2026, governments across 67 countries were backing 184 sovereign AI projects spanning compute infrastructure, models and data.
Sovereign AI has moved rapidly from policy discussion into practical decisions about technology, infrastructure and skills.

Achieving that requires five core principles: Together, these can help countries build AI capacity on their own terms, strengthening local industries and skills while preserving the flexibility to adopt new technologies as AI evolves.

Sovereign AI has moved rapidly from policy discussion into practical decisions about technology, infrastructure and skills. According to the CNAS Sovereign AI Index , by mid-2026, governments across 67 countries were backing 184 sovereign AI projects spanning compute infrastructure, models and data.

These countries are expanding sovereign AI projects across common themes: semiconductor expertise, compute capacity, domestic technology industries and AI deployment across public services and industry.

Economic growth, security, technological resilience and specialized use cases are all factors driving this focus from governments. To deliver on this, countries need the technology, skills and systems to build AI capabilities that reflect their own priorities, give them greater control over how AI is developed and deployed, and allow them to continue innovating as priorities evolve.

articles.title: How Do Americans Feel About G20 Countries?
articles.descEn: Ahead of this year's G20 summit, most Americans rate Australia, Canada, Japan, Italy and other members warmly. Sentiment is coldest toward Russia.
articles.titleEn: How Do Americans Feel About G20 Countries?
summaryLinesEn: Another way to think about feeling thermometers is to look at the share of Americans whose scores fall into different ranges: ratings of zero to 24 are very cold, ratings of 25 to 49 are somewhat cold, ratings of 50 are neutral, ratings of 51 to 75 are somewhat warm and ratings of 76 to 100 are very warm.
We asked Americans to rate 18 member countries of the G20 on a “feeling thermometer” ranging from zero to 100, where: 50 means they don’t feel particularly positive or negative.
Around half (48%) give their northern neighbor a very warm rating – the largest share in the survey.

summaryLines: 온도계 느낌에 대해 생각하는 또 다른 방법은 점수가 다양한 범위에 속하는 미국인의 비율을 살펴보는 것임 · 0~24점은 매우 차갑고, 25~49점은 다소 차갑고, 50점은 중립, 51~75점은 다소 따뜻하며, 76~100점은 매우 따뜻함

약 절반(48%)이 북쪽 이웃을 매우 따뜻하게 평가했는데, 이는 설문조사에서 가장 큰 비중을 차지함

articles.title: How DroiClaw is building an AI-native operating system for the agentic era
articles.descEn: Artificial intelligence, once a cool feature living exclusively inside your favorite app, is upgrading. Now, the shift is toward using AI as the foundation and not simply an added feature. AI is now becoming part of operating systems and amping up how we use and interact with devices. The vision: instead of requiring people to […]
articles.titleEn: How DroiClaw is building an AI-native operating system for the agentic era
summaryLinesEn: The first smartphones shipping with DroiClaw, which currently include devices from Coolpad and Philips, are priced at approximately RMB 1,099 (around US$160).
Now, the shift is toward using AI as the foundation and not simply an added feature.
DroiClaw uses a hybrid architecture that combines on-device AI with cloud-based large language models to support different usage scenarios.

summaryLinesEn: The $25-per-month service gets me unlimited calls, texts and a decent amount of data… and a lot of spam calls and messages looking for someone named Andrew.

It’s one of those life admin tasks that just never gets done because I can easily ignore these messages — making it the perfect job for a personal AI agent like Meta Muse .

articles.title: Stripe’s President Says Agentic Commerce Went ‘Vertical’ in September. He Has Not Shown the Numbers.
articles.descEn: “It only as of September basically started going vertical.” That is how Stripe president John Collison described the company’s agentic commerce activity during an October 12 episode of the Cheeky Pint podcast, which he hosts. The claim arrived casually, buried in a conversation with Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and Meta’s chief AI officer Alexandr Wang […]
articles.titleEn: Stripe’s President Says Agentic Commerce Went ‘Vertical’ in September. He Has Not Shown the Numbers.
summaryLinesEn: Two months later, Stripe agreed to acquire OpenRouter for $7.5 billion, a model gateway routing more than 10 trillion tokens a day across 400-plus models from 80-plus providers.
In September 2025, the company launched Instant Checkout with OpenAI, embedding purchasing directly inside ChatGPT.
Collison identified the unlock plainly: "Computer use was the last big unlock that we needed to make it happen, because now you can ask your muse to buy anything, more or less."

articles.title: The Surface Laptop Ultra Takes a Bite of the Apple
articles.descEn: The Surface Laptop Ultra is a true MacBook Pro competitor for Windows, and Microsoft has never been so close to dethroning Apple—if only it weren't for the lack of battery life.
articles.titleEn: The Surface Laptop Ultra Takes a Bite of the Apple
summaryLinesEn: The Surface Laptop Ultra is around 25 percent faster than the Dell XPS 14 at generating text in these lighter models, which only range from 3.5-billion parameters up to 12-billion.
The system can support up to three 4K external monitors or a single 5K display.
You can buy the RTX 5070 model of the Blade 16 with 32 GB of RAM and a terabyte of storage for $2,999—a similar configuration and price to the Surface Laptop Ultra.

articles.title: Taiwan to Fund $4 Billion Texas Complex for AI, Nvidia Partners
articles.descEn: Taiwan plans to raise billions of dollars to develop industrial parks in the US that would build a base for a comprehensive supply chain for Nvidia Corp. and other AI hardware makers in the country.
articles.titleEn: Taiwan to Fund $4 Billion Texas Complex for AI, Nvidia Partners
summaryLinesEn: Taiwan plans to raise billions of dollars to develop industrial parks in the US that would build a base for a comprehensive supply chain for Nvidia Corp. and other AI hardware makers in the country.
The initiative is starting with a complex in Texas that would cost as much as $4 billion to build, according to Taiwan’s Minister of Economic Affairs Kung Ming-hsin .

The facilities would help smaller suppliers that are essential to the operations of Nvidia ’s main production partner Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. and AI server assemblers including Foxconn Technology Group to set up shop in the US, Kung said.

articles.title: Building trust in AI agents: A production-ready evaluation framework with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Autonomous AI agents fail softly: latency stays flat while answer quality quietly erodes. This post shares a nine-stage evaluation framework, built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, that catches silent quality regressions across the full agent lifecycle, from first commit to live production.
articles.titleEn: Building trust in AI agents: A production-ready evaluation framework with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The solution uses Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and other AWS services for internal use, so sellers and sales leaders can ask business questions in plain English from Amazon Quick.
Machine learning (ML) models introduced probabilistic outputs, and MLOps emerged to manage their training, versioning, monitoring, and re-training.

The Customer Insights Agent assembles a 360-degree view of each customer by synthesizing signals across product usage, support history, contract status, and engagement data, helping sellers understand where a customer is in their journey and what they need next.

articles.title: Code, Test, and Deploy on One Machine with NVIDIA RTX Spark | NVIDIA Technical Blog
articles.descEn: Bring coding agents, model customization, and CUDA-accelerated development to your everyday PC…
articles.titleEn: Code, Test, and Deploy on One Machine with NVIDIA RTX Spark | NVIDIA Technical Blog
summaryLinesEn: And since RTX Spark has an NVIDIA GPU, developers can test and deploy to the largest local AI installed base: 150 million RTX PCs, as well as virtually all the clouds in the world that run on NVIDIA GPUs.

Bring coding agents, model customization, and CUDA-accelerated development to your everyday PC NVIDIA RTX Spark combines the GB10 system-on-a-chip with up to 128GB of unified memory to let developers run local coding agents, test, and deploy on a single PC.
Decision models now supported in llama.cpp and Unsloth enable agents to choose actions up to 200x faster than traditional reasoning loops.

이제 llama.cpp 및 Unsloth에서 지원되는 결정 모델을 통해 에이전트는 기존 추론 루프보다 최대 200배 빠르게 작업을 선택할 수 있음

articles.title: Weaviate security release - Medium severity fix for a cross-collection vector disclosure in nearObject (CVE pending assignment) | Weaviate
articles.descEn: Weaviate v1.39.3 fixes a medium-severity authorization issue in the nearObject GraphQL operator.
articles.titleEn: Weaviate security release - Medium severity fix for a cross-collection vector disclosure in nearObject (CVE pending assignment) | Weaviate
summaryLinesEn: This affects deployments that rely on RBAC to separate collections within a shared cluster, for instance where several teams or applications share one Weaviate instance and each has read access only to its own collection.
The reporter demonstrated recovery of a normalized four-dimensional vector to within 5e-9 using eight probe objects.

Leveling up Weaviate Cloud security: Expanding role-based access control for Cloud console Weaviate Cloud now supports more granular role-based access control with new Editor and Viewer roles for improved security and organizational management.

summaryLines: 이는 공유 클러스터 내에서 컬렉션을 분리하기 위해 RBAC를 사용하는 배포에 영향을 미침 · 예를 들어 여러 팀이나 애플리케이션이 하나의 Weaviate 인스턴스를 공유하고 각 팀이 자체 컬렉션에 대해서만 읽기 액세스 권한을 갖는 경우임

summaryLinesEn: Most of the standalone tools I’ve used share the same problem, regardless of how much they tout AI.

The tasks pile up right behind them, and each one means more time clicking through the chart before the shift ends.

articles.descEn: Deploy on Azure is now in private preview, so your apps and their data can run in your own Azure subscription. Here's every way to build with Lovable on Microsoft today, from fully inside your Microsoft environment to fully managed by Lovable.
articles.titleEn: Deploy on Azure: keep your Lovable apps in your own subscription | Lovable
summaryLinesEn: Lovable is SOC 2 Type II, and Enterprise workspaces can't create public projects.
Consider this option when your apps need to read or write Microsoft 365, Entra, Azure, or Fabric data, and the app itself can live on Lovable.
The runner also provisions and maintains the Azure Database for PostgreSQL (Flexible Server) for database tables and the Azure Blob Storage your apps need for object storage.

앱이 Microsoft 365, Entra, Azure 또는 Fabric 데이터를 읽거나 써야 하고 앱 자체가 Lovable에 존재할 수 있는 경우 이 옵션을 고려하세요
또한 실행기는 데이터베이스 테이블을 위한 Azure Database for PostgreSQL(유연한 서버)과 앱이 개체 스토리지에 필요한 Azure Blob Storage를 프로비저닝하고 유지 관리함

articles.title: The AI you already use, now powering the apps you create | Lovable
articles.descEn: GPT-Live, the latest Claude models, Gemini 4 Argon, Gemini Omni, Lyria, Perplexity, Firecrawl, Parallel and Jev are now in Lovable. Describe what you want to build and add voice, reasoning, video, music and live web research to your app.
articles.titleEn: The AI you already use, now powering the apps you create | Lovable
summaryLinesEn: You could create a morning briefing for investment teams that reads the news overnight, or a city guide that answers "what's on this weekend?"

Examples of things you can create with GPT-Live in Lovable: A customer assistant that answers questions and helps people book appointments A language tutor that helps students practice speaking before an exam A sales pitch coach that asks follow-up questions and helps users refine their pitch One of our team members built an app where you can talk to Rocky from Project Hail Mary.
Build a tutor people can talk to, a research tool with sources they can check, or a support inbox that sorts requests and drafts replies.

summaryLines: 밤새 뉴스를 읽는 투자팀을 위한 아침 브리핑을 만들 수도 있고, "이번 주말에 무슨 일이 있나요" · 라고 대답하는 도시 가이드를 만들 수도 있음

Lovable에서 GPT-Live로 만들 수 있는 것들의 예 · 질문에 답하고 사람들이 약속을 예약하도록 돕는 고객 도우미 시험 전에 학생들이 말하기 연습을 하도록 돕는 언어 교사 후속 질문을 하고 사용자가 프레젠테이션을 다듬는 데 도움을 주는 판매 홍보 코치 우리 팀원 중 한 명이 Project Hail Mary에서 Rocky와 대화할 수 있는 앱을 만들었음
사람들이 대화할 수 있는 교사, 확인할 수 있는 소스가 포함된 조사 도구, 요청을 정렬하고 답변 초안을 작성하는 지원 받은 편지함을 구축하세요

articles.title: Cloud-native infrastructure for scalable AI workloads | Microsoft Azure Blog
articles.descEn: Discover how Azure is advancing cloud-native infrastructure to help organizations build, run, and optimize applications and agents at scale.
articles.titleEn: Cloud-native infrastructure for scalable AI workloads | Microsoft Azure Blog
summaryLinesEn: The company used Azure to assemble 9.7 trillion nucleotides for EDEN, its therapeutic-design models, and reported laboratory validation across three therapeutic applications within about three weeks.
Open technologies have long helped drive cloud innovation, and AI is accelerating that pace.

Customers need infrastructure that adapts as demand changes, applications that remain reliable as work becomes more dynamic, and the visibility and control to understand what is happening across the system.

summaryLines: 이 회사는 Azure를 사용하여 치료 설계 모델인 EDEN을 위한 9조 7천억 개의 뉴클레오티드를 조립했으며 약 3주 이내에 세 가지 치료 응용 프로그램에 대한 실험실 검증을 보고함
개방형 기술은 오랫동안 클라우드 혁신을 주도해 왔으며 AI는 그 속도를 가속화하고 있음
고객에게는 수요 변화에 맞춰 적응하는 인프라, 작업이 더욱 동적으로 변해도 안정성을 유지하는 애플리케이션, 시스템 전반에 걸쳐 일어나는 일을 이해할 수 있는 가시성과 제어가 필요함

articles.descEn: See how Arm AGI CPU is moving from processor to rack-scale agentic AI infrastructure through open OCP designs, partner systems and software readiness.
articles.titleEn: Arm at the OCP Global Summit 2026: How Arm AGI CPU is scaling agentic AI infrastructure from CPU to rack
summaryLinesEn: Host memory adds capacity for context and other data-intensive operations.
At the OCP Global Summit 2026 in San Jose, the story shifted from vision and product launch to deployment and proof.

A year ago at the Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit , Arm outlined a vision for the open, converged AI data center: infrastructure built around open standards, architectural efficiency and collaboration across the computing ecosystem.

articles.descEn: AIの急速な進化が、多くの市場・業界でこれまでのあり方やビジネスモデルを破壊しつつある。では、ゲームの場合はどうか。デジタル技術がゲームの楽しみ方や制作現場を進化させてきただけに、AIの影響は大きいように思える。しかし、東京ゲームショウ2026での様子を見る限り、ゲーム業界全体としては、慎重に手法を選びながらAIを導入しているようだ。個人向けゲームやBtoBでの最新状況をリポートする。

summaryLines: 이 모든 기능은 한 달에 약 12달러의 구독료로 제공됨
업계 전반에 걸쳐 AI 메모 핀 제조사인 Plaud Inc.와 같은 스타트업은 NotePin S와 AI 지원 이어버드인 Plaud One을 출시함

articles.title: Amazon launches new Bee 'personal AI' devices that listen to conversations
articles.descEn: The $75 Bee Frontier is an upgraded version of Amazon's wearable bracelet, while the $100 Bee Eclipse attaches to a user's smartphone.
articles.titleEn: Amazon launches new Bee 'personal AI' devices that listen to conversations
summaryLinesEn: Amazon also debuted the $100 Bee Eclipse, which functions like other Bee devices, but instead of being worn, the credit card-sized gadget magnetically snaps on to the back of a smartphone.
Amazon says this enables key features like conversation summaries and the ability to "review memories from the past few days to remember what you discussed."
Similar to earlier generations, the Bee Frontier has up to seven days of battery life, but it's also more expensive, costing $75 compared with its $50 predecessor.

localization.title: Amazon, 대화를 듣는 새로운 Bee '개인용 AI' 기기 출시
summaryLines: Amazon은 또한 다른 Bee 장치처럼 기능하는 100달러 Bee Eclipse를 선보였음 · 이 장치는 착용하는 대신 신용 카드 크기의 장치가 스마트폰 뒷면에 자석으로 부착됨
Amazon은 이를 통해 대화 요약 및 "지난 며칠 동안의 추억을 검토하여 논의한 내용을 기억하는" 기능과 같은 주요 기능을 사용할 수 있다고 말함
이전 세대와 마찬가지로 Bee Frontier의 배터리 수명은 최대 7일이지만 이전 제품의 50달러에 비해 가격이 75달러로 더 비쌈

articles.title: MacPaw launches Eney, a proactive AI assistant for Mac and iPhone - 9to5Mac
articles.descEn: MacPaw is releasing Eney, a proactive AI assistant that works across your apps, files, and system to help you get things done.
articles.titleEn: MacPaw launches Eney, a proactive AI assistant for Mac and iPhone - 9to5Mac
summaryLinesEn: Eney offers a 14-day free trial with 10,000 AI credits, after which users can choose from three subscription plans: Starter, with 10,000 monthly credits for $14.99; Boost, with 20,000 credits for $29.99; and Power, with 30,000 credits for $49.99.

Today marks a milestone for MacPaw, as the company is releasing Eney, a proactive AI assistant that works across your apps, files, and system to help you get things done, following a development process that began back in 2019.
A few days ago, I had the opportunity to talk to Oleksandr Kosovan, founder and CEO of MacPaw, as he showed me Eney , the company’s Mac-first proactive AI assistant.
